data.title: Solution Test Engineer
data.description:
Join our Team

About the Opportunity: 

At Ericsson, we're shaping the future of connectivity through cutting-edge 5G and cloud-native technologies. We're looking for a Solution Test Engineer to lead end-to-end testing, system integration, automation, and validation of Ericsson Private 5G solutions ( BEWS - Private Networks). In this role, you'll work across 5G Core, RAN, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms, drive quality through automation and CI/CD, troubleshoot complex network issues, and collaborate with global teams to deliver world-class telecom solutions. 

What You Will Do

- Test Design & Execution: Design and execute detailed E2E system test plans for Ericsson Private 5G (EP5G) solutions, ensuring full coverage of 3GPP features and customer use cases. 
 - System Integration: Integrate and validate 5G components, including Cloud-Native Core (cn5GC), RAN, and Management/Orchestration platforms, ensuring seamless interoperability. 
 - Advanced Validation: Own the E2E validation for specific feature sets across performance, scaling, and stability, utilizing CI/CD pipelines for automated regression. 
 - Protocol Debugging: Perform deep-dive troubleshooting of complex call flows using tools like Wireshark/QXDM to analyze NAS/AS signaling and interfaces (N1, N2, N3, etc. ). 
 - Automation Development: Develop and maintain automated test scripts within a Python/Robot Framework environment to increase test velocity and reliability. 
 - Stability & Performance Testing: Design and run soak tests, stress tests, and load models to identify memory leaks and system bottlenecks before deployment. 
 - Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior engineers, conduct peer reviews of test cases, and contribute to the team's internal knowledge base. 

Skills You Bring

Bachelor's/Master's in CS, EE, or related field with 6-8 years of experience in Telecom/Network testing. 

5G/4G Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of 3GPP architectures and protocols (NGAP, S1AP, RRC, HTTP/2). Ability to analyze multi-interface traces to isolate faults. 

Cloud-Native Skills: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and Helm. Understanding of K8s networking (Services, Load Balancers, and CNI basics) is essential. 

Networking Foundations: Solid knowledge of L2/L3 networking, including IPV4/V6, VLANs, Routing, and familiarity with OSPF/BGP. 

Automation Proficiency: Strong Python scripting skills and experience with Robot Framework (or similar) to automate complex system-level scenarios. 

System Validation Expertise: Proven ability to design test cases for performance (throughput/latency), scaling, and stability (soak/reliability). 

Infrastructure & Tools: Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments. Experience with industry tools such as Spirent (Landslide), Keysight, or Viavi. 

"All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification. "

Are you ready to transform your passion for emerging technologies into tangible impact? Techolution, a leader in Full enterprise Automation, is seeking a highly enthusiastic UI Developer Intern to join our dynamic team. This is you chance to dive into ambitious MERN Stack projects, showcase your analytical prowess, and contribute to groundbreaking AI solutions that deliver real business outcomes. If you're eager to accelerate your career trajectory in a high-growth environment and build world-class products, your journey starts here. 

Designation: Associate UI Developer

Location: Remote, India

Employment Type: Full Time

Expertise: Associate (1-2 YOE)

Key Responsibilities

- Develop responsive and reusable user interfaces using React. js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Tailwind CSS. 
 - Build and maintain frontend applications with a focus on performance, usability, and scalability. 
 - Work with React Query for efficient server-state management, API integration, caching, and data synchronization. 
 - Develop dashboards involving charts, tables, filters, and data visualizations. 
 - Contribute to applications built using Microfrontend Architecture and understand the fundamentals of modular frontend development. 
 - Collaborate with UI/UX designers to translate Figma designs into functional and responsive interfaces. 
 - Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code following frontend development best practices. 
 - Use Git for version control and collaborate effectively within a development team. 
 - Write and maintain frontend tests using testing libraries such as Cypress. 
 - Debug UI issues, troubleshoot frontend defects, and contribute to improving application performance and reliability. 
 - Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and ensure seamless end-to-end functionality. 

Foundational Skills

- HTML & CSS / Tailwind CSS: Strong understanding of semantic HTML, responsive layouts, CSS fundamentals, and Tailwind CSS for building clean, reusable, and responsive UI components. 
 - JavaScript: Strong understanding of modern JavaScript concepts including ES6+, asynchronous programming, promises, closures, array/object manipulation, DOM interactions, and writing clean, maintainable frontend logic. 
 - React. js & React Query: Hands-on experience building reusable React components, managing component state, handling props and hooks, and integrating APIs using React Query for server-state management, caching, and data synchronization. 
 - TypeScript: Working knowledge of TypeScript, including interfaces, types, generics, and applying type safety while developing React applications. 
 - Dashboard Development: Experience building data-driven dashboards with interactive charts, tables, filters, pagination, and sorting, with a focus on presenting complex information in a clear and user-friendly manner. 
 - Microfrontend Architecture: Understanding of microfrontend concepts and how frontend applications can be broken into independently developed and deployable modules. 
 - Git: Strong understanding of Git for version control, including branching, merging, pull requests, resolving conflicts, and collaborating effectively within a development team. 
 - Figma: Ability to interpret Figma designs, understand layouts, spacing, typography, and component specifications, and accurately translate designs into responsive, production-ready UI. 

Advanced Skills

- Cypress / Frontend Testing: Experience writing and maintaining end-to-end or component-level tests using Cypress, with an understanding of test scenarios, assertions, selectors, and debugging test failures. 
 - Exposure to Nextjs for server-side rendering and static site generation is beneficial.

data.title: DevOps Engineer (Jenkins Expert)
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer - Jenkins Administration & CI/CD Integrations to join a dedicated Agivant engineering pod. This role is ideal for a hands-on Jenkins expert with strong experience in Jenkins administration, pipeline automation, GitLab integration, and CI/CD troubleshooting. 

You will play a key role in optimizing CI/CD workflows by integrating GitLab with Jenkins, automating repository configurations, and developing reliable webhook-based integrations. The primary objective is to reduce manual effort, improve pipeline reliability, and streamline configurations across 40+ repositories. 

Key Responsibilities

- Jenkins Administration: Administer, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Jenkins environments, including jobs, pipelines, plugins, credentials, agents/nodes, and build execution. 
 - CI/CD Pipeline Management: Develop, optimize, and maintain Jenkins pipelines using Jenkinsfiles and Groovy scripting. Ensure reliable pipeline execution and efficient build and deployment workflows. 
 - GitLab-Jenkins Integration: Configure and maintain GitLab integrations with Jenkins, enabling automated pipeline triggers through webhooks and repository events. 
 - Webhook Integration & Routing: Configure and troubleshoot webhook delivery from GitLab to multiple downstream Jenkins pipelines. Develop or maintain intermediary services such as RelayProxy, or configure suitable tunneling and routing tools where required. 
 - Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Develop and maintain Terraform configurations to automate repository-related setup and configuration migration from Gerrit to GitLab. 
 - API-Based Automation: Use GitLab REST APIs and scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Go to automate configurations, validate migrations, and reduce repetitive manual work. 
 - Bulk Repository Configuration: Execute and validate automated configuration changes across 40+ repositories, improving operational efficiency and reducing manual intervention. 
 - Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Diagnose Jenkins build failures, webhook delivery issues, plugin conflicts, agent connectivity problems, authentication errors, and CI/CD integration bottlenecks. 
 - Documentation & Operational Support: Maintain technical documentation, automation scripts, and troubleshooting procedures while ensuring reliable day-to-day CI/CD operations. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications

- 6-9 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD engineering, build and release automation, or Jenkins administration. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Jenkins administration, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting in production environments. 
 - Experience creating and maintaining Jenkins pipelines using Jenkinsfiles and Groovy. 
 - Strong understanding of Jenkins architecture, controller-agent configuration, plugins, credentials management, build execution, and pipeline security. 
 - Practical experience integrating Jenkins with GitLab using webhooks, repository events, APIs, and authentication mechanisms. 
 - Experience troubleshooting pipeline triggers, failed builds, webhook delivery, and connectivity issues. 
 - Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, preferably Python, Bash, or Go. 
 - Working knowledge of GitLab REST APIs and Git-based repository management. 
 - Exposure to Terraform and Infrastructure as Code for configuration automation. 
 - Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, network routing, reverse proxies, webhook payloads, and request/response handling. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced engineering environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience migrating CI/CD integrations or repository configurations from Gerrit to GitLab. 
 - Experience developing custom webhook relay or proxy services to route events to multiple Jenkins pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Linux administration, Git, and CI/CD security best practices. 
 - Experience managing Jenkins at scale across multiple repositories, teams, or build agents. 
 - Experience automating repetitive administrative tasks through APIs and Infrastructure as Code. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a Jenkins-first engineer who can administer, optimize, integrate, and troubleshoot CI/CD systems hands-on. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with Jenkins pipelines and GitLab integrations, writing automation scripts, and using Terraform where required. 

Candidates with strong Jenkins administration and pipeline expertise, supported by practical GitLab integration and automation experience, will be preferred over candidates whose experience is limited to general DevOps operations.

Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks. 

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails. 

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

- Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems. 
 - Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns. 
 - Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform. 

2. AI Application Development

- Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation. 
 - Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes. 
 - Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems. 
 - Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows.

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

- Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models. 
 - Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies. 
 - Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases. 
 - Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider. 

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

- Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs. 
 - Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules. 
 - Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP. 
 - Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance. 
 - Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership.

- Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs.

 - Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability. 
 - Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models. 
 - Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements. 

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs). 
 - Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Agentic AI & Generative AI

- Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 
 - Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability. 

Programming & Application Development

- Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node. js/TypeScript. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration. 

AI Frameworks & SDKs

- Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs.

LLM Integration

- Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs. 

Data Engineering & RAG

- Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies. 
 - Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search. 
 - Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG. 
 - Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture. 

Cloud Platforms

- Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 
 - Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools. 
 - Ollama and open-source LLMs. 
 - Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation.

 - Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches. 

What We're Looking For

 - Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking. 
 - A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions.

Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!

data.title: Lead OLTP Database Architecture, ETL & SSOT
data.description:
Work Timings: 10: 15 AM - 7: 15 PM

Working Days: 5 Days a Week - We Chose Balance Over the Industry Norm

Work Mode: Work from Office

Location: Marol, Mumbai

Job description

About IIDE

IIDE is India's leading digital business school, offering industry-relevant programs in digital marketing, AI, and business. With a strong focus on experiential learning, we equip students, graduates, and working professionals with the skills required to thrive in today's digital-first world. 

Backed by a community of 500, 000+ learners and 250+ industry experts, IIDE delivers hands-on training, real-world projects, and robust placement support. With campuses in Mumbai and Delhi, we continue to expand our presence across India and globally. 

About the Role

As the Team Lead Data Engineering & Analytics at IIDE, Mumbai, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and managing the organisation's data infrastructure, application databases, and business intelligence ecosystem. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role that involves leading a team of data engineers and analysts while actively contributing to database architecture, ETL/ELT pipelines, business system integrations, and reporting solutions. 

You will be responsible for establishing a reliable, centralised source of truth across the organisation, ensuring data accuracy, scalability, and accessibility. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will translate business requirements into robust technical solutions that enable data-driven decision-making and operational efficiency. 

You will also explore opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics to enhance business intelligence and automation. 

What You'll Do

- Database Architecture & Application Development: Design and develop scalable relational database architectures and schemas from scratch for business applications, including LMS, CRM, ERP, and student management systems. 

Define database entities, relationships, constraints, indexing strategies, and data models using PostgreSQL. 

Ensure transactional integrity, data consistency, security, and optimal performance across application databases. 

Collaborate with backend development teams to align database structures with application logic, APIs, and evolving business requirements. 

Plan and execute database migrations, schema versioning, performance optimisation, and scalability improvements. 

- Data Engineering & System Integration: Design, develop, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines to integrate data from CRM, websites, LMS, marketing platforms, and other business systems. 

Build automated data ingestion, transformation, and processing workflows using SQL, APIs, Python, and relevant integration tools. 

Implement incremental data loading, data validation, deduplication, error handling, retry mechanisms, and pipeline monitoring. 

Establish a centralised analytical data architecture with standardised data definitions and reliable historical records. 

Optimise data pipeline performance, processing efficiency, system reliability, and infrastructure costs. 

- Reporting & Business Intelligence: Consolidate existing reporting systems and establish standardised business metrics across departments. 

Develop reliable reporting datasets, analytical data models, and dashboards using BI platforms such as Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau. 

Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into accurate, actionable, and scalable reporting solutions. 

Identify and resolve reporting discrepancies, eliminate manual reporting processes, and improve data accessibility. 

Enable leadership and business teams to make informed decisions using consistent, trustworthy, and timely data. 

- Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Lead, mentor, and guide data engineers and analysts while ensuring clear ownership, accountability, and timely project delivery. 

Conduct technical reviews of SQL queries, database designs, data pipelines, and engineering implementations. 

Establish development standards, documentation practices, quality assurance processes, and technical best practices. 

Collaborate with technology, marketing, sales, finance, and academic teams to understand requirements and prioritise data initiatives. 

Remain actively involved in complex technical implementations, troubleshooting, and solution design while managing team responsibilities. 

- AI & Advanced Analytics: Identify opportunities to apply artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced analytics to improve business operations. 

Contribute to AI-enabled data solutions, automated insights, and intelligent reporting systems. 

Support predictive analytics initiatives, including lead conversion prediction, forecasting, customer segmentation, and trend analysis. 

Evaluate and implement relevant AI-driven solutions that improve operational efficiency and business decision-making. 

- Additional Duties: Establish and maintain a reliable, centralised data platform that supports seamless integration across business applications. 

Continuously improve data accuracy, database performance, reporting efficiency, and overall system reliability. 

Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual dependencies and enhance data engineering productivity. 

Ensure the team delivers maintainable, scalable, well-documented technical solutions aligned with organisational objectives. 

Perform any other reasonable duties as requested by management, aligned with the broad scope of the position. 

RequirementsWho You Are

- Must-Have: 4 - 8 years of relevant experience in data engineering, database development, analytics engineering, or related technical roles. 

Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and PostgreSQL, including query optimisation and database performance management. 

Proven experience designing relational database architectures for production applications, including ER modelling, normalisation, constraints, indexing, and transaction management. 

Strong understanding of OLTP databases, data integrity, transactional consistency, and backend application integration. 

Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and integrating multiple data sources. 

Proficiency in data modelling, data warehousing concepts, data transformation, and data quality management. 

Experience developing reporting datasets, consolidating business information, and standardising organisational metrics. 

Previous experience leading or mentoring data engineers, analysts, or other technical team members. 

Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and the capability to independently own complex technical implementations. 

Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders while translating business requirements into scalable data solutions. 

- Should Have: Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, scripting, and pipeline development. 

Experience working with cloud-based data warehouse platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Amazon Redshift. 

Familiarity with data orchestration and transformation tools such as Apache Airflow, dbt, or Dagster. 

Experience developing dashboards and business intelligence solutions using Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau. 

Working knowledge of REST APIs, cloud infrastructure, database deployments, and system integration practices. 

Experience implementing automated data validation, monitoring, and performance optimisation processes. 

- Nice to Have: Exposure to AI/ML initiatives, LLM integrations, predictive modelling, or business forecasting solutions. 

Familiarity with Spring Boot, Java, or other backend application development frameworks. 

Experience supporting predictive analytics use cases such as lead scoring, customer segmentation, or conversion forecasting. 

Relevant certifications or professional training in cloud platforms, database engineering, data analytics, or AI/ML technologies. 

Prior experience working with education technology platforms, LMS, CRM, ERP, or student management systems. 

BenefitsWhy Join IIDE?

- Work with one of India's fastest-growing digital education brands. 
 - Gain exposure to end-to-end data engineering, database architecture, and business intelligence initiatives. 
 - Take ownership of building and scaling the organisation's data infrastructure and centralised analytics ecosystem. 
 - Lead a technically driven team while remaining hands-on with architecture, engineering, and implementation. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute directly to business-critical decisions and technology initiatives. 
 - Explore opportunities to implement AI-enabled solutions, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation. 
 - Work in a collaborative, high-growth environment that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. 
 - Enjoy a five-day workweek that supports work-life balance and sustainable professional growth. 

Who You'll Thrive As

You're someone who: 

- Is a hands-on technical leader who enjoys designing and building scalable data solutions as much as guiding a team. 
 - Has a strong foundation in SQL, PostgreSQL, database architecture, and data engineering, with a passion for solving complex technical challenges. 
 - Thinks beyond individual reports and pipelines, focusing on building reliable, integrated, and future-ready data ecosystems. 
 - Takes complete ownership of technical initiatives, from understanding business requirements to architecture, implementation, and ongoing optimisation. 
 - Is passionate about data accuracy, consistency, automation, and establishing a single source of truth across the organisation. 
 - Can translate complex business problems into practical, scalable technical solutions that create measurable impact. 
 - Enjoys mentoring team members, establishing engineering best practices, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. 
 - Communicates effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and understands how technology supports broader business objectives. 
 - Is curious about emerging technologies, AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics, and actively explores opportunities to apply them.

data.description:
About Lyra

Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra's transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Clinical Governance & Quality Assurance
 - Framework Implementation: Lead the implementation and ongoing adherence to Lyra's global clinical governance framework and quality standards within the Indian context. 
 - Policy Development: Develop, review, and update local clinical policies and protocols to ensure full compliance with Indian mental health regulations (e. g. , Mental Healthcare Act 2017), ethical guidelines, and best practices. 
 - Quality Oversight: Design and oversee robust quality assurance activities, including systematic clinical audits, in-depth case reviews, and continuous outcome monitoring (CORE-10/Work Impact). 
 - Incident Management: Lead investigations into serious clinical incidents and formal complaints, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure corrective actions and systemic learning. 
 - Senior Escalation: Act as the final clinical escalation point for complex queries, ethical dilemmas, and high-risk situations, providing expert guidance and resolution. 
 - Clinical Delivery Oversight & Team Management
 - Team Leadership: Provide senior clinical oversight and leadership to teams responsible for direct service delivery, including Intake Counselors, Clinical Case Managers, and Structured Counselors. 
 - Fidelity & Pathways: Ensure consistent application of Lyra's clinical pathways, standardized assessment tools, and evidence-based intervention protocols across all delivery teams. 
 - Capacity Planning: Contribute to strategic planning regarding clinical team capacity and resource allocation to align with service demand and operational efficiency. 
 - Professional Development: Oversee onboarding and continuous professional development programs, focusing on clinical fidelity and the sophisticated use of Lyra's methodologies. 
 - Mentorship: Foster a high-performance environment by providing direct mentorship and supervision to Clinical Team Leaders. 
 - Case Management Excellence
 - Clinical Integrity: Maintain overall responsibility for the clinical integrity and effectiveness of the case management function. 
 - Data-Driven Optimization: Analyze aggregate case management data and trends to identify areas for process refinement and improved client outcomes. 
 - High-Acuity Consultation: Provide direct clinical guidance on high-acuity or highly sensitive cases requiring senior-level review and intervention. 
 - Care Coordination: Ensure rigorous adherence to best practices in care coordination, inter-provider collaboration, and referral pathways across the service spectrum. 
 - Interdepartmental Collaboration & Strategic Input
 - Network Partnership: Partner with the Network Operations Manager to ensure the provider network aligns with Lyra's standards, providing clinical input on recruitment criteria and performance expectations. 
 - Strategic Advisory: Provide essential clinical expertise to Product Development, Commercial, and Client Success teams to inform service evolution and market strategy. 
 - Thought Leadership: Represent Lyra's clinical approach and quality standards in external forums, conferences, and industry discussions. 

Requirements And Qualifications

- Master's degree in a clinical field (e. g. , Clinical Psychology, Counseling, Social Work). 
 - Optional: Valid and current professional registration/licensure to practice independently in India (e. g. , RCI registration for Clinical Psychologists or equivalent recognized national bodies). 

Experience

- Several years of extensive post-qualification clinical experience in mental health, including direct assessment, diagnosis, and evidence-based interventions. 
 - Several years of progressive experience in a clinical leadership, supervisory, or programmatic oversight role within India. 
 - Deep understanding of the Indian mental healthcare landscape and regulatory compliance. 
 - Fluency in English and Hindi is essential; knowledge of other major regional languages is a significant advantage. 

About You

- Clinical Acumen: Exceptional clinical understanding and the advanced ability to identify, assess, and manage high-level clinical risk and complex psychological presentations. 
 - Problem Solver: Highly analytical with superior problem-solving skills, capable of navigating intricate clinical and operational challenges independently. 
 - Autonomous & Accountable: Able to work independently without close supervision, while ensuring all key issues are escalated appropriately and critical decisions are clinically sound. 
 - Detail-Oriented: Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy of data, maintaining strict confidentiality, and adhering to complex clinical procedures. 
 - Communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex clinical concepts clearly and professionally to diverse stakeholders internationally. 
 - Proactive & Adaptive: Strong continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to innovate and refine clinical processes. Flexible, adaptable, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Organized: Highly organized with exceptional ability to plan, prioritize, and manage a high-volume, complex clinical function effectively. 
 - Collaborative: A strong team player who readily accepts change and collaborates effectively with internal and external partners. 

Miscellaneous

- Upholding Lyra Values: Act as a brand ambassador by consistently demonstrating Lyra's core values of clinical excellence, innovation, and empathy. 
 - Task Ownership: Ensure all allotted clinical and administrative tasks are performed with high precision and within agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs). 
 - Process Optimization: Proactively identify gaps in current workflows and implement solutions that enhance operational efficiency and care outcomes. 
 - Workshop & Content: Lead the delivery of onsite or online workshops and contribute to the development of training manuals and affiliate-facing materials. 
 - Event Participation: Represent Lyra Health at professional events and webinars to promote Lyra's transformative care model and clinical research.

Strong understanding of insurance industry regulations, data accuracy, auditability, and compliance standards. 
 - E2E Data Pipeline & Lakehouse Testing: Strong experience testing modern data architectures, covering source ingestion, transformations, and consumption layers. 
 - Hands-on Technical Validation: Expertise in SQL-based data validation, source-to-target reconciliation, pipeline dependency tracing, and identifying anomalies across automated workflows.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer (Bengaluru)
data.description:
We Are Hiring | Product Manager, Enterprise AI Platform | Bengaluru

About ReN3

ReN3 is a sovereign AI platform for the enterprise, built to unify an organization's knowledge and let teams execute AI-powered work under strict governance and access control. The platform runs in air-gapped, private-cloud, or other sovereign environments, so sensitive data never leaves the client's own infrastructure. ReN3 works with government, banking and financial services, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, and construction clients, and partners with major infrastructure and cloud providers on deployment. 

About the Role

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, security and cost of a multi-tenant AI platform running on Kubernetes. You'll own the full spectrum of reliability engineering, from provisioning infrastructure with Terraform to building alerting systems that keep our services running smoothly. As one of the first SREs on the team, you'll have the opportunity to shape our engineering practices, establish standards, and build a strong foundation for reliability as we scale. 

Our stack

- Platform: GKE, Terraform, Helm charts deployed through GitOps (Argo CD)
 - Services: TypeScript (NestJS) APIs and workers, Python agent runtime, JVM data-processing jobs
 - Data and messaging: PostgreSQL (plus MySQL and SQL Server for some customer deployments), Kafka, Temporal, Redis, a vector store
 - Security: OpenFGA for fine-grained permissions, a secrets manager, sandboxed code execution (gVisor)
 - Observability: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs
 - AI: several LLM providers behind a gateway, plus self-hosted models

Key Responsibilities

- Own SLOs. Define and defend uptime and latency targets for the APIs, the document-ingestion pipeline and the agent runtime. 
 - Change infrastructure only through code. Every change goes through Terraform and GitOps: planned, reviewed and applied. No click-ops and no ad-hoc kubectl in production. 
 - Make the system observable. Build tracing, dashboards and alerts that point to the cause, not just the symptom. Add AI-specific signals: token spend, provider latency and errors, queue depth and workflow backlog. 
 - Lead incidents. Run on-call, lead response, write blameless postmortems and make sure the root cause gets fixed. 
 - Control capacity and cost. Autoscaling, Kafka and Temporal throughput, database sizing, and LLM and GPU spend. 
 - Keep tenants isolated and secure. Secrets handling, network policy, sandbox isolation and least-privilege access. Help us pass customer security reviews and compliance audits. 
 - Support customer deployments. Some customers need their own region, their own cloud or their own data centre. Help make those installs repeatable. 
 - Run operations with agents, safely. Use coding agents to write Terraform, runbooks, scripts and alert triage. Build the guardrails (plan review, dry runs, scoped credentials, human approval) that keep agents from making unsafe changes to production. 

What We're Looking For

Must-have

- Based in Bengaluru
 - 3-5 years in SRE, DevOps or platform engineering, running production Kubernetes for real users. 
 - Strong Terraform and Kubernetes skills on at least one major cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure is fine). 
 - You write real code in Python, Go or TypeScript: tools and automation, not only YAML. 
 - Daily use of agentic coding, including on infrastructure. You can explain how you use agents without risking production. 
 - Hands-on incident experience with databases, queues, networking or DNS. You have been the one who found the cause. 
 - Observability experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog or similar. 
 - High agency. Take initiative, solve problems, deliver results, adapt quickly, and own your outcomes. 

Nice-to-have

- Running Kafka or Temporal in production. 
 - PostgreSQL operations: tuning, backups and point-in-time recovery, upgrades. 
 - Multi-tenant SaaS for enterprise or regulated customers. 
 - OpenShift, on-premises or air-gapped deployments. 
 - Serving LLMs or running GPU workloads. 
 - Sandboxing technologies such as gVisor or Firecracker. 

How to apply

- Submit your resume (more specifications below). 
 - Ensure your resume includes a link to something you built mostly with coding agents (a repo, a live URL, a writeup or a 3-minute Loom). 
 - Ensure your resume includes a short paragraph on a production incident you led: what broke, how you found it and what you changed afterwards.

You will also lead efforts to strengthen AI safety, observability, scalability, and cost efficiency across cloud infrastructure. Working closely with product engineering, security, infrastructure, and leadership teams, you will shape technical standards and drive an AI-first engineering culture. This remote opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer passionate about distributed systems, agent orchestration, and building resilient AI capabilities that deliver measurable impact. 

Accountabilities

- Architect, develop, and maintain production-grade agentic systems featuring multi-step reasoning workflows, tool usage, orchestration, planning, memory and context management, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Build and evolve a shared AI platform for product and engineering teams, including reusable agent frameworks, tool integrations, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, LLM gateways, and prompt and model versioning. 
 - Design and implement LLM gateway capabilities such as model routing, rate limiting, caching, fallback strategies, and usage controls. 
 - Establish comprehensive AI evaluation and observability practices, including evaluation frameworks, regression testing, agent tracing, and production metrics for quality, latency, cost, and safety. 
 - Lead the adoption of AI-driven engineering workflows, developer tooling, and automation that improve engineering velocity and reduce repetitive operational work. 
 - Manage cloud infrastructure for AI workloads across Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or AWS, including provisioning, scaling, security, access management, and cost governance. 
 - Implement robust AI safety and reliability measures, including guardrails, scoped permissions, sandboxing, prompt-injection defenses, audit trails, graceful degradation, and incident management practices. 
 - Drive continuous optimization of inference, token usage, and infrastructure costs while maintaining high standards of performance, reliability, and output quality. 
 - Define technical architecture and engineering standards, lead design reviews, produce design documentation, and mentor engineers across teams. 
 - Collaborate with product engineering, site reliability engineering, infrastructure, security, and organizational leadership to align AI platform capabilities with business and technical priorities. 
 - Use measurable performance data to guide architectural decisions, prioritize improvements, communicate risks, and report on platform health, agent quality, and cost efficiency. 
 - Champion an AI-first engineering culture, ensuring teams adopt shared AI capabilities and achieve measurable improvements in productivity and operational effectiveness. 

Requirements

- At least 12 years of overall software engineering experience, including substantial experience as a senior or staff-level individual contributor. 
 - At least one year of recent experience architecting and operating production agentic systems, including multi-step tool-using agents, orchestration, memory and context management, and safety guardrails. 
 - An AI-first mindset, with active use of AI tools in personal engineering workflows and the ability to encourage adoption across an engineering organization.

 - Strong hands-on engineering experience, including writing and reviewing code, debugging production issues, and making deep architectural contributions. Candidates whose work has been exclusively managerial rather than hands-on during the past year are not a fit for this role. 
 - Strong understanding of LLM application fundamentals, including tool and function calling, MCP, retrieval, context engineering, prompt and model management, and evaluation methods for nondeterministic systems. 
 - Extensive experience with observability practices, particularly AI observability, including tracing agent executions and monitoring production quality, latency, cost, and safety. Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, or equivalent tools is expected.

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr Manager Client Technology based in India. 

In this role, you will lead and develop a team of Cloud Platform Engineers responsible for delivering reliable, secure, and scalable cloud infrastructure. You will combine people management with hands-on technical oversight, ensuring high-quality Kubernetes operations and Terraform automation. Working closely with senior platform experts across international teams, you will help maintain architectural consistency and enforce engineering best practices. You will oversee workload planning, technical reviews, delivery priorities, and team performance while ensuring that progress reporting accurately reflects actual system and repository states. This position offers the opportunity to influence platform reliability, strengthen automation practices, and build engineering capabilities in a collaborative, distributed environment. If you enjoy balancing technical leadership with team development and operational excellence, this role offers a meaningful opportunity to make an impact. 

Accountabilities

- Lead and manage India-based Cloud Platform Engineers, overseeing workload allocation, prioritization, day-to-day execution, performance management, and team development. 
 - Review and validate Terraform modules, Kubernetes configurations, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) changes to ensure technical correctness, maintainability, compliance with established standards, and production readiness. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering workflows, including issue-based tracking, work triage, prioritization, work-in-progress limits, and regular status updates. 
 - Provide senior leadership with accurate, evidence-based progress reports verified against actual infrastructure, system configurations, and repository activity. 
 - Collaborate with Principal and Expert Platform Engineers across regions to align implementation with established platform architecture, GitOps practices, Terraform standards, and AKS conventions. 
 - Identify and escalate technical challenges, delivery risks, and operational concerns proactively to support timely resolution and predictable execution. 
 - Contribute to recruitment, onboarding, knowledge sharing, and skills development, particularly in Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Apply established security controls and policy-as-code standards, using Kyverno or equivalent tools, to ensure infrastructure changes meet platform governance requirements. 

Requirements

- At least 5 years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, site reliability engineering, or a closely related technical field, including previous people-management or formal technical-lead responsibilities. 
 - Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes, ideally Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), with the ability to independently review cluster configurations and workload changes and identify potential issues. 
 - Practical experience with Terraform, including reviewing modules for correctness, reusability, maintainability, and compliance with documented engineering standards. 
 - Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD, Flux, or equivalent, with a strong commitment to managing infrastructure and cluster changes through version-controlled workflows. 
 - Proven experience directly managing engineers, including performance development, workload planning, prioritization, and day-to-day team coordination. 
 - Strong reporting, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to provide senior stakeholders with accurate, verifiable updates on technical progress and delivery risks. 
 - Working knowledge of policy-as-code solutions such as Kyverno, Open Policy Agent (OPA), Gatekeeper, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound technical judgment, and the ability to balance operational execution with people leadership. 
 - Experience managing geographically distributed or offshore engineering teams reporting to leadership in another region is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and their practical application in everyday engineering workflows is preferred. 
 - Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent is beneficial. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy automation, including PowerShell-based workflows, into Terraform-driven or platform-native solutions is an additional advantage. 

Benefits

- Competitive compensation package aligned with experience and qualifications. 
 - Comprehensive employee benefits, with specific healthcare and coverage details to be confirmed during the recruitment process. 
 - Flexible working arrangements within a remote-friendly role based in India. 
 - A collaborative, supportive work environment that encourages initiative, knowledge sharing, and professional growth. 
 - Opportunities to strengthen technical expertise in cloud platforms, infrastructure automation, Kubernetes, and modern engineering practices. 
 - Access to learning opportunities and career development in a diverse, international business environment. 
 - Long-term organizational stability combined with the autonomy to contribute ideas, improve engineering processes, and make a meaningful impact. 
 - A people-focused culture that values curiosity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and a positive approach to work.

data.title: Manager, Data Storage Platforms
data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs. 
 - Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement. 
 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners. 
 - Manage datasets using Apache Hudi (version 0. 11. x and higher), focusing on supporting near real-time data processing and incremental data loading utilizing cutting-edge features for more efficient data lake management and complex data transformation pipelines
 - Implement the latest versions of Terraform (0. 12. x and higher) to efficiently handle infrastructure changes and versioning with enhanced security and flexibility

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge
 - Amazon Kinesis, Route 53, S3 (events, triggers)
 - Terraform (0. 12+)
 - Apache Hudi (0. 11+) and CDC methodologies
 - AWS DMS
 - Apache Spark (2. 4+) and PySpark
 - Amazon EMR (5. x+)
 - Python (3. 6+) for automation and pipeline development
 - IBM DataStage (for supplemental ETL workflows)
 - Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse

Reasonable Accommodation

Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. Form Link

Vantive has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Vantive employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

data.title: Lead Application Developer
data.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them. 

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself. 

Empower India is seeking a highly motivated Lead Fullstack Developer to serve as the functional owner of an internally developed document automation platform. This role is ideal for an experienced full-stack application developer who enjoys translating business requirements into intuitive, scalable software solutions. 

As a key member of the development team, you will own the ongoing enhancement of a business-critical application built with a Laravel/PHP back end and React/TypeScript front end. You will partner closely with business stakeholders to understand operational needs, design application features, and deliver solutions that automate the creation of high-quality business documents, including email communications and PDFs. 

This role combines application ownership, full-stack software engineering, and solution design. The ideal candidate brings a strong product mindset, works effectively across the full technology stack, and takes business requirements from concept through implementation. 

What You Will Do

- Serve as the functional owner of an internally developed document automation platform, driving the design, development, and continuous improvement of application features. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable, intuitive, and user-friendly application functionality. 
 - Design and develop responsive user interfaces using React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs using Laravel/PHP. 
 - Design and implement PostgreSQL database structures using Laravel migrations, with a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability. 
 - Design and maintain document templates and document-generation workflows supporting a variety of business use cases. 
 - Develop and maintain Python-based AWS Lambda functions that generate business documents, including email communications and PDFs. 
 - Integrate the application with enterprise systems, internal APIs, and third-party services. 
 - Build and maintain cloud-based application components using AWS services, including Lambda, S3, RDS, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager. 
 - Collaborate with technical team members to ensure solutions align with application architecture, engineering standards, and development best practices. 
 - Maintain technical documentation and source control using Git. 
 - Participate in code reviews and provide technical guidance to other developers as appropriate. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve usability, automate manual processes, and enhance the overall user experience. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies, including AI-powered application capabilities, and recommend solutions that improve business outcomes. 

What You Will Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 5+ years of experience designing and developing modern web applications. 
 - 3+ years of experience with Laravel/PHP developing and maintaining web applications and backend services. 
 - 3+ years of experience with React/TypeScript developing modern front-end applications and user interfaces. 
 - 3+ years of experience with PostgreSQL, including relational database design, development, and optimization. 
 - 3+ years of experience with AWS building, deploying, or integrating cloud-based applications and services. 
 - Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs. 
 - Experience using Git and modern software development practices. 
 - Experience collaborating directly with business stakeholders to define requirements and implement application features. 
 - Strong full-stack development skills spanning front-end, back-end, database, API, and cloud technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of application architecture, relational database concepts, and REST API architecture. 
 - Ability to translate business requirements into intuitive, scalable software solutions. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high-quality solutions in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail, with a commitment to delivering reliable, maintainable, and well-documented software. 

What Will Set You Apart

- Experience integrating enterprise applications with internal and third-party APIs. 
 - Experience with Snowflake. 
 - Experience integrating applications using LiteLLM or similar LLM gateway frameworks. 
 - Exposure to Amazon Bedrock or other generative AI platforms. 
 - Experience developing document-generation or workflow-automation applications. 
 - Experience designing responsive, user-focused interfaces and application workflows. 
 - Experience developing applications in Python, preferably for AWS Lambda.

Manager- Quality & Regulatory- General Quality and Regulatory

18

Summary

This section focuses on the main purpose of the job in one to four sentences. 

Manages and leads India BRD Drug RA compliance and regulatory execution, including laboratories and external testing partners

Regulatory Compliance Leadership:

data.description:
Software Testing Analyst (AI Training)

About The Role

What if your coding instincts could directly influence how AI writes software for millions of people? We're looking for Software Testing Analysts to put AI-generated code through its paces - running programs, hunting down bugs, and helping ensure that the software AI produces actually works the way it should. 

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role open to anyone who can read and run basic code. No formal QA certification or software engineering degree required - just a logical mind, a sharp eye for detail, and a knack for finding what breaks. 

- Organization: Alignerr
 - Type: Hourly Contract
 - Location: Remote
 - Commitment: 10-40 hours/week

What You'll Do

- Run AI-generated code and evaluate whether it produces correct, expected outputs
 - Hunt for bugs, edge cases, and unexpected or broken behavior
 - Document test results clearly in structured formats
 - Assess code readability and suggest practical improvements
 - Work across a variety of programming languages and problem types
 - Complete task-based assignments independently on your own schedule

Who You Are

- Comfortable reading and running simple programs - casual coders welcome
 - Logical thinker with a systematic approach to problem-solving
 - Naturally detail-oriented - you notice when something doesn't add up
 - Able to use a code editor or online IDE without hand-holding
 - Clear and concise written communicator
 - No formal QA, software engineering, or AI experience required

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with one or more programming languages (Python, JavaScript, etc. )
 - Background in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field
 - Experience with debugging tools or testing frameworks
 - Prior exposure to code review or software quality evaluation

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
 - Fully remote and flexible - work when and where it suits you
 - Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work
 - Make a direct, tangible impact on how AI writes and understands code
 - Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

About The Role

What if the code you write could determine how smart the next generation of AI truly is? We're looking for experienced Software Engineers to design and build the coding benchmarks and data pipelines used to evaluate frontier AI models - the systems that decide whether an AI can actually reason, debug, and write production-quality software. 

This is high-impact, technically demanding work at the intersection of software engineering and AI research. You'll work with large codebases, multiple programming languages, and scalable infrastructure to create evaluation systems that push the boundaries of what AI can do. 

This is a fully remote contract role. If you thrive in fast-paced engineering environments and want your work to directly shape the trajectory of AI - this is the role.

 - Location: Remote
 - Contract Length: 3 Months

What You'll Do

- Design and implement coding benchmarks used to evaluate frontier AI models across real-world programming tasks
 - Build and maintain scalable data pipelines for AI evaluation workflows
 - Analyze AI-generated code for correctness, reliability, and edge-case failures

Why Join Us

data.title: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead
data.description:
Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead at Monay

Location: Kakinada or Hyderabad, India

Work arrangement: On-site, full-time

Monay is building two connected products: a wallet for enterprise and consumer payments, and a blockchain settlement layer that links payments to invoices and records confirmed money movement. 

We need a strong engineer who can lead a small team in India and write production code every week. You'll work directly with our US-based founder and team, make technical decisions and take responsibility for getting features delivered. 

What the role involves

You'll lead and mentor 3-5 engineers across Monay Wallet and Monay Blockchain. The work includes wallet applications, backend services, ledger integrations and smart contracts. 

Our stack includes TypeScript, Next. js, React Native with Expo, Node. js, PostgreSQL, Rust, TigerBeetle and Solidity. We use Foundry, Hardhat and Arbitrum Orbit/Stylus across the blockchain work. 

You'll be expected to: 

• Take features from specification through implementation, testing and release. 

• Review code carefully and keep pull requests small enough to review properly. 

• Protect payment and ledger correctness as the products grow. 

• Use Claude Code or comparable AI coding agents daily, and verify what they produce. 

• Help your team solve problems, improve their work and meet commitments. 

• Raise blockers early and take the initiative to resolve them. 

Who we're looking for

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years leading or mentoring engineers. 

• Strong, current coding skills in TypeScript/Node. js or Rust, with a willingness to work in both. 

• Practical experience with AI coding agents in everyday engineering. 

• Exposure to Ethereum/EVM, Solidity and smart contract tooling. 

• A solid understanding of APIs, relational databases and testing. 

• Clear written English and dependable communication. 

• A record of taking ownership and finishing difficult work without constant supervision. 

Payments, fintech, double-entry accounting, reconciliation, wallet integrations, TigerBeetle or Arbitrum experience would be useful. 

Please read this before applying

This is a demanding startup role. It is not a routine 8-to-5 position where responsibility ends when the working day does. There will be tight deadlines, difficult problems and periods that require additional effort to get a release over the line. 

We're looking for someone dedicated, focused and highly motivated. You should be comfortable starting work without waiting for detailed instructions, making decisions and being accountable for the result. 

Commitment means delivering consistently, helping the team and maintaining quality when the pressure is on. We care about what you accomplish and whether people can depend on you. 

Employment and stock options

You'll initially be employed by Tilli Software India. The role will move to Monay India once the local entity is established. 

After two years, you may qualify for Monay stock options based on your dedication, performance, leadership and consistency. Eligibility and any grant are subject to review, approval and the terms of Monay's stock option plan. Completing two years does not automatically qualify you for a grant. 

You'll have the opportunity to help build our India engineering team and earn greater responsibility as the company grows. 

How to apply

Send your CV to both hr@tilli. pro and talent@Monay. com, along with links to code you've written and a short note telling us: 

• About a difficult feature or product you personally delivered. 

• How you use Claude Code or other AI coding agents. 

• Why this kind of role appeals to you. 

• Whether you prefer Kakinada or Hyderabad.

data.title: Data Automation Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Automation Engineer based in India. 

We are looking for a technically skilled and analytical Data Automation Engineer to build, manage, and optimize end-to-end data automation systems. In this role, you will connect business and marketing platforms, streamline data flows, and transform raw information into reliable insights that support strategic decision-making. You will design automated workflows, manage ETL processes, and integrate databases and third-party tools to create scalable data solutions. Working independently, you will take ownership of technical challenges and translate business needs into practical, efficient automations. You will also leverage AI-powered development tools to improve workflows and accelerate problem-solving. This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on professional who enjoys combining data analysis, automation engineering, and client-facing communication in a dynamic digital environment. 

Accountabilities

- Understand business objectives and operational challenges, then independently design, develop, and maintain end-to-end automation solutions. 
 - Analyze data from connected platforms to generate actionable insights and support informed business decisions. 
 - Build, manage, and optimize automated workflows using tools such as Zapier, Make. com, or similar automation platforms. 
 - Configure and maintain connectors and integrations between different business applications, marketing platforms, and data sources. 
 - Own the end-to-end Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) process, including extracting data, cleaning and standardizing information, and loading it into centralized databases. 
 - Use AI-powered tools, including Claude Code, to support development, troubleshoot issues, and improve data automation workflows. 
 - Maintain and enhance data infrastructure as data volumes, integration requirements, and business needs evolve. 
 - Identify inefficiencies, resolve integration issues, and continuously improve data accuracy, reliability, and workflow performance. 
 - Explain automation logic, technical decisions, and problem-solving approaches clearly to non-technical clients and stakeholders. 
 - Ensure automated systems are well organized, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives. 

Requirements

- At least 2 years of hands-on experience with automation platforms such as Zapier, Make. com, or comparable tools. 
 - Proven experience building and maintaining integrations between multiple applications using connectors, APIs, or native integration capabilities. 
 - Good working knowledge of ETL processes, including data extraction, cleaning, transformation, standardization, and loading. 
 - Demonstrated practical experience using Claude Code to support automation or development tasks. 
 - Working knowledge of databases and data platforms such as Supabase, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, or Snowflake. 
 - Basic understanding of marketing data and performance metrics, such as Google Ads and Meta Ads data. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to understand business requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions. 
 - Ability to work independently, manage automation projects end-to-end, and take ownership of troubleshooting and implementation. 
 - Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical workflows and data processes to non-technical clients. 
 - Attention to detail and a commitment to data quality, system reliability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and use AI-assisted tools to improve productivity. 

Benefits

- Remote work flexibility: Work remotely from India. 
 - Competitive compensation: Listed salary range of ₹5-7 lakh per year. 
 - Full-time employment: A full-time role offering opportunities to take ownership of end-to-end automation projects. 
 - Hands-on technical experience: Work with automation platforms, database technologies, data integrations, and AI-assisted development tools. 
 - Business impact: Build solutions that improve data accessibility, operational efficiency, and decision-making. 
 - Professional development: Expand your expertise in data engineering, ETL workflows, marketing analytics, and scalable automation systems. 
 - Independent ownership: Take responsibility for solving business problems and delivering practical technical solutions. 
 - Client collaboration: Develop experience communicating technical concepts and presenting solutions to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Additional benefits: Healthcare coverage, paid leave, bonuses, and other specific perks were not detailed in the provided job description. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
