data.title: AI Evaluation Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Evaluation Engineer based in India. 

As a founding AI Evaluation Engineer, you will design and build the evaluation, testing, and observability infrastructure that ensures production-grade AI agents perform reliably, safely, and efficiently. You will develop automated testing systems for complex reasoning, multi-turn conversations, and agent interactions involving APIs, databases, and code execution. Working across AI engineering, software testing, and infrastructure, you will create scalable evaluation pipelines that go beyond traditional QA and manual prompt testing. You will establish robust regression testing, statistical evaluation methods, and adversarial scenarios to identify weaknesses before deployment. This is an opportunity to take ownership of an evaluation architecture from the ground up while working with modern AI technologies in a fully remote, globally distributed environment. Your work will directly contribute to the reliability, security, and continuous improvement of advanced AI systems. 

Accountabilities

- Design, build, and maintain automated CI/CD testing pipelines to validate AI agent behavior before deployment and throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Develop and maintain golden datasets containing regression prompts, edge cases, and synthetic scenarios to measure agent accuracy, safety, performance, and latency. 
 - Implement fast, cost-effective, deterministic evaluation checks before introducing LLM-as-a-judge approaches, including JSON schema validation, regular expressions, API status checks, and embedding similarity. 
 - Create comprehensive test suites for multi-turn agent conversations, evaluating context retention, state consistency, reasoning behavior, and safeguards against infinite tool-calling loops. 
 - Design and implement adversarial testing scenarios to assess resilience against prompt injection, malformed inputs, unexpected tool responses, and other potential security vulnerabilities. 
 - Build statistical evaluation frameworks to measure non-deterministic AI behavior using pass rates across multiple runs, confidence intervals, and other quantitative reliability metrics. 
 - Integrate evaluation workflows into GitHub Actions or comparable CI systems using SDK-level execution and automated testing practices. 
 - Implement observability and tracing solutions using tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or equivalent platforms to monitor agent execution and diagnose failures. 
 - Optimize evaluation efficiency and cost through caching, mocking, and other techniques that reduce unnecessary LLM API calls. 
 - Validate structured outputs, including JSON schemas, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads, to ensure agents interact reliably with external systems. 
 - Evaluate and improve agent performance under load, accounting for variable response times and non-deterministic endpoint behavior. 
 - Independently design and own the evaluation architecture, establishing best practices, testing standards, and scalable processes for ongoing quality assurance. 

Requirements

- Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript, particularly for API testing, headless execution, asynchronous programming, and automated testing systems. 
 - Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation pipelines, AI testing frameworks, or statistical testing systems capable of measuring performance across repeated runs. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD environments, particularly GitHub Actions or similar platforms, with SDK-level execution. 
 - Strong expertise in validating structured data and outputs, including JSON schema, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads. 
 - Familiarity with observability and tracing tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or custom logging solutions. 
 - Ability to independently design, implement, and maintain an evaluation architecture from scratch, with a strong sense of ownership and technical judgment. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate technical findings clearly in a distributed team. 
 - Availability to overlap with US Central Time business hours for at least three hours each day. 
 - Experience with code execution sandboxes or AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI. 
 - Strong understanding of embedding models, vector databases, and their applications in AI evaluation and similarity-based testing. 
 - Experience with load testing non-deterministic endpoints and assessing system behavior under varying workloads. 
 - A proactive, analytical approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently, adapt to evolving technologies, and continuously improve testing methodologies. 

Benefits

- Fully remote work: Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection, with the flexibility to choose your preferred time zone and working hours. 
 - Flexible schedule: Organize your working day around your productivity while maintaining the required overlap with US Central Time. 
 - Professional development: Access paid training and other opportunities to expand your technical expertise and support your career growth.

data.title: Engineering Operations Lead
data.description:
Engineering Operations Lead

Location: Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) | Team: Engineering | Reporting to: CTO

OVERVIEW

APEXX is an independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform. Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem: acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation. Our routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost. We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome. 

We're backed by MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds. 

We're looking for an Engineering Operations Lead to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers. 

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working. 

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO. 

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best. 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations

- Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem: take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance. 
 - Standardise engineering workflows: establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs. 
 - Build automation and integrations: connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency. 
 - Maintain secure, reliable platforms: oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment. 
 - Drive platform adoption and improvement: troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities. 

Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office

- Strengthen delivery governance: establish consistent approaches to planning, tracking, reporting and managing delivery commitments across Product and Technology teams. 
 - Improve engineering performance visibility: develop dashboards and reporting covering DORA metrics, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability, delivery bottlenecks and defect trends. 
 - Support release readiness: coordinate visibility into outstanding defects, testing progress, dependencies, operational risks and release milestones, helping teams identify and address issues before deployment. 
 - Drive cross-functional delivery: track key initiatives, milestones, dependencies and risks across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, proactively escalating blockers and supporting resolution. 
 - Improve incident and problem management: strengthen incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis and follow-through on corrective and preventative actions. 
 - Partner with the CTO: translate technology priorities into structured initiatives, coordinate team reviews, maintain visibility into key decisions and commitments, and prepare concise executive & board reporting with storytelling at heart. 
 - Champion delivery effectiveness: identify recurring operational challenges, challenge inefficient processes and work with engineering leaders to improve predictability, accountability and execution. 

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

- Build intelligent automation: develop workflows, integrations and lightweight internal tools using APIs, scripting, automation platforms and AI-assisted development. 
 - Develop practical AI solutions: explore and implement AI agents, intelligent reporting, ticket triage, knowledge retrieval and other solutions that improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness. 
 - Improve technology knowledge management: strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing and AI-assisted search across Confluence and other internal platforms. 
 - Connect and optimise our technology stack: reduce manual administration, eliminate duplicated processes and improve the flow of information between engineering and operational systems. 
 - Champion responsible innovation: evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, appropriately governed and deliver measurable value. 

ABOUT YOU

- Strong experience in technology operations, technical delivery management, engineering operations or a similar role within a software engineering environment. 
 - Demonstrable hands-on expertise administering and improving Jira, including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, dashboards and integrations. 
 - Good understanding of Agile/Scrum/Kanban, SDLC, engineering delivery processes, release management and delivery governance. 
 - Experience coordinating technical initiatives, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks and improving accountability across engineering teams. 
 - Familiarity with engineering performance metrics, including DORA, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and delivery predictability. 
 - Practical experience with AI-assisted development, workflow automation, APIs or scripting to build solutions and improve operational efficiency. 
 - Comfortable working with Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub, Slack and modern engineering tooling. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating operational data into actionable reporting and recommendations. 
 - Confident partnering with CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders, constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements. 
 - A proactive, hands-on approach, comfortable balancing platform administration, operational delivery and longer-term improvement initiatives. 
 - Excellent communication and organisational skills, with experience working across distributed, cross-functional teams. 

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience working within a CTO Office, Engineering Operations or Technical Programme Management function. 
 - Atlassian certifications or experience with Jira Cloud, REST APIs, ScriptRunner, Forge or Rovo. 
 - Experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, n8n or similar automation tools. 
 - Experience developing AI-powered internal tools, LLM integrations or agentic workflows. 
 - Experience with engineering analytics, release governance, incident management or IT service management. 
 - Experience in a FinTech, SaaS or scale-up environment, ideally with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001. 

HOW WE HIRE

Three conversations: 

- a talent screen, 
 - a conversation with the hiring manager, and
 - a practical technology operations, delivery and automation discussion. 

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges - improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems. 

You're welcome to use AI tools where appropriate. We're interested in how you think, validate and make decisions. 

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them. 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation: that recognises your skills, experience and impact. 
 - Generous time off: annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work. 
 - Work From Anywhere: up to 90 days a year from eligible locations, subject to our policy. 
 - Comprehensive health insurance: for you and your loved ones. 
 - Personal accident insurance: for when it's needed most. 
 - Enhanced family leave: enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies. 
 - Learning & growth: opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX. 

WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers. We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2. 

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. 

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.

data.title: Software Engineer I -Data Infrastructure
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Role

The Data Infrastructure Team is a lean, high-impact group operating in a true founder mode. We are responsible for building and safeguarding all data systems, managing the lifecycle of 500+ production-grade resources across 10+ types of data stores. Our core mission is to build self-serve, automated platforms that ensure our systems are efficient, scalable, and continuously evolving. We don't just operate systems-we invent them. 

What You Will Do

We are looking for enthusiastic, innovative engineers to join our engineering team as Software Engineers (SDE-1). In this role, you'll collaborate with experienced engineers, contribute to real-world projects from day one, and gain exposure to cutting-edge tools and technologies. You'll play a key role in building and optimizing products that reach millions of users globally. you will join one of our many teams to develop robust, well-designed products, implement new updates and features, and solve complex problems that affect our business and our clients. 

- Invent, design, and build self-serve, automated platforms for managing the lifecycle of 500+ production-grade data resources across 10+ data store types. 
 - Drive innovation by engineering foundational tooling for all engineering teams, such as the Database Proxy and the database replication services. 
 - Pioneer and execute complex projects like large-scale, zero-downtime database migrations. 
 - Go deep into technical architecture, distributed systems, protocol-level debugging, and performance optimization to ensure systems are reliable, scalable, and efficient at petabyte scale. 
 - Build and maintain the core foundations for strategic initiatives, including multi-region architecture, sandbox environments, and a comprehensive, Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code platform. 
 - Focus intensely on performance, observability, cost and operability to maintain infrastructure that just works, even when handling ~100 billion queries/day and 10 PB of data transfer. 
 - Write core libraries like middlewares, ORMs, proxies, rate limiters, shard routers (in Python and Go) to support scalability and developer experience. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of projects, from initial design and planning to successful rollout and operation. 

What You Will Have

- 1-2 years experience working with fast growing, top tier product companies
 - Strong coding in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, or Go. 
 - Expert understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design principles and low level design
 - Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively in a collaborative environment
 - Understanding of system design and complex distributed systems
 - Eagerness to learn new technologies and apply them to solve real-world problems. 
 - Bonus points for open source contributions, competitive coding experience, and a strong Computer Science background from a Tier 1 institution.

data.title: Voice AI Engineer
data.description:
Voice AI Engineer (LiveKit / Pipecat)

NeuroDrift is a US-based AI voice and enterprise software company. We build real-time voice AI agents that run live on real phone lines, at scale, for enterprise contact centres. Our platform carries production call traffic every day, so latency, telephony quirks and audio edge cases are our daily reality, not a research problem. 

We are hiring an engineer who has built and run voice agents on LiveKit or Pipecat. Either framework counts. 

Who this is for

If your voice AI experience is calling a hosted API or finishing a quickstart, this is not the role. We need someone who has: 

- Built voice agents on LiveKit Agents or Pipecat and deployed them beyond a local demo

- Wired STT, LLM and TTS into a live pipeline and tuned how it behaves on real calls

What you'll do

- Build and ship voice agents end to end: audio pipeline, STT/TTS, LLM integration, tool calling

- Run and improve our self-hosted voice stack in production: media server, SIP, agent workers on Kubernetes

- Measure and reduce latency from end-of-utterance to first audio

- Tune turn-taking: endpointing, VAD, barge-in and interruption behaviour

- Debug bad calls across telephony, media and agent logs

What we need

- 1. 5+ years Python, including async (asyncio, FastAPI or similar)

- LiveKit Agents or Pipecat in a real deployment

- STT, TTS and LLM providers in a live voice pipeline

- WebRTC, SIP, RTP fundamentals

- Docker; debugging from logs and metrics

Nice to have

- Self-hosted LiveKit server on Kubernetes: config, Redis, TURN/ICE, upgrades

- SIP trunk integration: LiveKit SIP, Twilio, Telnyx or similar

- Speech vendor tuning: Deepgram, Whisper, Azure Speech, keyterm biasing, telephony-band audio

- Contact-centre integration: Genesys, Five9, NICE, SIP REFER, transfers

- Latency instrumentation and per-minute STT/TTS cost awareness

How we work

- Claude Code from day one

- Proof of concept first, then hardening on real phone calls

The setup

- Fully remote

- High intensity, 50 to 60 hours a week. Startup pace, not a 9-to-5

- Working hours primarily IST, with availability for US client meetings

- Immediate joiners

This role is for you if you have built voice agents that real people have talked to, and you want to make them faster and more human.

- Knowledge Engineering: Build and configure RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) knowledge bases and GraphDB mappings to provide agents with secure, domain-specific context. 
- Safety & Governance: Implement "Human-in-the-Loop" (HITL) escalation interfaces, confidence thresholds, and strict egress controls to prevent data exfiltration. Ensure all AI solutions comply with security, data privacy, and responsible-AI standards. 
- Optimization: Configure "Agent Overrides" and token optimization strategies (e. g. , "balanced" vs. "perfectionist" consumption) via configurable workflows. 
- End-to-End Development: Lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI systems across Data Science and AI Engineering domains. Contribute hands-on to development activities, from experimentation and prototyping to production-grade implementation. 
- Architecture & Pipelines: Architect and implement scalable AI pipelines and LLM-driven applications, including RAG, orchestration, and multi-agent systems. 
- MLOps / LLMOps: Apply MLOps and LLMOps best practices for CI/CD, observability, evaluation, and continuous improvement of AI models and pipelines. 
- Ecosystem Integration: Integrate AI services with enterprise platforms (e. g. , Confluence, Jira, GitHub, CRM, ERP) and ensure seamless interoperability. 
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional engineering, data, and product teams to align technical solutions with client and business objectives. 
- Innovation: Drive innovation through internal frameworks and accelerators. 

Commercial / Presales

- Technical Authority: Serve as the technical authority during client engagements, ensuring architecture quality, scalability, performance, and reliability. 
- Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a technical SME in presales conversations, translating business challenges into viable AI engineering solutions. 
- Strategic Planning: Partner with delivery and account teams to shape long-term client engagement strategies based on engineering excellence. 

Internal Resource Management & Team Building

- Mentorship & Standardization: Provide technical guidance to mid-level AI engineers and lead "Agent Factory" sessions to standardize decision logic and orchestration patterns. Mentor engineering peers and support knowledge sharing across teams and practices (e. g. , contributing to Ciklum's AI Academy). 
- Recruitment: Support recruitment efforts through technical assessments, interviews, and candidate evaluation. 
- Cross-Skilling: Mentor team members and contribute to cross-skilling initiatives within the AI and Engineering service lines. 
- Engineering Excellence: Uphold engineering excellence by promoting best practices, code quality, and delivery standards across projects. 

Required Skills & Experience

- AI Ecosystem: Extensive experience with Python, LangChain, and LangSmith; familiarity with the Prodigy framework is a significant advantage. 
- Agentic Intelligence: Proven track record building multi-step reasoning chains, tool-use protocols, and state management for autonomous agents. 
- Data Architecture: Practical experience with Vector Databases (ChromaDB, PGVector) and building ETL "Data Engines" for secure agent consumption via MCP. 
- Infrastructure: Understanding of containerization (Docker/K8s) and isolated runtimes such as Firecracker MicroVMs for agent sandboxing. 
- Integration: Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise identity providers like WorkOS for multi-tenancy. 
- Workflow Orchestration: Experience with Temporal for managing long-running, multi-stage agentic workflows. 

Desirable

- Domain Expertise: Familiarity with Commercial Real Estate workflows (Lease accounting, CAM reconciliation). 
- Evals Literacy: Experience building programmatic "Evaluation Harnesses" and testing against "Golden Datasets" to measure hallucination rates.

data.title: CPU Verification Infrastructure Tools Architect
data.description:
We are looking for a Hardware and Software Developer. The role is multifaceted - SoCV testbench Infrastructure, Bare-metal boot, Silicon Bringup Tools and CPU/SOC/GPU test frameworks. It involves a detailed understanding of the nVidia CPU, GPU, SOC system and boot architectures. The tools and technologies are complex and involve code that coordinates many IPs in the overall SOC. A key part of NVIDIA's strength is our development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of delivering new technology to the market. We are looking for a creative and hardworking engineer who is passionate about joining a dynamic & agile SoCV/Emulation Infrastructure and test-frameworks team. 

What You Will Be Doing

- The work includes building tools, infrastructure, and test frameworks used in RTL-simulations, c-simulations, Emulation, FPGA, and on Silicon. 
 - You will understand Tegra system architecture, with a focus on all IPs in the SOC that are involved in boot and security features. 
 - The tools that you build give Design and Verification teams the ability to access registers/memory/DMA engines and other features in their unit. The tools also enable test re-use across multiple platforms (RTL, models, Emulation, and Silicon). The gamut of tools is wide and you also develop features used for Silicon bring up (example: FUSE, ATE, Security, Flash/DMA, Board I2Cs, USB debug devices among others). We strive for the highest quality of test frameworks and tools that we deliver from this team. 
 - You would assess and build C-model or RTL-simulation capability that allows us to simulate the features before Silicon arrival in a pre-silicon environment. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Computer Science or Electronics Engineering or equivalent experience with 5+ years of experience
 - Strong programmer who is proficient with C, C++, Python. 
 - Understanding of SOC and System Architecture. 
 - Understanding of How the SOC Devices like DMA, interrupt-engines, CPU, boot-devices, MMU/IOMMU function. 
 - Operating System and Device-Driver concepts and ability to write no-OS test frameworks - i. e tests that run directly on the bare-metal SOC. 
 - A good programmer takes pride in building scalable and maintainable software. 
 - Understanding Hardware and/or Software development life cycle. 

Way To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Previous experience handling Silicon Bringup and in enabling Emulation/FPGA related test frameworks.

 - Verilog and System Verilog coding skills are a plus.

Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks. 

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails. 

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

- Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems. 
 - Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns. 
 - Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform. 

2. AI Application Development

- Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation. 
 - Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes. 
 - Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems. 
 - Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows. 
 - Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components. 

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

- Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models. 
 - Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies. 
 - Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases. 
 - Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider. 

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

- Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs. 
 - Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules. 
 - Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP. 
 - Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance. 
 - Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership. 

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

- Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs. 
 - Design human-approval workflows where required. 
 - Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability. 
 - Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models. 
 - Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements. 

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs). 
 - Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Agentic AI & Generative AI

- Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 
 - Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability. 

Programming & Application Development

- Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node. js/TypeScript. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration. 

AI Frameworks & SDKs

- Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs. 
 - Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology. 

LLM Integration

- Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs. 

Data Engineering & RAG

- Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies. 
 - Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search. 
 - Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG. 
 - Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture. 

Cloud Platforms

- Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 
 - Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools. 
 - Ollama and open-source LLMs. 
 - Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation. 
 - AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation. 
 - Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection. 
 - Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations. 
 - AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices. 
 - Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace. 
 - Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software. 
 - Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches. 

What We're Looking For

- A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions. 
 - Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking. 
 - A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions. 
 - Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills. 

Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!

 - 3+ years Public Cloud (AWS RDS) experience to instant and configure up databases for mission critical, highly available and high throughput application
 - 3+ years Expert knowledge of Linux / Unix / Windows systems
 - 5+ years' experience as a Senior DBA or Database automation Engineer; Expertise in designing/configuring mission critical, highly available and high throughput Databases

data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to manage the continuous availability and reliability of Control & Instrumentation (C&I) systems for the Ash Handling Plant (AHP) and water treatment systems through regular maintenance, system backups, and technical audits. This role involves managing business associates and ensuring adherence to budgets for optimal system performance. 

Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation Engineer AHP and Water circuit (BoP)

System Availability And Maintenance

Manage the continuous availability and reliability of Control & Instrumentation (C&I) systems related to Ash Handling Plant (AHP) and water treatment systems including analysers. 

Conduct regular maintenance activities for AHP and water treatment systems to prevent system failures and ensure optimal performance. 

Schedule and perform regular backups of PLC systems to safeguard against data loss and system downtime. 

Manage the timely calibration of weighbridges and road weighbridges to ensure accurate measurements and compliance with regulatory standards. 

Coordinate with contract manpower for on-field maintenance of AHP and water treatment systems to maintain system efficiency. 

Provide on-field support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability. 

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes. 

Budget, Inventory And Documentation Management

Provide requirements of C&I systems for AHP and water treatment systems, to ensure effective budget planning. 

Manage spares and inventory, including the development of indigenous spares for cost optimization. 

Manage documentation and as-built drawings for the section. 

Business Sustainability

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department, promoting a culture of sustainability. 

Develop the skills of Contract Supervisors and Technicians through knowledge sharing to build a competent workforce. 

Maintain the safety of personnel and equipment through rigorous training and strict adherence to safety protocols. 

Ensure the implementation of and compliance with proper work permit systems to maintain operational safety and efficiency. 

Implement filed related ZFO to eliminate human error and maintain operational excellence. 

Maintain a thorough understanding of PLC systems for AHP and water treatment systems to ensure compliance with technical specifications. 

Manage contractor safety and oversee departmental business associates to ensure a safe working environment. 

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations. 

Digitization And Automation

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency within the C&I systems domain. 

Implement automation solutions to support the overall organizational goals and strategy. 

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas to stay ahead of industry trends.

This is a senior individual-contributor role that combines real-time incident leadership with deep hands-on engineering, focused on how we detect, respond to, and prevent issues at scale across NVIDIA's AI-powered enterprise platforms. You will operate as an Incident Commander during critical events, set the technical direction for reliability engineering across multiple teams, and build the automation, observability, and AI-assisted tooling that reduce operational toil and raise reliability over time. You will also mentor and grow SRE talent as we scale the practice in India. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead major incidents end to end - driving triage, cross-team coordination, decision making, and executive communication across global time zones. 
 - Set technical direction for SRE initiatives that improve reliability, scalability, and developer efficiency across NVIDIA's enterprise systems, and drive them to adoption beyond your immediate team. 
 - Design, build, and operate distributed systems - including Kubernetes-based and cloud-native infrastructure - that power NVIDIA's AI-powered enterprise products and services. 
 - Build automation for incident detection, triage, communication, and remediation, replacing manual runbooks with self-healing systems. 
 - Improve observability and signal quality to enable earlier detection, reduce alert noise, and eliminate reliance on user-reported issues. 
 - Drive root cause analysis and translate learnings into systemic fixes, automation, and prevention mechanisms; raise the bar on post-incident review quality across the org.

 - Champion AI-assisted engineering practices, including coding agents and LLM-powered tooling, to accelerate day-to-day engineering workflows. 
 - Partner with Cloud, Platform, Security, and AI/ML teams to embed SRE best practices, define SLOs and error budgets, and influence architecture early in the design cycle. 
 - Mentor engineers, raise engineering standards through design and code review, and help build a strong reliability culture in the India organisation. 

What We Need To See

- 10+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Incident Management roles, with a track record of technical leadership at scale. 
 - BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - Proven experience acting as an Incident Commander or leading major incident response in complex, high-availability environments. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, monitoring, and reliability engineering principles - SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, and graceful degradation. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one programming language (e. g. , Python, Go, Java ) to build production-grade automation and tooling. 
 - Hands-on expertise with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Solid experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling (e. g. , Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Strong Linux/Unix and networking fundamentals, plus expertise in observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Working knowledge of relational databases (e. g. , PostgreSQL, MySQL) - SQL, indexing, and query optimisation. 
 - Experience or familiarity with AI/ML concepts (e. g. , LLMs, anomaly detection, or data-driven operations) applied to operational workflows. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief executives during high-pressure incidents and influence senior technical stakeholders. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Building & applying AI to operations: Hands-on experience building incident management or automation platforms (ChatOps, workflow orchestration, alert intelligence) and applying AI to operations - intelligent triage, RCA generation, and signal correlation - with a demonstrable track record of reducing MTTD and MTTR, backed by numbers. 
 - Scaling reliability across distributed teams: Proven ability to balance real-time incident leadership with scalable, long-term reliability solutions, including scaling a follow-the-sun model and operating AI/ML training and inference infrastructure at scale across multi-region teams. 
 - Ownership & community impact: A strong sense of ownership, curiosity, and initiative - turning challenges into durable engineering solutions and diving into unfamiliar systems - along with contributions to open-source infrastructure/observability projects, conference talks, or active participation in the wider SRE community.

data.description:
Role Title: AVP - Cloud Database Automation Engineer

Company Overview

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

Our Platform Engineering organization comprises of Database experts and automation engineers who focus on enabling strategies to enhance customer and partner experience and optimize business performance through database platform development and management cutting edge automation technologies such as Terraform, Jenkins and Ansible. 

Role Summary/Purpose

Cloud Database Automation Engineer role will be responsible for projects to design, enhance or add new functionality to Synchrony Data platforms (Databases), as well as all operational support activities. Provide technical oversight, architecture, design expertise and guidance, interdepartmental coordination, and vendor direction for Synchrony Database Engineering and automation efforts. 

Key Responsibilities

- Implement infrastructure as code for various database platforms
 - Perform Software Configuration Management (SCM) for databases
 - Implement automation of database operations and migration
 - Implement monitoring and logging solutions for different database technology stacks or container orchestration platforms
 - Have general cloud ops knowledge with at least one provider, private or public, such as attached volume lifecycle, auto scaling, cloud-config, security, instance lifecycle, etc
 - Implement Database automation in AWS from build to day-to-day support. 

Required Skills & Knowledge

- Experience working on or leading teams performing systems automation and integration (ideally leveraging an agile methodology / lean techniques)
 - Competence in using scripting + programming languages to automate frequently executed activities
 - 3+ years Public Cloud (AWS RDS) experience to instant and configure up databases for mission critical, highly available and high throughput application
 - 3+ years Expert knowledge of Linux / Unix / Windows systems
 - 5+ years' experience as a Senior DBA or Database automation Engineer; Expertise in designing/configuring mission critical, highly available and high throughput Databases
 - Experience with production systems and dealing with production issues
 - A clear understanding of cloud service and deployment model

Desired Skills & Knowledge

- Database experience with RDS, PostgreSQL, Cassandra. MySQL, Oracle, DynamoDB or DocumentDB
 - Experience in streaming service such as Kinesis
 - Scripting Proficiency in Terraform, Python and Shell
 - Experience in migrating Database from on-prem to public cloud
 - Responsible for architecting, implementing, and maintaining automation tools to reduce time and complexity of operations and development tasks
 - Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve escalated production issues
 - Establish and consult on best practices and standard operating procedures for development, deployment, support, break-fix, and systems management
 - Deploy and support automation systems and tooling in a 24x7 production environment
 - Assess usage and utilization trends to make appropriate design and implementation recommendations towards scaling our architecture 
 - AWS Cloud certification, Terraform certification

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 8+ years of experience performing systems automation (ideally leveraging an agile methodology) on Database platforms. Deep expertise in at least one database technology. 

Work Timings

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details. We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs - Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. As directed by the management, you will be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in-person engagement activities such as business/ team meetings, trainings, and events

For Internal Applicants

- Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
 - Inform your manager or HRM before applying for the role on Workday

 - Must not be any corrective action plan (Formal/Final Formal) or LPP
 - L4 to L7 Employees who have completed 12 months in the organization and 12 months in their current role and level are eligible
 - L8+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in their current role and level are eligible.

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to manage the operational integrity and reliability of control and instrumentation systems of a Turbine. This role involves on-field execution of maintenance activities, scheduling and executing precise calibrations, providing technical support and ensuring that all equipment is meticulously monitored and maintained according to established checklists. The lead is pivotal in maintaining the continuous, efficient operation of turbine systems through proactive management and hands-on technical expertise. 

Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation (Turbine)

Operational Excellence And Equipment Reliability

Monitor the availability and functionality of all Control & Instrumentation (C&I) systems related to Turbine including UPS, DCS, SWAS, CPU systems, Governing system, ETS, HPLP Bypass, Turbine, and Auxiliaries. 

Conduct routine maintenance tasks for SWAS, Motor Operated Valves (MOV), Turbine, and Auxiliaries to prevent operational disruptions. 

Execute timely overhauls of units to maintain optimal performance and reduce downtime. 

Troubleshoot and resolve equipment breakdowns promptly to ensure continuous operations. 

Conduct scheduled calibrations of instrumentation and generate detailed reports on findings and adjustments. 

Allocate necessary resources and guidance to contractor technicians for the execution of routine maintenance tasks. 

Provide on-field support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability. 

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes. 

Technical And Process Improvement

Perform periodic backups of DCS, PLC, PSI, and other turbine and auxiliary systems to safeguard operational data. 

Provide technical expertise and resources to contractor technicians for routine maintenance and system upgrades. 

Follow equipment checklists meticulously to maintain high standards of operation and maintenance. 

Inventory Management And Documentation

Manage the procurement process for equipment and services, ensuring adherence to financial guidelines.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
data.description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. 

NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team's transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. 
 - Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. 
 - Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done. 
 - Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model. 
 - Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes. 

What We Need To See

- Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks. 
 - Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track. 
 - 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering. 
 - High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team's traditional capacity. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes. 
 - Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland. 
 - Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL. 
 - Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software. 

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you.

data.title: Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
data.description:
Description

Amazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid - accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real-time platforms: a high-throughput, event-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code - you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics - real-time and event-driven - of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially. 

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system. 

Key job responsibilities

- Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation. 

Write high-quality, well-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews. 

- Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade-offs clearly. 

Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation. 

- Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time. 

Contribute to system-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews - propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures. 

Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits. 

- Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs. 

Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth - without being asked. 

Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity. 

A day in the life

You start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system - incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services - tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup. 

About The Team

We are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time - globally, across all business lines and geographies. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
 - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
 - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
 - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: Sr Software Engineer
data.description:
Senior Software Engineer
Engineering • Bangalore, India (Hybrid) • Full-Time
Mission-Critical Core Banking Platform • Cloud-Native • Low-Latency Transaction Processing
About the Role

ACI Worldwide is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building and operating a mission-critical, low-latency core banking platform. Our product is architected cloud-natively and containerized from the ground up, deployed initially on Microsoft Azure / AKS with a clear roadmap to Red Hat OpenShift, AWS, and Google Cloud Infrastructure (GCI). Every design decision - from threading models to deployment topology - is made with high throughput, sub-millisecond latency, and five-nines availability in mind. 

This is a full-stack engineering role in the deepest sense: you will design and build features end to end, own the reliability and performance of what you ship, actively contribute to the CI/CD pipeline and quality strategy, and provide L3 production support when the platform counts on it. We are also on an active modernization journey, migrating mission-critical COBOL logic to modern Java services, and your ability to read, understand, and translate legacy COBOL will be highly valued. 

We are looking for self-motivated, driven engineers who take pride in craftsmanship, embrace AI as an accelerator across the full development lifecycle, and are genuinely excited to grow their careers at ACI Worldwide. 
Location & Work Model

Location: Bangalore , India
Work Model: Hybrid - on-site on designated days; remote-eligible on other days per team and business needs
Key Responsibilities

1) Low-Latency Application Engineering
- Design, implement, and optimize high-performance Java services for real-time transaction processing: payments, authorization, clearing, and settlement workflows where latency and correctness are non-negotiable. 

- Apply deep JVM knowledge - threading models, garbage collection tuning, lock-free data structures, and async I/O - to sustain predictable throughput under peak load. 

- Define and enforce performance budgets: author benchmarks, regression tests, and latency SLOs; profile and root-cause regressions before they reach production. 

- Build against modern cloud-native patterns: microservices, event-driven messaging (NATS), reactive pipelines, and 12-factor application design. 

2) Cloud-Native & Container-First Development
- Write software that is container-native from day one: images must be lean, stateless where possible, and fully operable on Kubernetes (AKS, OpenShift, EKS, GKE). 

- Collaborate with the DevOps/Platform team on Kubernetes manifests, Helm/Carvel packaging, resource requests/limits, health probes, and rolling deployment strategies. 

- Understand and contribute to GitOps workflows; ensure application configuration is version-controlled, auditable, and environment-agnostic. 

- Design for multi-cloud portability from the start: avoid cloud-vendor lock-in in application code and dependency choices. 

3) AI-Augmented Development Lifecycle
- Leverage AI tools actively across the SDLC: AI-assisted code generation and review, test case synthesis, documentation drafting, defect analysis, and performance diagnostics. 

- Apply responsible AI practices: validate all AI-generated output for correctness, security, and maintainability before merging; never place secrets, PII, or PCI data into AI prompts. 

- Contribute to team-level AI adoption: share effective patterns, prompt strategies, and tooling discoveries that raise the velocity and quality bar for the whole team. 

- Stay current with AI/ML advancements relevant to banking - intelligent anomaly detection, automated triage, fraud signal enrichment - and propose production-ready applications. 

4) Quality Engineering & Test Automation
- Own quality for what you ship: write comprehensive unit, integration, and contract tests; enforce non-negotiable coverage thresholds and quality gates in CI. 

- Author and maintain end-to-end test scenarios for transaction processing flows; partner with Quality Engineering to integrate Testkube-orchestrated test suites into the pipeline. 

- Practice shift-left quality: treat a bug escaping to staging as a process failure, not an expected outcome. 

- Participate in code reviews with a quality lens: correctness, edge cases, error handling, observability hooks, and long-term maintainability. 

5) Security & Compliance
- Write secure-by-design code in regulated financial environments: input validation, output encoding, least-privilege service identities, and safe secret consumption via ESO/vault integrations. 

- Ensure compliance controls are built into the code - not bolted on afterward: PCI-DSS, SOC2, and audit logging requirements are first-class acceptance criteria. 

- Participate in threat modeling sessions, security code reviews, and SAST/DAST remediation cycles; treat security findings with the same urgency as production incidents. 

6) DevOps Collaboration & Engineering Excellence
- Engage actively with the DevOps/Platform team: contribute to pipeline definitions, own your service's observability (structured logs, metrics, distributed traces), and participate in on-call rotations. 

- Write and maintain runbooks, deployment guides, and architecture decision records (ADRs); documentation is a deliverable, not an afterthought. 

- Champion engineering best practices: clean code, SOLID principles, API contract discipline, backward compatibility, and disciplined release management. 

7) COBOL Modernization Support
- Read and interpret existing COBOL programs to extract business logic, data flow, and processing rules that must be faithfully reimplemented in modern Java services. 

- Collaborate with domain experts and architects to validate that modernized Java implementations are behaviorally equivalent to legacy COBOL counterparts under all documented business scenarios. 

- Document COBOL-to-Java translation decisions, edge cases, and business rule interpretations to build institutional knowledge for the long-term migration program. 

8) L3 Production Support
- Serve as the third line of escalation for production issues on services you own: diagnose complex failures using logs, metrics, traces, and thread/heap dumps. 

- Deliver timely, accurate root-cause analyses and post-incident reviews; implement durable fixes and preventive controls to eliminate recurrence. 

- Maintain a "you build it, you run it" mindset: production reliability is a shared engineering accountability, not a handoff. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience; substantial time building production systems that handle high-volume, low-latency workloads. 

- Java - expert-level proficiency: JVM internals, concurrency, performance tuning, Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem, and modern Java (17+) features. 

- Low-latency systems - demonstrated experience designing and optimizing transaction processing, payments, or equivalent high-throughput distributed systems. 

- Microservices & APIs - RESTful and event-driven service design; experience with API versioning, backward compatibility, and contract testing. 

- Containers & Kubernetes - hands-on experience containerizing Java applications and running them on Kubernetes (AKS, EKS, GKE, or OpenShift). 

- Cloud platforms - Azure (primary); working familiarity with AWS or GCI a strong plus. 

- CI/CD & DevOps - experience with Jenkins, Gradle, container image builds, and automated quality gates; comfortable contributing to pipeline definitions. 

- Test automation - strong unit, integration, and e2e testing discipline; experience with JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, or equivalent. 

- Security - secure coding practices in regulated environments; familiarity with OWASP Top 10, input validation, and secrets management. 

- Observability - structured logging, metrics (Micrometer/Prometheus), and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry or equivalent). 

- Databases - PostgreSQL (or equivalent relational DB) in production; familiarity with schema migration, query optimization, and connection pooling. 

- AI-assisted development - active use of AI coding tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) with disciplined validation practices. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Banking or payments domain experience: core banking, payment processing, ACH, SWIFT, card authorization, or clearing & settlement. Understanding of 8583 , 20022 specs and implementations based on it

- Drools / rule engine experience: authoring and maintaining business rules in Drools (KIE) or a comparable BRMS; ideally applied to transaction routing, risk, or eligibility logic. 

- NATS messaging: operational experience building event-driven services on NATS or equivalent (Kafka, Pulsar, RabbitMQ). 

- Multi-cloud portability: experience deploying identical workloads across two or more of Azure, OpenShift, AWS, and GCI. 

- COBOL literacy - ability to read and interpret COBOL programs sufficiently to extract and translate business logic into Java. 

- Carvel toolchain: familiarity with ytt, kapp-controller, or imgpkg for Kubernetes-native packaging and GitOps. 

- Regulated environment experience: PCI-DSS, SOC2, GDPR, or equivalent compliance frameworks embedded in engineering practices. 

- AI/ML feature delivery: experience shipping AI or ML capabilities as part of a production product (anomaly detection, intelligent routing, fraud signals, etc. ). 

- Technical mentorship: demonstrated experience upleveling junior engineers through code review, pair programming, or structured coaching. 

What We Offer

- Technically challenging work on a platform that processes mission-critical banking transactions for global financial institutions. 

- A cloud-native, automation-first engineering culture that invests in quality, security, and developer experience as competitive advantages. 

- Real career growth: ACI actively develops engineers into senior technical leaders and engineering managers; your trajectory here is yours to define. 

- An AI-forward team that embraces modern tooling and gives engineers the latitude to experiment, improve, and lead. 

- Competitive compensation and benefits package; hybrid flexibility

ACI Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

The two hardest, highest-leverage problems in this seat: 

- Own end-to-end system validation of NVIDIA GPU, SoC, and platform programs - feature checks, PVT stress, system-stress campaigns at scale, and multi-unit fleet testing. 
 - Lead debug of the hardest cross-stack issues - logic, signal integrity, power delivery, firmware, and software interaction - and drive them to root cause with reusable workarounds and productized fixes. 
 - Develop test plans, scripts, and automation for next-generation chips ahead of physical builds, translating architecture, boot flows, high-speed I/O, and power and thermal dependencies into executable coverage. 
 - Design and deploy AI-enabled debug and validation workflows used by the team - with explicit guardrails (evals, regression validation, false-positive handling) and measurable impact on cycle time, debug velocity, or escape rate. 
 - Translate complex silicon and system risk into decision-ready options for technical and executive audiences - without padding or hand-waving. 
 - Partner with globally distributed teams across silicon design, DFT, firmware, software, manufacturing, and platform engineering - including counterpart engineers in India and other major hubs. 
 - Lead crisis-mode debug task forces when a program is stuck, and convert the learnings into reusable methodology for adjacent programs. 
 - Find critical silicon and platform issues before they reach the customer - by shifting validation coverage left with system stress, PVT, and feature-interaction tests that catch escapes before software hardens. Your work shows up in DPPM, escape rate, and ramp confidence. 
 - Build AI-enabled validation as a real capability, not a demo - by deploying debug, triage, root-cause hypothesis generation, and regression workflows with the evals and guardrails that make them trustworthy enough to gate production decisions. 

What We Need To See

- BTech/BE or MTech/ME in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (or equivalent experience), and 6+ years of post-silicon validation, system integration, or platform debug experience on shipped GPU, CPU, or SoC products. 
 - Hands-on debug depth across silicon, board, and software boundaries - logic design, signal integrity, power delivery, high-speed I/O, and PVT behavior - with strong EE fundamentals across SI/PI, power delivery, and thermal, and a working understanding of GPU, CPU, or SoC architecture across PC, Datacenter, or Automotive. 
 - At least one specific example of taking an ambiguous, multi-team failure to root-cause closure with a productized fix, and a track record of leading a project team end-to-end through a real crisis with decision points you owned. 
 - Demonstrated AI-driven validation workflow you built or scaled, not just used - with adoption beyond yourself and measurable impact on debug velocity, coverage, or escape rate. You can describe the guardrails you put in place and where AI is dangerous in your workflow. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- A history of building reusable validation methodology, debug playbooks, or test frameworks that were adopted by other programs or teams - backed by patents, conference papers, invited talks, or recognized contributions. 
 - Hands-on subsystem depth in HBM, SerDes or high-speed I/O, power and thermal, or advanced packaging - failure modes, debug instrumentation, and the tradeoffs that show up in production. 
 - Experience partnering deeply with a counterpart team in India or another major engineering hub - examples of shared culture, shared metrics, and shared on-call across geographies. 
 - AI work that goes beyond personal-copilot use - agentic workflows, RAG-grounded debug assistants, regression bucketing, or automated triage deployed at team scope with adoption metrics. 

NVIDIA is the world leader in accelerated computing, and our work powers AI, gaming, robotics, autonomous systems, and scientific discovery. We invest in our people with competitive benefits, flexible time off, and continuous learning, and we build a team where everyone can do their best work. Come help us build chips that change what is possible!
