data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

About the Role: 

As an SoC Chip Lead, you will lead SoC execution from spec to silicon across domains. You will be responsible to drive technical strategy and execution for complex SoCs and digital systems, drive product and technology roadmaps, architecture for mission-critical projects and serve as a technical authority within the organization. This position requires exceptional expertise across multiple domains and the ability to influence business direction while delivering on the product actualization. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Technical Strategy & Architecture

- Drive Product Strategy: Define long-term product and technology roadmaps for complex SoCs and systems. 
 - Select IP & Nodes: Lead technical IP assessments, vendor selection, and foundry technology node evaluations. 
 - Define Architecture: Author and drive top-level SoC definitions alongside business and architecture teams, including fabric interconnects (NoC), memory hierarchies, power management, and micro-architecture. 

Silicon Execution & Sign-off

- Own the Lifecycle: Lead SoC execution from initial concept through definition, tape-out, and final productization. 
 - Optimize PPA: Ensure all silicon milestones meet strict Power, Performance, Area, and Cost (PPA) requirements. 
 - Govern Silicon Sign-off: Drive final sign-off reviews for synthesis, DFT, constraints, timing closure, and physical design tape-out. 

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

data.description:
We are growing the team at Qubist Solutions!

Are you a highly experienced Verification & Validation leader looking for your next challenge? We are expanding our embedded software team and seeking a Senior Verification & Validation (V&V) Engineer to drive activities for safety-critical aerospace and UAS applications. 

Location: Bangalore

Experience: Senior (7+ Years)

What you will be doing: 

- Leading and executing V&V activities in strict compliance with DO-178C, DO-254, DO-160, and MIL-STD standards. 
 - Performing requirements-based testing, structural coverage analysis (including MC/DC), and executing HIL/SIL testing. 
 - Supporting DER (Designated Engineering Representative) reviews and contributing directly to SAS and PSAC documentation. 
 - Developing automated test scripts in C, C++, or Python, and managing HIL simulation setups. 
 - Mentoring junior V&V engineers and providing technical input from the requirements phase right through to certification. 

What you bring to the table: 

- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 7+ years of embedded software V&V experience, including a minimum of 5 years specifically in aerospace, UAS, or other safety-critical domains. 
 - Proven, demonstrated experience working on DAL A, B, or C software certification projects. 
 - Deep proficiency with V&V tools (like RTRT), requirements management (DOORS, Polarion, Jama), and defect tracking systems (JIRA). 
 - A strong understanding of RTOS environments and communication protocols such as ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, and CAN. 

Why join us?

You will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge aerospace and UAS programmes, gain exposure to the full software certification lifecycle, and enjoy flexible working arrangements within a collaborative, technically challenging environment. 

If you have a meticulous eye for test design and a passion for diagnosing complex software failures, I would love to chat. 

Please send me a direct email to communications@qubistsolutions. com or apply below!

data.title: Founder's Office (Engineering)
data.description:
OnArrival | Bengaluru | Full-time | Work directly with the CTO & Co-founder

About OnArrival

At OnArrival, we're building the technology infrastructure that powers the next generation of travel experiences. 

Our platform enables fintechs, banks, consumer brands, and digital businesses to seamlessly embed travel into their products through APIs, SDKs, and intelligent infrastructure. 

We're building towards a future where travel is embedded everywhere, increasingly autonomous, and powered by AI. 

About the Role

We're looking for an exceptionally resourceful, technically strong, and hands-on individual to join our Founder's Office - Engineering. 

Think of this role as being the CTO's technical right hand. 

You'll work closely with the CTO across engineering initiatives, new product ideas, architecture, AI experimentation, internal tooling, and strategic technical projects. 

You'll also act as a trusted liaison between the CTO and engineering teams, product stakeholders, technology partners, and external collaborators. 

But here's the important part: This is a hands-on engineering role, not a project management or coordination role. 

We want someone who can write code, build prototypes, investigate problems, understand complex systems, challenge technical decisions, and independently take projects from an idea to a working solution. 

One day you could be building an AI agent. The next, exploring a new backend architecture, debugging an integration, or representing the CTO in a technical discussion. 

You'll be involved in both the thinking and the doing. 

What You'll Do

1. Build, Code & Experiment

* Write production-quality code and build working prototypes. 

* Personally own and deliver engineering projects from concept to deployment. 

* Build internal tools, developer utilities, automations, and AI-powered workflows. 

* Experiment with LLMs, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and emerging technologies. 

* Work across APIs, backend systems, integrations, SDKs, and occasionally frontend applications. 

* Debug complex technical problems, investigate issues, and propose practical solutions. 

* Use modern AI coding tools to accelerate development and experimentation. 

2. Work Directly with the CTO

* Be deeply involved in the CTO's ongoing technical initiatives and special projects. 

* Translate early-stage ideas and loosely defined problems into working solutions. 

* Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making. 

* Research new tools, frameworks, and technologies, and make informed recommendations. 

* Understand the broader engineering vision and help translate it into tangible outcomes. 

* Take ownership of initiatives without requiring constant direction or follow-ups. 

3. Act as a Technical Liaison

* Represent the CTO in selected engineering discussions, technical reviews, and partner conversations. 

* Work closely with engineering leads, product teams, and external stakeholders. 

* Bridge communication between the CTO and various engineering initiatives. 

* Understand technical blockers, dependencies, and implementation challenges. 

* Ensure important technical decisions translate into actual engineering progress. 

* Coordinate execution when needed, while remaining actively involved in the technical work. 

4. Drive Special Engineering Projects

* Take on experimental or high-impact initiatives that don't naturally belong to an existing engineering team. 

* Build proof-of-concepts to validate new product ideas and technical approaches. 

* Explore platform improvements, architectural changes, performance optimization, and developer productivity. 

* Collaborate with different engineering pods to move initiatives forward. 

* Help evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and third-party technologies. 

* Take promising prototypes through technical validation and handover or production deployment. 

5. Explore What's Next

* Stay ahead of developments in AI engineering, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, and software architecture. 

* Experiment with emerging technologies before they become mainstream. 

* Identify opportunities to simplify systems, automate work, and improve engineering velocity. 

* Bring fresh ideas to the CTO, backed by actual experimentation rather than presentations alone. 

* Help shape how OnArrival uses AI internally and builds AI-native travel experiences. 

What We're Looking For

Technical Skills

* 3-5 years of hands-on software engineering experience. 

* Strong programming ability in at least one modern backend or full-stack language, such as Kotlin, Java, TypeScript, Python, or Go. 

* Solid understanding of APIs, distributed systems, databases, and modern backend architectures. 

* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

* Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, debugging, deployment, and engineering workflows. 

* Familiarity with LLMs, AI development tools, and modern AI-assisted software engineering. 

* Ability to independently build, test, deploy, and demonstrate working solutions. 

* Broad technical curiosity and the ability to learn unfamiliar stacks quickly. 

Beyond Engineering

* Exceptional ownership: You don't wait to be told every step. You figure things out and get them done. 

* Strong communication: You can explain complex technical ideas clearly to engineers, business stakeholders, and external partners. 

* High agency: You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying opportunities, and making progress independently. 

* Structured thinking: You can break complex, loosely defined problems into manageable solutions. 

* Confidence: You're comfortable challenging assumptions, asking difficult questions, and engaging with senior technical stakeholders. 

* Resourcefulness: You know when to build, when to automate, when to use AI, and when an existing tool is sufficient. 

* Discretion and reliability: You can be trusted with sensitive technical discussions, strategic initiatives, and responsibilities. 

Bonus Points If You

* Have worked in an early-stage or rapidly scaling technology startup. 

* Have been a founding engineer or independently built and launched products. 

* Have experience with AI agents, MCP, developer tooling, or LLM-powered applications. 

* Understand travel technology, fintech, APIs, or embedded platforms. 

* Have worked closely with founders, CTOs, or senior engineering leaders. 

* Enjoy hackathons, side projects, open-source contributions, and experimentation. 

* Are comfortable interacting with partners, vendors, and developer communities. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 3-6 months, we expect you to: 

* Independently ship meaningful engineering projects and working prototypes. 

* Develop a strong understanding of OnArrival's technology stack and engineering priorities. 

* Become a trusted technical extension of the CTO. 

* Take ownership of special projects with minimal supervision. 

* Build strong working relationships with engineering leads and product teams. 

* Help accelerate technical decisions, experimentation, and execution. 

* Free up the CTO's bandwidth without introducing unnecessary coordination overhead. 

What This Role Is Not

* Not an executive assistant. 

* Not a traditional project manager or scrum master. 

* Not a role focused primarily on tracking tasks, preparing reports, or scheduling meetings. 

* Not a strategy-only position where engineering is delegated to other teams. 

* Not a role where you'll spend all your time in meetings. 

You'll be expected to write code, solve technical problems, and ship actual software. 

Why Join?

* Direct founder exposure: Work alongside the CTO on some of the company's most important technology initiatives. 

* Real engineering ownership: Build, experiment, architect, and ship without unnecessary layers. 

* Technical breadth: Work across AI, APIs, SDKs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and developer platforms. 

* Freedom to experiment: Explore new technologies and turn ideas into working products. 

* High-impact work: Your contributions can directly influence OnArrival's architecture, engineering productivity, and future products. 

* Accelerated growth: Develop the technical, product, and leadership judgment required to become an exceptional engineering leader. 

The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here

- You're probably the person who builds things over the weekend because you're curious. 
 - You enjoy coding, but you're equally interested in understanding why something should be built. 
 - You can jump from a technical architecture discussion to writing an API, then explain the solution to a stakeholder without losing context. 
 - You don't need perfectly written requirements to get started. You ask the right questions, make sensible assumptions, and build something. 
 - You like being close to decisions, taking responsibility, and making things happen. 

If you're someone who loves engineering, enjoys working with founders, and wants to be involved in building what's next, this role is for you. 

Join us in building the infrastructure for the future of travel.

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World's Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth. 

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we're looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.   

Join our team! We're building a world where Identity belongs to you. 

  

About Okta's Enterprise Access Team

  

Okta is The World's Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology-anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth. 

  

The Enterprise Access team drives billions of authentications every month. The team builds and supports single sign-on, strong authentication, provisioning, and threat protection technologies. Our Enterprise Access service runs in the cloud on a secure, reliable, extensively audited platform with 99. 99% availability. 

  

About the role

  

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the SIW Platform team. Operating under the larger Enterprise Access pillar, the SIW Platform team owns Okta's secure web experiences for end-user authentication and access. We build the Okta Sign-In Widget (SIW) -a highly secure, open-source login platform designed to be easily customized and extended both by our internal feature teams and by external customers. 

  

What you'll be doing

 - Ensure the team maintains a high bar for quality, security, and operational excellence through effective processes, mentorship, and a focus on testing and automation.

 - Knowledge of IAM protocols (e. g. , OAuth, OIDC, SAML) and identity management concepts is a strong plus. 
 - Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and secure coding practice is a strong plus
 - Prior experience as a Tech Lead or in an architecture-focused role is highly desirable. Education and Training:

 - 10+ years of software development experience, with at least 5 years of experience designing and building enterprise grade software

Okta's Top 5 Core Leadership Competencies

data.description:
Role Title: AVP - Cloud Database Automation Engineer

Company Overview

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

Our Platform Engineering organization comprises of Database experts and automation engineers who focus on enabling strategies to enhance customer and partner experience and optimize business performance through database platform development and management cutting edge automation technologies such as Terraform, Jenkins and Ansible. 

Role Summary/Purpose

Cloud Database Automation Engineer role will be responsible for projects to design, enhance or add new functionality to Synchrony Data platforms (Databases), as well as all operational support activities. Provide technical oversight, architecture, design expertise and guidance, interdepartmental coordination, and vendor direction for Synchrony Database Engineering and automation efforts. 

Key Responsibilities

- Implement infrastructure as code for various database platforms
 - Perform Software Configuration Management (SCM) for databases
 - Implement automation of database operations and migration
 - Implement monitoring and logging solutions for different database technology stacks or container orchestration platforms
 - Have general cloud ops knowledge with at least one provider, private or public, such as attached volume lifecycle, auto scaling, cloud-config, security, instance lifecycle, etc
 - Implement Database automation in AWS from build to day-to-day support. 

Required Skills & Knowledge

- Experience working on or leading teams performing systems automation and integration (ideally leveraging an agile methodology / lean techniques)
 - Competence in using scripting + programming languages to automate frequently executed activities
 - 3+ years Public Cloud (AWS RDS) experience to instant and configure up databases for mission critical, highly available and high throughput application
 - 3+ years Expert knowledge of Linux / Unix / Windows systems
 - 5+ years' experience as a Senior DBA or Database automation Engineer; Expertise in designing/configuring mission critical, highly available and high throughput Databases
 - Experience with production systems and dealing with production issues
 - A clear understanding of cloud service and deployment model

Desired Skills & Knowledge

- Database experience with RDS, PostgreSQL, Cassandra. MySQL, Oracle, DynamoDB or DocumentDB
 - Experience in streaming service such as Kinesis
 - Scripting Proficiency in Terraform, Python and Shell
 - Experience in migrating Database from on-prem to public cloud
 - Responsible for architecting, implementing, and maintaining automation tools to reduce time and complexity of operations and development tasks
 - Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve escalated production issues
 - Establish and consult on best practices and standard operating procedures for development, deployment, support, break-fix, and systems management
 - Deploy and support automation systems and tooling in a 24x7 production environment
 - Assess usage and utilization trends to make appropriate design and implementation recommendations towards scaling our architecture 
 - AWS Cloud certification, Terraform certification

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 8+ years of experience performing systems automation (ideally leveraging an agile methodology) on Database platforms. Deep expertise in at least one database technology. 

Work Timings

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details. We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs - Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. data.description:
Company Description

Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You'll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way. 

We are looking for a Platform Architect for our production team. The role involves: 

Platform Architecture & Strategy

- Lead the architectural design of Vialto's unified enterprise product platform supporting multiple product lines (B2B and B2C). 
 - Define platform capabilities, service boundaries, and technical patterns and principles. 
 - Develop frameworks and reusable components to accelerate product development across teams. 
 - Establish architectural standards for microservices, API design, event-driven communication, workflow orchestration, and data integration. 

Transformation & Migration

- Assess existing tools, systems, and products to define a migration roadmap into the enterprise platform. 
 - Identify opportunities to modernize legacy components, consolidate redundant functionality, and align services to the new platform vision. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to guide phased migration, ensuring minimal disruption and technical consistency. 

Cloud & Technical Architecture

- Architect scalable, secure, cloud-native solutions in Microsoft Azure using services such as: 
 - Azure API Management 
 - App Services / Functions 
 - Event Grid / Service Bus 
 - Azure SQL MI / Cosmos DB 
 - AKS (preferred) 
 - Azure DevOps / GitHub 
 - Drive adoption of best practices in microservices, distributed systems, observability, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Establish standards for performance, resiliency, multi-tenancy, and security posture. 

AI, Automation & Experience Layer

- Partner with teams to define platform-level capabilities using: 
 - Azure OpenAI 
 - Agentic AI with Microsoft Agent Framework 
 - Model Context Protocol (MCP) 
 - AI-augmented capabilities for enabling product team to build features for client-facing and operational tools 
 - Collaborate on the architecture of user experience layers built in Next. js and React. 
 - Enable intelligent services and automation to enhance global mobility operations and client outcomes. 

Patterns We Expect You to Use

- Event-based systems (pub/sub, workflow orchestration, event sourcing where appropriate) 
 - Distributed systems (partitioning, resiliency, failure-mode design, consistency tradeoffs) 
 - Domain-driven integration approaches (bounded contexts, contracts, anti-corruption layers) 
 - Agentic AI patterns including plan/execute/verify loops, tool/function calling, RAG, verifier/critic steps, guardrails, evaluation, and agent observability/auditability. Experience applying these patterns to automate business process flows using Azure OpenAI APIs and orchestration frameworks. 

Collaboration & Leadership

- Act as a trusted architectural advisor to product engineering teams and business stakeholders. 
 - Advocate for platform thinking, technical quality, and long-term sustainability. 
 - Conduct architectural reviews, provide guidance, and mentor engineers across teams. 
 - Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance for technical and non-technical audiences. 

Qualifications

Required

- 10+ years of experience designing and delivering cloud-based enterprise systems. 
 - Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, microservices architecture, distributed systems, and DevOps practices. 
 - Proficiency with C# / . NET Core, API development, and cloud-native patterns. 
 - Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next. js, and front-end platform integration concepts. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing platform architectures that support multiple products. 
 - Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, conversational agents, or generative AI integration. 
 - Strong grounding in integration patterns, and system interoperability. 
 - Excellent communication, influencing, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred

- Prior work in B2B and B2C product ecosystems or professional services platforms. 
 - Knowledge of data privacy, compliance, and regulatory constraints for global services. 
 - Background in enterprise transformation or modernization programs. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree required
 - Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field preferred

Additional Information

- This job is based in our Bangalore office, with the possibility of a hybrid work mode
 - We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status

Job Description

Do you want to develop enterprise applications that support critical business operations for a global manufacturing organization?

As a Dynamics AX Developer at Husky Technologies, you'll work hands-on across our Microsoft Dynamics AX platform and supporting enterprise applications, developing and enhancing solutions that help enable reliable and efficient business operations across our global organization. 

You'll be responsible for delivering high-quality software solutions using Microsoft Dynamics AX, X++, SQL Server, . NET, and related technologies, while supporting the ongoing evolution, stability, and maintainability of our business-critical systems. 

This role is ideal for an experienced developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, working with enterprise systems, and delivering reliable software solutions, while contributing to a globally distributed development team. 

If you want your work to have visible business impact across a global manufacturing organization, Husky offers the opportunity to contribute to enterprise applications that support our day-to-day operations. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Design, develop, customize, and maintain Microsoft Dynamics AX applications and supporting enterprise solutions. 
 - Understand and implement solutions based on approved requirements and technical designs. 
 - Own assigned implementations at the component, module, and feature levels. 
 - Ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability of delivered solutions. 
 - Make sound technical decisions within the assigned scope, escalating broader design concerns when necessary. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate approved business requirements and technical specifications into working software solutions. 
 - Break down assigned features and development activities into actionable tasks. 
 - Provide reliable effort estimates for assigned backlog items. 
 - Deliver high-quality software increments aligned with agreed priorities and sprint goals. 
 - Proactively identify and resolve technical issues within assigned scope. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write code that is reliable, readable, and maintainable, and follow the team's agreed standards and best practices. 
 - Develop and maintain appropriate technical documentation. 
 - Participate in meaningful peer code reviews. 
 - Ensure adherence to agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) criteria. 
 - Identify and address technical debt within assigned components and modules. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement in code quality, development productivity, and engineering practices. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects and production issues. 
 - Investigate recurring issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes. 
 - Ensure adequate logging and observability in implemented components. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

- Collaborate closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, QA, and Platform teams. 
 - Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement within the team. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - 5+ years of professional experience in software development. 
 - Strong hands-on experience developing, customizing, and maintaining Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 R3 applications using X++, MorphX, and Application Object Tree (AOT). 
 - Experience with SQL Server databases, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), and SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS). 
 - Experience with Dynamics AX integration technologies, including Application Integration Framework (AIF), Data Import and Export Framework (DIXF), WCF, and SOAP/XML web services. 
 - Experience with . NET interoperability and C# for integration with other enterprise applications. 
 - Experience using Team Foundation Server (TFS) and/or Azure DevOps for work management, source control, and deployment activities. 
 - Experience in requirements analysis, technical specifications, and effort estimation. 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices. 
 - Experience with clean code principles, unit testing, and code reviews, with familiarity with test-driven development practices. 
 - Familiarity with source control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and related DevOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum development practices. 
 - Ability to work independently, manage assigned responsibilities, and adapt to changing priorities. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Fluency in English, both spoken and written. 
 - Ability and willingness to work full-time on a late afternoon shift, with mandatory overlap with the global teams. 

Assets

- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. 
 - Experience with automated testing, release management, and deployment automation. 
 - Experience working with geographically distributed development teams. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise application performance optimization and troubleshooting. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics AX Application Object Server (AOS) and Windows Server environments. 
 - Experience using Microsoft Visual Studio, Dynamics AX Debugger, Trace Parser, and SQL Server Profiler for development, debugging, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) for database queries, troubleshooting, and performance analysis. 

Why Husky?

- Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work as you develop and enhance enterprise applications supporting critical business operations. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in technical discussions and solution reviews, contributing ideas that help improve our enterprise applications and development practices. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in implementation decisions within your area of responsibility, where your expertise contributes to reliable and maintainable solutions. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be part of an organization where individual contributions are recognized and can lead to meaningful improvements. 
 - Impactful Role: Play an important part in developing new functionality, enhancing existing applications, and maintaining the stability of business-critical systems. 
 - Evolving Technologies: Work with enterprise technologies and modern engineering practices while contributing to Husky's ongoing digital transformation. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that values professional growth, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals where your ideas are valued and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex technical and business challenges. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Technical Architect
data.description:
About dunnhumby

dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3, 000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers. 

Tesco Media

Tesco Media is the ultimate media partner to brands. Built on unrivalled customer insight, it's a media owner with soul, scale, and storytelling power. Tesco Media helps brands and agencies connect meaningfully with customers, drive creative effectiveness, and grow at the point of purchase. 

About the Role

We are looking for an Technical Architect to join our engineering organization and help shape the future of our SaaS platform. Our platform powers retail media solutions for global retailers and CPGs, enabling end-to-end advertisement campaigns across e-commerce sites, in-store channels, and social media platforms. 

This role is pivotal in defining architectural guardrails, frameworks, and patterns that enable multiple squads to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure solutions. You will combine hands-on technical depth with the ability to influence and align engineering managers, lead engineers, and product leaders. This is not an ivory-tower role - you will actively partner with teams, ensuring architecture decisions are practical, business-aligned, and execution ready. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Architectural Leadership: Define and evolve application architecture in line with business and product strategy for a global retail media SaaS platform. 
 - Set Guardrails: Establish repeatable patterns for microservices, APIs, identity/auth, observability, and data flows. 
 - NFR Ownership: Ensure non-functional requirements (scalability, reliability, resiliency, observability, security, maintainability) are embedded into design decision. 
 - Cross-Squad Influence: Collaborate with multiple squads (frontend, backend, BFF, platform services) to align on architectural choices. 
 - Tech Evaluations: Lead structured assessments of new tools and frameworks (e. g. , OPA, SpiceDB, caching, API gateways) and guide adoption. 
 - Decision Frameworks: Move teams away from ad-hoc debates by creating clear frameworks for architectural decision-making. 
 - Mentorship: Partner with engineering managers and lead engineers to strengthen design-level thinking and technical maturity. 

What We're Looking For

- Strong hands-on expertise across modern application architecture
 - . NET Core, C#, REST APIs, microservices. 
 - Event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka, or similar). 
 - Databases (Postgres, SQL Server, caching strategies with Redis or Couchbase). 
 - Identity & authorization frameworks (Auth0, OPA, SpiceDB, OpenFGA). 
 - Observability platforms (New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana). 
 - Cloud-native experience (GCP preferred; AWS/Azure acceptable). 
 - An understanding of AI-enabled application patterns and workflow orchestration frameworks. 
 - Awareness of emerging AI and agentic workflow technologies and their application across retail media, advertising, analytics, and SaaS platforms, with the ability to assess their architectural implications and business value
 - Strong track record of embedding NFRs into platform and product design. 
 - Excellent communicators can simplify trade-offs for both engineers and business stakeholders. 
 - Experience influencing without authority and driving closure across multiple teams. 
You'll Thrive If You. . . 

- Enjoy solving complex technical and organisational challenges. 
 - Can balance long-term architectural vision with practical delivery needs. 
 - Build strong partnerships across engineering, product, and business teams. 
 - Take ownership and drive continual improvement in technology standards and practices. 

India Benefits

- Comprehensive medical insurance of INR 500, 000 covering employees and eligible dependents, with dental and vision benefits included. 
 - Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover, with coverage levels linked to employee grade. 
 - Retirement benefits including Provident Fund, Gratuity, and voluntary National Pension Scheme (NPS). 
 - Employee Assistance Programme, Indian Health Organisation (IHO) membership, and wellbeing resources through the Wellness Hub. 
 - Internet allowance, office commute support, work-from-home kit, subsidised meals, and Early Friday each month. 
 - 25 days annual leave plus 10 public holidays, birthday leave, maternity, paternity and adoption leave provisions. 

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work. We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process. For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found(here)

data.description:
Acceldata is reimagining the way companies observe their Data!

Acceldata is the pioneer and leader in data observability, revolutionizing how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive insights into various key aspects of data, data pipelines and data infrastructure across various environments. Our platform empowers data teams to manage products effectively by ensuring data quality, preventing failures, and controlling costs. 

About The Role

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Engineering Manager to lead an engineering team of 15-20 engineers. This is a techno-managerial role responsible for delivering high-quality software while ensuring the team is productive, engaged, and aligned with business goals. This role is responsible for managing a team that works on building the next generation of Acceldata's platform and products and owns the responsibility to ship the key features of the product on-time. 

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will work closely with Engineering Leadership to build the product strategy, reviewing the product roadmaps, track the engineering progress and plan the releases. You will play a key role in hiring, coaching the team members, providing technical guidance and ensuring engineering excellence across the team. 

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

- Guide architecture and design decisions. 
 - Review technical proposals and trade-offs. 
 - Establish engineering best practices. 
 - Ensure scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability. 
 - Partner with senior engineers and architects on technical strategy. 

People Leadership

- Build a strong engineering team. 
 - Guide the team, resolve conflicts and remove blockers. 
 - Conduct performance reviews and career development discussions. 
 - Build a healthy and inclusive team culture. 

Project & Delivery Management

- Own execution of engineering roadmaps. 
 - Ensure projects are delivered on time and with quality. 
 - Manage project planning, resource allocation, risk assessment, and dependency management across multiple initiatives. Balance technical debt with feature delivery. 
 - Drive engineering productivity and predictability. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Product Managers on roadmap planning. 
 - Collaborate with Design, Customer Success, Sales, and Support teams. 
 - Align engineering efforts with business objectives. 
 - Communicate status, risks, and priorities to stakeholders. 

Operational Excellence

- Define engineering processes and metrics. 
 - Improve CI/CD, testing, observability, and release management. 
 - Manage incident response and postmortems. 
 - Monitor team health and delivery metrics. 

What We're Looking For

- 14-18 years of hands-on software engineering experience with deep expertise in backend systems and platform engineering. 
 - 6+ years of experience in managing a high performance team of 20+ engineers 
 - Experience designing complex systems around data, applications, and enterprise-scale workloads. 
 - Strong programming expertise in Java, Scala, Golang, or similar backend technologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, and Apache Kafka, along with NoSQL databases (e. g. , Cassandra, MongoDB, HBase, DynamoDB).

 - Expertise in project planning, resource allocation, risk assessment, and dependency management 
 - Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to balance technical depth with people leadership and business priorities. 
 - Exceptional problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with engineering leaders, architects, product leaders, and executives. 

Preferred Qualifications

Why Join Us?

 - Influence the architecture and technical direction of a category-defining platform. 
 - Work on large-scale distributed systems serving some of the world's largest enterprises. 
 - Collaborate with a world-class engineering team focused on innovation and technical excellence.

We care for our team

 - ESOPs

Acceldata for All

We promote innovation, commitment, and accountability. Our goal is to cultivate a healthy work environment that fosters a sense of belonging, encourages teamwork, and brings out the best in every individual.

Acceldata is redefining data observability for enterprise data systems. Founded by experts who recognized the need for innovative monitoring and management solutions in a cloud-first, AI-driven environment, our platform empowers data teams to effectively manage data products. data.description:
General Manager - Plant Operations

Wallikon Industries Private Limited

Location: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh

Website: wallikon. com

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Department: Manufacturing / Plant Operations

Experience: 12-18 years

Salary: ₹10, 00, 000-₹15, 00, 000 per annum (negotiable for the right candidate)

About Wallikon Industries Private Limited

Wallikon Industries Private Limited is a manufacturer of PVC wall panels, ceiling panels, WPC louvers, fluted panels, and related interior building products. 

We are looking for an experienced General Manager - Plant Operations to take complete responsibility for the day-to-day management and performance of our manufacturing facility in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. 

Our plant operates 25 production lines across two shifts, with approximately 250 employees. 

We require a highly capable manufacturing professional who can independently manage the factory, establish effective management systems, improve productivity, control costs, and ensure smooth operations without requiring daily intervention from the company directors. 

Job Purpose

The General Manager will be responsible for the overall functioning of the manufacturing plant, including production, maintenance, quality, manpower, inventory, safety, and operational cost control. 

The successful candidate must be capable of managing a large workforce, leading departmental managers, establishing standard operating procedures, and creating a disciplined, performance-driven manufacturing environment. 

The primary objective is to ensure that the factory operates efficiently and independently under professional management. 

Key Responsibilities1. Overall Plant Management

- Take complete ownership of daily factory operations. 
 - Manage 25 production lines operating across two shifts. 
 - Establish clear reporting structures, responsibilities, and accountability. 
 - Implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) across all departments. 
 - Ensure uninterrupted production and effective coordination between departments. 
 - Resolve operational issues independently and escalate only major matters to company directors. 2. Production Planning and Control

- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production plans. 
 - Monitor line-wise production targets and actual output. 
 - Improve machine utilisation, labour productivity, and overall operational efficiency. 
 - Minimise production downtime, bottlenecks, and material wastage. 
 - Coordinate production planning with sales forecasts, raw-material availability, and dispatch schedules. 
 - Ensure timely completion of production orders. 3. Manpower and Workforce Management

- Manage approximately 250 employees across two shifts. 
 - Lead production managers, shift in-charges, supervisors, operators, technicians, and support staff. 
 - Establish clear duties and performance targets for all employees. 
 - Manage shift allocation, attendance, overtime, discipline, and workforce productivity. 
 - Train and develop supervisors and departmental managers. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, efficiency, and continuous improvement. 4. Maintenance and Equipment Management

- Implement preventive and predictive maintenance programmes. 
 - Reduce machine breakdowns and unplanned downtime. 
 - Coordinate mechanical, electrical, and utility maintenance. 
 - Maintain maintenance schedules, breakdown histories, and spare-parts inventories. 
 - Ensure proper functioning of extrusion lines, hot and cold mixers, vacuum systems, cooling systems, motors, and associated equipment. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis of recurring breakdowns. 5. Quality Control

- Maintain consistent quality across all production lines and shifts. 
 - Monitor product dimensions, thickness, weight, colour, surface finish, and other applicable specifications. 
 - Reduce rejection, rework, and customer complaints. 
 - Establish quality inspection procedures and batch traceability. 
 - Coordinate corrective actions with production teams. 6. Raw Materials and Inventory Control

- Control raw-material consumption against approved production standards. 
 - Monitor wastage, scrap, and material variances. 
 - Coordinate with procurement and stores to ensure uninterrupted material availability. 
 - Maintain accurate records of raw materials, finished goods, consumables, and spare parts. 
 - Prevent inventory discrepancies and unauthorised material usage. 7. Cost Control and Productivity Improvement

- Monitor manufacturing costs, energy consumption, labour productivity, and material utilisation. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency and profitability. 
 - Establish measurable cost-reduction initiatives. 
 - Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and take corrective action when targets are missed. 8. Safety and Compliance

- Ensure compliance with applicable factory, labour, environmental, and industrial safety requirements. 
 - Maintain safe working practices and machine-safety procedures. 
 - Conduct regular safety inspections and employee training. 
 - Ensure proper documentation and coordination for applicable statutory requirements. 9. Reporting and Management Systems

- Implement daily production reporting and weekly and monthly performance reviews. 
 - Monitor production, downtime, quality, inventory, manpower, and maintenance KPIs. 
 - Use Excel, ERP, or manufacturing information systems to improve operational visibility. 
 - Provide accurate reports to company directors. 
 - Develop systems that allow management to monitor factory performance remotely. Required Qualifications and Experience

- Diploma or bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Plastics Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 12-18 years of experience in manufacturing operations. 
 - At least 5 years in a senior plant management or factory operations leadership position. 
 - Proven experience managing a workforce of approximately 200-400 employees. 
 - Experience managing multiple production lines and two-shift operations. 
 - Strong knowledge of production planning, maintenance, quality management, inventory control, and cost optimisation. 
 - Proficiency in Excel, production reporting, and ERP/MIS systems. 
 - Excellent leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and team-management skills. Preferred Industry Experience

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in: 

- PVC extrusion manufacturing. 
 - WPC extrusion manufacturing. 
 - PVC wall panels and ceiling panels. 
 - WPC profiles, louvers, and fluted panels. 
 - Plastic profiles, building materials, and related manufacturing industries. Candidates with direct experience managing multiple PVC/WPC extrusion lines will be strongly preferred. 

Key Performance Indicators

The selected candidate will be responsible for measurable improvements in: 

- Production target achievement. 
 - Machine utilisation and downtime reduction. 
 - Material consumption and wastage control. 
 - Product quality and rejection rates. 
 - Labour productivity. 
 - Preventive maintenance compliance. 
 - Inventory accuracy. 
 - On-time production and dispatch. 
 - Workplace safety and statutory compliance. Compensation

- Annual CTC: ₹10-15 lakh, depending on experience and suitability. 
 - Performance-linked incentives may be offered against agreed operational targets. 
 - Direct reporting to company directors. 
 - Opportunity to lead a large, established manufacturing facility. How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting: 

- Total manufacturing experience. 
 - Previous plant management experience. 
 - Number of production lines and employees managed. 
 - Experience in PVC/WPC extrusion or related industries. 
 - Production capacity handled. 
 - Achievements in reducing downtime, wastage, and rejection. 
 - Current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period. Candidates must demonstrate the ability to manage a large manufacturing operation independently and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, and cost efficiency.

data.title: Protection Relay Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

Veilix AI, an NVIDIA Inception Startup, turns complex engineering drawings (P&IDs, electrical protection and control schematics, floor plans) into dynamic, machine-readable data. Our graph-based approach, built around standards like IEC 61850 and DEXPI, uses diagram scanning, AI-powered parsing, and automated signal and sensor mapping to give industrial and energy-sector clients real-time visibility into their infrastructure. We work with utilities and industrial operators to modernize legacy systems and make their engineering data usable, so protection and control knowledge stops living only in PDFs and in people's heads. 

Role: Protection Relay & Testing Engineer (Telangana; Andhra Pradesh)

If you've spent real time with an OMICRON CMC 500 or CMC 356 and Test Universe, this role puts that experience at the center. 

You will: 
Design, configure, and test protection schemes for electrical power systems

Plan and run relay testing with OMICRON CMC hardware and Test Universe, including FAT and SAT, and build reusable test plans and templates

Read single-line diagrams, protection schematics, and coordination studies

Select and configure protective relays, and manage settings files

Analyze faults and disturbance records (COMTRADE) and troubleshoot relay and scheme issues

Prepare documentation, settings files, and test reports for internal and external stakeholders

What you bring
Strong grounding in protection principles: overcurrent, distance, differential, and transformer protection, plus fault analysis and coordination

Hands-on experience with OMICRON CMC 500/356 and Test Universe (or comparable secondary injection test sets), including test modules such as Overcurrent, Distance, Differential, and Advanced TransPlay

Hands-on experience with relays from major vendors (Siemens, ABB, SEL, Schneider): configuration, parameter setting, and testing

Familiarity with IEC 61850 (GOOSE, SCL/CID files) and IEC/IEEE standards, plus good practice for safety and documentation

Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

Our Platform Engineering organization comprises of Database experts and automation engineers who focus on enabling strategies to enhance customer and partner experience and optimize business performance through database platform development and management cutting edge automation technologies such as Terraform, Jenkins and Ansible.

Cloud Database Automation Engineer role will be responsible for projects to design, enhance or add new functionality to Synchrony Data platforms (Databases), as well as all operational support activities. Provide technical oversight, architecture, design expertise and guidance, interdepartmental coordination, and vendor direction for Synchrony Database Engineering and automation efforts.

- Implement infrastructure as code for various database platforms

 - Implement Database automation in AWS from build to day-to-day support. 

Required Skills & Knowledge

- Experience working on or leading teams performing systems automation and integration (ideally leveraging an agile methodology / lean techniques)
 - Competence in using scripting + programming languages to automate frequently executed activities

 - 3+ years Expert knowledge of Linux / Unix / Windows systems
 - 5+ years' experience as a Senior DBA or Database automation Engineer; Expertise in designing/configuring mission critical, highly available and high throughput Databases
 - Experience with production systems and dealing with production issues
 - A clear understanding of cloud service and deployment model

Desired Skills & Knowledge

- Database experience with RDS, PostgreSQL, Cassandra. MySQL, Oracle, DynamoDB or DocumentDB

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 8+ years of experience performing systems automation (ideally leveraging an agile methodology) on Database platforms. Deep expertise in at least one database technology.

This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. data.title: ABAP Development Manager
data.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient's mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds. As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised. 

What You Can Expect

The ABAP Development Lead is responsible for leading a team of ABAP developers delivering SAP solutions across the Enterprise Applications portfolio. This role combines people management, technical leadership, and delivery accountability, ensuring SAP development capabilities are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and business objectives. 

It leverages AI-enabled development, review, and analysis tools to improve code quality, reduce defects, accelerate understanding of complex ABAP solutions, and enforce enterprise standards across internal and AMS delivery teams. The role owns ABAP development standards, resource planning, and delivery quality across SAP ECC and S/4HANA environments and partners closely with Functional Leads, Architecture, Basis, Security, and business stakeholders. It is to lead the transition from classic ABAP to cloud-aligned development, enforcing clean core principles and guiding when to use ABAP Cloud, BTP extensions, or standard SAP services. 

How You'll Create Impact

People Leadership & Team Management

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of ABAP developers and senior analysts
 - Set performance expectations, conduct reviews, and support career development
 - Manage team capacity, skills planning, and workload prioritization
 - Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

Technical & Solution Leadership

- Provide technical direction for ABAP development across enterprise SAP initiatives
 - Define and enforce ABAP coding standards, design patterns, and best practices
 - Review and approve complex technical designs and code changes
 - Ensure solutions align with S/4HANA architecture, performance, and security standards
 - Drive responsible use of AI-assisted development tools to accelerate ABAP coding while enforcing enterprise standards
 - Use AI to analyze custom code, identify anti-patterns, performance risks, and clean-core violations
 - Establish guardrails so AI-generated outputs are reviewed, traceable, and production-safe

Delivery & Execution Management

- Own delivery commitments for ABAP development workstreams
 - Partner with project and product leaders to plan, estimate, and deliver work
 - Ensure effective testing, release, and deployment processes
 - Own and enforce a rigorous root cause analysis discipline, leveraging AI to: 
 - Correlate incidents, defects, transports, and code changes
 - Identify systemic patterns, not just single-failure causes
 - Use RCA outputs to drive standards updates, refactoring priorities, and architectural decisions
 - Track and reduce repeat incidents and regression defects
 - Apply AI tools to generate and maintain technical documentation, design summaries, and interface descriptions for custom ABAP solutions
 - Ensure knowledge artifacts are complete, current, and reusable, reducing reliance on individual developers or AMS continuity
 - Promote use of AI-assisted test generation for unit, integration, and regression testing of ABAP code
 - Use AI analytics to identify test gaps, defect patterns, and high-risk components
 - Ensure AI-generated tests are incorporated into the test management processes

Integration, Modernization & Architecture

- Oversee development of integrations using IDocs, BAPIs, RFCs, OData, and APIs
 - Partner with middleware teams (e. g. , SAP CPI / PI / PO)
 - Drive modernization efforts including legacy ABAP refactoring, CDS adoption, and performance optimization
 - Support SAP roadmap initiatives including S/4HANA upgrades and cloud enablement
 - Lead adoption of SAP BTP for extensions, integrations, and event-driven scenarios
 - Define when to use in-app ABAP, ABAP Cloud, or side-by-side BTP extensions
 - Partner with Architecture to enforce clean core and upgrade-safe development patterns
 - Review and approve all custom code for S/4 upgrade and cloud compatibility

Governance, Risk & Stakeholder Management

- Ensure compliance with ITSM, change management, and SOX ITGC requirements
 - Partner with GRC and Security teams to ensure control effectiveness
 - Communicate status, risks, and outcomes to senior IT and business leaders
 - Use AI-assisted code and design analysis to objectively review deliverables from internal and AMS teams

Apply AI Insights To

- Validate complexity vs. effort
 - Detect over-customization or poor design quality
 - Identify skill gaps or coaching needs in vendor teams
 - Serve as final technical authority for accepting or rejecting work based on quality evidence, not just completion

What Makes You Stand Out

Core SAP & ABAP Technologies

- ABAP/4, Advanced OO-ABAP, BAS
 - SAP S/4HANA & ECC development and optimization concepts
 - ABAP Dictionary, Enhancements, User Exits, BADIs

Reporting & Forms

Integration & Interfaces

Development & Lifecycle Management

Platforms & Databases

CORE COMPETENCIES

 - Clear, executive-level communication

Your Background

Preferred Qualifications

Senior Software Engineer - Locomotives

Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We're looking for individuals who continuously seek creative ways to grow, learn, and make a real impact - today and in the future. If this sounds like you, we'd love to welcome you to our vibrant team. 

At Siemens Mobility, we are shaping the future of intelligent transportation. Our portfolio includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification, turnkey systems, intelligent traffic solutions, and related services. We help customers worldwide deliver reliable, sustainable, and efficient mobility solutions. 

We are currently looking for a Senior Software Engineer - Locomotives to join our team in Bangalore. 

You'll Make a Difference By

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in developing, integrating, validating, and sustaining locomotive control software solutions across multiple projects and platforms. You will collaborate closely with system engineering, testing, commissioning, project management, and field teams to deliver stable, reliable, and high-quality software throughout the vehicle lifecycle. 

Your Responsibilities

- Drive software engineering activities for locomotive control applications across multiple projects. 
 - Develop, integrate, validate, maintain, and release locomotive software in line with quality and process standards. 
 - Troubleshoot software issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions. 
 - Coordinate with system engineering, testing, commissioning, suppliers, and global teams for timely issue resolution. 
 - Ensure software compatibility with hardware and communication interfaces, while meeting railway safety and cybersecurity requirements. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers. 
 - Prepare technical documentation and communicate status and progress to stakeholders. 
 - Support process improvement, roadmap planning, and software lifecycle activities. 

Desired Skills & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 
 - 8+ years of experience in locomotive software development, integration, testing, maintenance, and issue resolution. 
 - Good understanding of software requirements engineering and V-cycle development in accordance with EN 50716: 2023. 
 - Strong knowledge of locomotive control systems, TCMS, traction, braking, auxiliary systems, and train communication networks.

data.title: Device- Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Firmware Engineer)
data.description:
Our Mission

SPAN is enabling electrification for all ⚡

We are a mission-driven company designing, building, and deploying products that electrify the built environment, reduce carbon emissions, and slow the effects of climate change. 

- Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere. 
 - Electrification is the process of replacing fossil fuel appliances that run on gas or oil with all-electric upgrades for a cleaner way to power our lives. 

At SPAN, We Believe In

- Enabling homes and vehicles powered by clean energy
 - Making electrification upgrades possible
 - Building more resilient homes with reliable backup
 - Designing a flexible and distributed electrical grid

The Role

The Team and Role

SPAN's Device Software team is responsible for all of the software that is physically embodied in our hardware products. Our first product - the SPAN Panel - contains a complex network of microcontrollers and a single board computer that must work together to react quickly to changing conditions with impeccable reliability in order to perform its job. We look for friendly, excellent engineers who enjoy working with their peers to solve complex problems and prioritize trusting that the people we hire are capable of great things when well supported. Engineers work directly with the broader software, product, and hardware teams to ensure the right things get built at the right time. 

As an engineer on the Device Software team you will define and implement new features directly related to SPAN's hardware products focusing on the lowest level - the microcontroller. This includes everything from bootloaders on systems without an OS up through applications in C and C++ inside an RTOS. Hardware products are central to SPAN's business and writing firmware for even our smallest microcontrollers means working on something that directly impacts the user experience. You will own large user-facing features from conception through implementation on future hardware products, working independently to bring them to completion. 

Representative Projects

- Designing an OTA system that encompasses a variety of communication interfaces, processor types, and products, while achieving both secure goals for hardware-backed encryption and verification and high reliability. 
 - Working with system architects to invent a data steaming architecture for a new product family which can satisfy both the needs of the data science team to access high rate and quality data, as well as safety guarantees around consistency and accuracy. 
 - Representing the Device Software team in group settings and evangelizing engineering best practices. Participating in code and design reviews as well as authoring documents which further reinforce these goals, and supporting engineers across the org in hitting them. 

About You

Required Qualifications

We Are Seeking a Firmware/Embedded Linux Engineer With

- 8 or more years of experience writing software for a hardware device (on a microcontroller, and/or in Linux, etc) in C++ or C
 - Strong fundamentals in modern software design with tools like Object-Oriented design, coupled with awareness of concerns like manual memory management
 - Experience working with standard electrical communication interfaces like UART, I2C, USB, etc
 - Exceptional interpersonal communication and collaboration skills. Great at building trust and driving decisions to a resolution
 - Track record of taking ownership over projects and willingness to help others with theirs, from design and code review through to mentorship of new employees

Bonus Qualifications

We do not expect any engineer to have all skills, but we do want you to be excited to learn and grow. Every Device Software Engineer is free to roam up and down our device software stack, so any combination of the following skills is welcome but not required. 

- Experience with the STM32 microcontroller family
 - Experience with functional safety and processes and standards like UL 60730, ISO 26262, IEC 61508, and UL 1998
 - Experience writing higher level system or application software such as diagnostic command line tools or the application side of a communication interface
 - Wireless technologies like WiFi, Bluetooth and Zigbee
 - Hands-on experience with electronics lab equipment
 - Clean energy hardware in a multidisciplinary environment. 

Life at SPAN

Our Bengaluru team plays a pivotal role in SPAN's continued growth and expansion. Together, we're driving engineering, product development, and operational excellence to shape the future of home energy solutions. 

As part of our team in India, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate closely with our teams in the US and across the globe. This international collaboration fosters innovation, learning, and growth, while helping us achieve our bold mission of electrifying homes and advancing clean energy solutions worldwide. 

Our in-office culture offers the chance for dynamic interactions and hands-on teamwork, making SPAN a truly collaborative environment where every team member's contribution matters. 

Our climate-focused culture is driven by a team of forward-thinkers, engineers, and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day. 

- Do mission-driven work: Every role at SPAN directly advances clean energy adoption. 
 - Bring powerful ideas to life: We encourage diverse ideas and perspectives to drive stronger products. 
 - Nurture an innovation-first mindset: We encourage big thinking and bold action. 
 - Deliver exceptional customer value: We value hard work, and the ability to deliver exceptional customer value. 

Benefits At SPAN India

⚡Generous paid leave

⚡Comprehensive Insurance & Health Benefits

⚡Centrally located office in Bengaluru with easy access to public transit, dining, and city amenities

data.description:
Description

Amazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid - accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real-time platforms: a high-throughput, event-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code - you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics - real-time and event-driven - of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially. 

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system. 

Key job responsibilities

- Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation. 

Write high-quality, well-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews. 

- Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade-offs clearly. 

Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation. 

- Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time. 

Contribute to system-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews - propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures. 

Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits. 

- Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs. 

Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth - without being asked. 

Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity. 

A day in the life

You start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system - incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services - tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup. 

About The Team

We are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time - globally, across all business lines and geographies. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
 - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
 - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
 - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
