data.title: Chief Cloud Infrastructure & Security Officer
data.description:
Job Description

Senior Director / Vice President, Cloud Operations & Security Engineering

Location: Chennai DLF

Employment type: Full-time

Experience: 20+ years

Role Summary

Talentgigs is seeking an experienced technology leader to own and advance Production Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevSecOps, and Security Engineering. 

This leader will bring deep technical judgment and a strong record of leading cloud-native production environments. They will build a capable, accountable organization that protects and operates critical services through reliable engineering, proactive security, automation, continuous monitoring, and disciplined incident management. 

The role extends beyond traditional infrastructure management and information security management system (ISMS) compliance. The successful candidate will embed security and reliability in engineering and operational practices, reduce risk before it becomes an incident, and use automation and AI-driven operations to improve service health and response. 

Key Responsibilities

Production Operations and Reliability

- Own the reliability, availability, performance, and operational readiness of production services. 
 - Establish clear service ownership, operational accountability, escalation paths, and on-call practices. 
 - Lead incident response, service restoration, root-cause analysis, and follow-through on corrective actions. 
 - Define and improve service-level objectives, service-level indicators, error budgets, and operational health measures. 
 - Strengthen change, release, capacity, resilience, backup, and disaster-recovery practices. 
 - Reduce recurring incidents and operational toil through engineering-led improvements. Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering

- Set the direction for secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-aware cloud infrastructure. 
 - Lead the design and operation of cloud-native platforms, environments, networks, identity controls, and shared services. 
 - Promote infrastructure as code, standard platform patterns, self-service capabilities, and repeatable environment provisioning. 
 - Ensure platform design supports availability, recovery, observability, performance, and secure delivery. 
 - Guide capacity planning, cloud cost visibility, and optimization without compromising reliability or security. SRE and Operational Excellence

- Build and mature SRE practices that make reliability measurable and part of day-to-day engineering. 
 - Develop observability across services using actionable metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and service health views. 
 - Improve deployment safety through progressive delivery, automated checks, rollback readiness, and resilient release practices. 
 - Use incident trends, operational data, and post-incident reviews to guide prioritized improvements. 
 - Create a culture of learning and accountability in which incidents lead to durable fixes. DevSecOps and Security Engineering

- Embed security into software delivery, infrastructure management, and operational workflows. 
 - Lead practical security engineering across identity and access, secrets, configuration, network controls, workload protection, and data safeguards. 
 - Build automated security checks into build, test, deployment, and infrastructure pipelines. 
 - Establish continuous monitoring and threat detection with clear triage, escalation, and response ownership. 
 - Drive vulnerability prevention and remediation through asset visibility, risk-based prioritization, patching, secure configuration, and dependency controls. 
 - Strengthen cloud security posture and address risks across applications, platforms, identities, and operational processes. 
 - Partner with product and engineering teams to resolve security issues early and sustainably. 
 - Ensure audits and ISMS obligations are supported by effective technical controls and evidence, while keeping operational security and risk reduction at the center. Automation and AI-Driven Operations

- Set an automation strategy that reduces manual work, improves consistency, and speeds up safe delivery and recovery. 
 - Apply AI and advanced analytics to suitable operational use cases, such as anomaly detection, alert correlation, incident triage, capacity forecasting, and knowledge retrieval. 
 - Establish appropriate safeguards, human oversight, validation, and access controls for AI-supported operational workflows. 
 - Measure automation outcomes through reduced toil, faster response, fewer repeat incidents, and improved service health. Organization and Leadership

- Build, develop, and retain strong teams across production operations, cloud infrastructure, SRE, DevSecOps, and security engineering. 
 - Define organizational structure, role clarity, decision rights, service ownership, and measurable accountability. 
 - Develop senior technical leaders and create growth paths for engineering and operations talent. 
 - Work closely with product, application engineering, architecture, risk, and business leaders to align technology priorities with business outcomes. 
 - Communicate operational risk, service health, security posture, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders. 
 - Lead through technical credibility, sound judgment, collaboration, and consistent follow-through. Required Technical Qualifications

- 20+ years of progressive experience in technology, infrastructure, production operations, cloud engineering, reliability, or security, including substantial leadership responsibility. 
 - Demonstrated hands-on technical leadership in cloud-native production environments. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, networking, identity, compute, storage, and platform operations. 
 - Experience designing and operating containerized and orchestrated workloads, such as Kubernetes or comparable platforms. 
 - Practical knowledge of infrastructure as code, configuration management, CI/CD, source control, and deployment automation. 
 - Deep working understanding of SRE principles, observability, service-level objectives, incident management, resilience, and disaster recovery. 
 - Experience implementing security controls in cloud and software delivery environments, including identity management, secrets, vulnerability management, secure configuration, and threat detection. 
 - Experience establishing continuous monitoring, alerting, incident response, and security operations practices. 
 - Ability to assess architecture and operational risk, make trade-offs, and guide teams through complex technical decisions. 
 - Familiarity with cloud cost management and capacity planning in production environments. Required Leadership Qualifications

- Experience leading multiple technical functions and managing managers or senior technical leaders. 
 - Track record of building technically strong teams with clear ownership and measurable outcomes. 
 - Ability to stay close to technical decisions while setting direction and enabling teams to execute. 
 - Proven leadership in major incidents, security events, operational change, or complex service transformations. 
 - Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk and investment priorities to executive and non-technical audiences. 
 - A practical, engineering-led approach to governance, risk management, and compliance. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build trust and work across organizational boundaries. Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience leading operations and security in a high-scale, high-availability, or business-critical environment. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure and operational models into cloud-native platforms and practices. 
 - Familiarity with zero-trust principles, security architecture, threat modeling, and secure software supply chains. 
 - Experience with chaos engineering, resilience testing, game days, and recovery exercises. 
 - Experience using AI or machine learning to improve operational monitoring, incident workflows, or engineering productivity. 
 - Familiarity with security and service-management frameworks or standards relevant to the organization. 
 - Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or leadership certifications. Success Measures

Success in this role will be assessed through sustained improvements in: 

- Production service availability, reliability, performance, and recovery readiness. 
 - Incident frequency, severity, time to detect, time to restore, and recurrence rates. 
 - Adoption and quality of service-level objectives, observability, and service ownership. 
 - Vulnerability exposure, remediation timelines, secure configuration, and cloud security posture. 
 - Security monitoring coverage, alert quality, response readiness, and closure of corrective actions. 
 - Automation coverage, reduction in manual toil, and safe deployment frequency. 
 - Resilience, backup, disaster-recovery, and continuity test outcomes. 
 - Cloud cost visibility and efficiency while meeting reliability and security requirements. 
 - Team capability, role clarity, leadership depth, and accountability across the functions. 
 - The ability of engineering teams to adopt secure and reliable practices as part of normal delivery.

The role of Engineer II , Product Owner is to contribute in design and development of a product or solution, from conception to design and verification/validation. You will apply expert technical knowledge and engineering principles in the development of products and solutions. You will collaborate with cross functional team for technical issues, design changes, design reviews, and complex problem resolution

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and translate customer, business, regulatory, performance, usability, and safety requirements into clear system requirements and product specifications. 
 - Lead requirements engineering activities, including use case development, requirements decomposition, traceability, and change management using tools such as DOORS, Polarion, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Apply systems engineering principles to balance design trade-offs, identify risks early, and support informed technical decision-making. 
 - Execute and support risk management activities in accordance with ISO 14971, ensuring product safety and regulatory compliance throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and drive optimal technology solutions. 
 - Support Usability Engineering and Human Factors activities, ensuring compliance with IEC 62366 and relevant FDA guidance. 
 - Apply reliability and robustness engineering principles to enhance product performance, quality, and customer experience. 
 - Develop high-quality technical documentation that effectively communicates system architecture, requirements, design decisions, and development outcomes. 
 - Collaborate closely with software, hardware, and systems teams to support successful product integration and development testing. 
 - Work with Verification & Validation (V&V) teams to define comprehensive verification strategies and test plans that ensure thorough requirements coverage. 
 - Provide technical leadership and expertise to help projects achieve key objectives related to quality, cost, schedule, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Contribute to the successful delivery of innovative healthcare solutions by championing best practices in systems engineering, risk management, and product development. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 3-6 years of experience in Systems Engineering, with a strong focus on electro-mechanical product development. 
 - Experience supporting the development of complex products within highly regulated industries, preferably medical devices. 
 - Working knowledge of FDA regulations, Medical Device Regulation (MDR), and applicable quality and regulatory standards. 
 - Experience with requirements management, systems engineering processes, and product lifecycle development. 
 - Familiarity with Usability Engineering and Human Factors Engineering methodologies. 
 - Understanding of design and development tools and methodologies such as QFD (Quality Function Deployment), Pugh Matrix, CTQ (Critical to Quality), Design for Reliability (DFR), and Design for Excellence (DFX). 
 - Knowledge of FDA, ISO, and IEC standards, including design controls, risk management, and product development best practices. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex technical challenges and recommend effective solutions. 
 - Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and successfully deliver project objectives within quality, cost, and schedule expectations. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

Id: 20855

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

Do you want to lead the integration backbone that connects systems, data, and business processes across the enterprise?

As Tech Lead for our API & Integration team, you'll drive the technical direction of a critical integration landscape built on the Azure integration stack. You'll shape integration architectures, set engineering standards, and lead by example in code-balancing new integration development with the stabilization and evolution of existing interfaces to ensure reliability, scalability, and security. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who enjoys designing clean APIs, building resilient event and message-driven integrations, and guiding teams through complex system landscapes-turning connectivity challenges into robust, well-governed Azure solutions. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
 - Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD. 
 - Technical direction for the product area. 
 - Contribute to coordinating cross team dependencies and integration points. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Contribute to the feature definition and review. 
 - Generate concepts and facilitate concept selection. 
 - Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks. 
 - Helping with estimation and sprint planning. 
 - Addressing technical impediments. 
 - Own production readiness (incl. non-functional requirements). 

Quality, Governance & Security

- Ensuring code quality. 
 - Conducting meaningful code reviews and ensuring adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) / DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Ensure adherence to applicable standards, policies, and practices (e. g. DevSecOps). 

Incident Response

- Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortems. 

Mentorship & Team Growth

- Mentoring team members. 
 - Documenting key design decisions. 
 - Participate in interviews and hiring decisions. 
 - Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement. 

Collaboration & Communication

- Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams. 
 - Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - Minimum of 10+ years of experience in software development, with at least 5 years focused on integration solutions. 
 - Solid understanding of integration patterns and practices. 
 - Experience with microservices and hybrid integration (On‐Prem/Cloud). 
 - Strong proficiency and hands-on experience in Azure Integration Services (including Azure API Management, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure Data Factory). 
 - Familiarity with RESTful API design, development and lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with programming languages such as C#, PowerShell, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET framework. 
 - Designing integrations with security-by-design principles. 
 - Experience with: Entra ID, Network security (Private Endpoints, VNET integration), Role-based access control (RBAC). 
 - Awareness of compliance and data protection requirements (e. g. , GDPR). 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. 

Assets

- Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Experience with BizTalk Server. 
 - Experience with MuleSoft. 
 - Domain experience in large enterprises (finance, manufacturing, engineering). 

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

You will lead the development of scalable AI-powered applications, demonstrating exceptional execution skills and the ability to deliver high-performance results under pressure in demanding production environments.

Project Ownership & Execution

- Full Lifecycle Ownership : Take complete accountability for the full ML and GenAI lifecycle, spanning data processing, model development, monitoring, and optimization. 
 - Architectural Leadership : Drive strategic architectural decisions for AI platforms, ensuring they are modular, scalable, and maintainable. 
 - Execution Excellence : Write clean, high-performance Python code following strict OOP principles and manage CI/CD pipelines for seamless project execution. 
 - Leadership & Mentoring : Act as a key technical leader, managing stakeholders and mentoring team members to ensure all project milestones are met with quality. 
 - System Integrity : Manage model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, and comprehensive documentation for all pipelines and workflows. 

Performance Under Pressure

- Production Reliability : Ensure all AI systems maintain extreme scalability and performance under heavy production workloads, including both batch and real-time processing. 
 - High-Pressure Optimization : Rapidly optimize inference latency and system costs for ML and LLM systems to meet urgent business and technical requirements. 
 - Proactive Problem Solving : Apply strong analytical thinking to address complex challenges such as system drift, hallucinations, and latency in fast-paced environments. 
 - Robust Guardrails : Implement and manage strict evaluation frameworks and feedback loops to maintain system quality under stress. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related field. 
 - Proven expertise in Python, system design, and scalable AI/ML architecture. 
 - Deep knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, and Deep Learning models. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLOps, and major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

data.description:
About the RoleWe're looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own the quality of our web product. You'll build and maintain our automated test suite using Playwright and Python, and you'll work closely with developers and product to catch issues early and ship with confidence. We care about automation, but we also want someone with a good instinct for exploratory testing and for knowing what's worth automating. 

What You'll Do•        Design, build, and maintain end-to-end UI test suites using Playwright with Python and pytest, and keep them fast, parallel, and reliable. 

•        Write automated API tests for REST services with Playwright's API testing or Python libraries like requests or httpx. 

•        Investigate failures and fix flaky tests, using Playwright traces, screenshots, and logs to get to the root cause. 

•        Write test plans and test cases for new features, and do exploratory and manual testing where automation isn't the right tool. 

•        Run regression, smoke, and cross-browser testing (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) before releases. 

•        File clear, reproducible bug reports and work with developers to verify fixes. 

•        Review requirements and designs early to flag testability issues and edge cases. 

•        Help shape our overall test strategy, coverage, and quality metrics. 

Must-Haves•        [3+] years of QA experience, with at least [2] years in test automation. 

•        Strong Python skills: you write clean, maintainable, reusable test code, not just scripts that happen to pass. 

•        Hands-on Playwright experience (Python), including locators, auto-waiting, fixtures, authentication/storage state, network interception, and tracing. 

•        Solid experience with pytest: fixtures, parametrization, markers, and plugins. 

•        Experience with the Page Object Model or similar patterns for structuring test frameworks. 

•        Strong testing fundamentals: test design techniques (boundary values, equivalence partitioning), the bug lifecycle, and the difference between smoke, sanity, and regression testing. 

•        Experience testing REST APIs. 

•        Comfortable with Git. 

•        Experience with a bug tracker like Jira or Linear. 

•        Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain a bug so a developer can reproduce it on the first try. 

Nice to Have•        Experience with Docker and running tests in containers. 

•        Basic SQL for test data setup and validation. 

•        Performance testing (Locust, k6, or JMeter). 

•        Accessibility or visual regression testing. 

•        Cloud testing platforms like BrowserStack or LambdaTest. 

•        Mobile web or native app testing.

data.title: Sr. GenAI Engineer
data.description:
Senior GenAI Engineer

● Overall experience: 5-8 years

● Location: Bangalore (or willing to relocate to Bangalore)

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior GenAI Engineer with strong core engineering foundations and

hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI solutions. This role is execution- and

ownership-focused - responsible for delivering GenAI features end-to-end (backend +

frontend), working with agentic AI workflows, and mentoring junior engineers while handling

ambiguous requirements. 

This position is part of our GenAI hiring phase, where we prioritize strong full-stack/backend

engineers who have recently built and shipped GenAI and agentic AI solutions in production. 

Experience Profile

● Overall experience: 5-8 years

● Core engineering background: Python (Django / FastAPI)

● GenAI experience: 2-3+ years of hands-on, production-level experience, including Agentic AI. 

Key Responsibilities

GenAI Solution Development

● Build and deploy GenAI-powered features within real-world products, spanning backend

(Python - Django/FastAPI)

● Design and implement RAG pipelines, including: 

○ Embeddings

○ Vector databases

○ Retrieval strategies

● Integrate GenAI capabilities with backend systems via APIs and services. ● Build responsive, GenAI-integrated UI/UX components in React to surface AI-driven

features to end users. 

System & Solution Ownership

● Own GenAI solutions end-to-end, from design to production rollout - across backend, 

frontend, and AI layers. 

● Design RAG architectures and decide: 

○ Chunking strategies

○ Retrieval approaches

● Handle ambiguous requirements and convert them into working, shippable solutions. 

Reliability, Quality & Performance

● Address latency, cost, and evaluation considerations in GenAI systems. 

● Implement guardrails and safety mechanisms. 

● Contribute to monitoring and basic operational readiness. 

Agentic AI (Core Focus)

● Build and own agent-based workflows, including: 

○ Multi-step reasoning flows

○ Tool/function calling

○ Orchestrated GenAI interactions

● Work hands-on with agent frameworks to design and deploy production-grade agentic

systems (deep research not required, but practical build experience expected). 

Mentoring & Collaboration

● Mentor junior engineers working on GenAI components. 

● Review GenAI-related code and designs, across both backend and frontend

implementations. 

● Collaborate closely with backend, frontend, data, and product teams. 

Must-Have Skills

● Strong engineering experience in Python (Django / FastAPI)

● Hands-on experience building GenAI applications in production. 

● Experience with: 

○ RAG pipelines

○ Vector databases

○ LLM APIs

○ Agentic AI (multi-step reasoning, tool/function calling, orchestration)

● Solid understanding of API design and backend integrations. 

● Ability to reason about trade-offs in performance, cost, and reliability. 

Nice-to-Have Skills

● Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for GenAI. 

● Exposure to cloud-native deployments. 

● Experience mentoring junior engineers.

Job Title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Data Platform & ERP Integration)

Job Location: Pune/Hybrid)

About Accelirate

Accelirate is a leading agentic AI and automation firm, building intelligent agents that transform enterprise operations. Honored as a Top Workplaces USA winner five years in a row, we're known for delivering scalable, agent-driven solutions that empower humans, agents, and robots to work smarter together. 

About the Role We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to build, scale, and maintain the cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines supporting our platform team. In this role, you will focus on powering real-time ERP data integration workloads by building resilient Kubernetes platform automation, managing distributed streaming clusters (Kafka/Flink), ensuring rigorous IaC standards, and delivering comprehensive observability across our multi-database ecosystem. 

Key Responsibilities

- Infrastructure Automation: Design, provision, and maintain secure, scalable AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform or CloudFormation. 
 - Container Orchestration & Platform: Manage, optimize, and secure Kubernetes clusters (EKS) for deploying microservices, stream processors, and data connectors. 
 - CI/CD & Pipeline Engineering: Build, automate, and maintain robust GitHub Actions deployment pipelines for Java (Spring Boot), Python, and infrastructure workloads. 
 - Observability & Reliability: Implement end-to-end monitoring, centralized logging, distributed tracing, and automated alerting using Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk to guarantee high availability for mission-critical integration pipelines. 
 - Data Platform Support: Partner with data engineers to automate, scale, and secure deployments of Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect, Apache Flink/Kafka Streams, and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle). 
 - Security & Compliance: Enforce secret management, IAM policies, network security controls, and infrastructure compliance across environments. 

Required Qualifications

- DevOps & Cloud Engineering: 5+ years of experience in DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), with deep expertise on AWS. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced hands-on proficiency with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation. 
 - Containerization & Orchestration: Proven track record running production workloads using Docker and Kubernetes (EKS). 
 - CI/CD Automation: Deep experience designing and optimizing automated pipelines using GitHub Actions. 
 - Observability & APM: Strong production experience configuring dashboards, metrics, and alerting in Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk. 
 - Scripting & Tooling: Strong scripting abilities in Python or Bash, with solid understanding of Java/Spring Boot application runtimes and JVM tuning. 
 - Databases & Streaming Awareness: Experience provisioning and supporting self-hosted or managed relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle) and streaming middleware (Apache Kafka). 
 - Version Control: Advanced proficiency with Git and standard branching models. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing stateful workloads and operators on Kubernetes (e. g. , Strimzi Kafka Operator, Flink Kubernetes Operator). 
 - Familiarity with Change Data Capture (CDC) infrastructure tools like Debezium. 
 - AWS certifications (e. g. , AWS Certified Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer Professional).

data.title: Digital Quality Analyst - Marketing Tech Team
data.description:
At Columbia, we're as passionate about the outdoors as you are. And while our gear is available worldwide, we're proud to be based in the Pacific Northwest, where natural wonders are our playground. 

Every product we make and every task we undertake is inspired by the famous words of our founder Gert Boyle: "It's perfect. Now make it better. " As pioneers of relentless improvement, we are constantly evolving. 

We believe the outdoors is ours to protect and strive to keep our planet healthy. We believe in empowering people to experience the outdoors to the fullest. 

And we believe in you. 

About The Position

Although we're an apparel and footwear-focused company, technology is central to everything we do. Columbia Sportswear's Digital Technology (CDT) group enables an IT infrastructure and applications across four global brands, a global supply chain, and 500+ geographically dispersed stores. These teams support in-store, mobile, and data platforms to enhance customer interface and service in an ever-evolving industry. 

The Quality Analyst II has a solid understanding of technology platforms and utilizes best practices among the quality team. This person reviews test strategies, authors test plans, and authors and executes test cases. The Quality Analyst II uses a variety of testing tools and methods and updates or creates automated test cases. The role executes automated test scripts and identify process and/ technology issues. 

How You'll Make a Difference

- Communication, Collaboration & Leadership: Communicates status in daily meetings, fosters constructive, collaborative and effective communication with others, both internally and externally. Actively participates in design discussions, planning, and retrospective reviews. Explains and simplifies complex information to others. 
 - Knowledge: Ensures processes are clearly documented. Demonstrates a basic understanding of the functions and technologies of the product. Learns about multiple test techniques, tools and business context and technologies of the software used. Addresses problems, proposes solutions, and takes action to resolve, referring more complex issues to senior employees. 
 - Metrics: Creates and monitors status dashboards for tracking team progress
 - Quality Standards: Drives analysis of post release quality and defect escapes and implements improvements based on the results of analysis. Completes straightforward projects and provides input for enhancements to improve test coverage and processes. Assesses the testability of components and features built by development teams. Works with project team to establish quality standards or metrics and identify risks. 
 - Test Strategy & Planning: Identifies salient test cases based on product domain knowledge and traceability to use cases, enabling on-time sprint deployments. Writes effective and efficient test scripts and test cases. Reviews of test plans are thoughtful and considerate of the customer and time frames needed for releases. 
 - Test Execution: Ensures thorough and complete resolution and closure of tickets once deployed to production. Assists developers in desk checks and testing. Works with the team to ensure code is tested at the appropriate level, assists in gaining efficiencies. Identifies and prevents defects early. Proactively works to identify the root cause of problems and identifies efficient ways to reproduce issues. Contributes to bug triage and prioritization processes. 
 - Mentorship: Provides peer level technical guidance for team members. Helps more junior team members learn, grow and contribute to the team. 

YOU ARE

- Genuinely curious - you ask why, not just whether. You want to understand why a tag fires in a specific sequence, what the Liquid personalization token is supposed to render for a given profile, and what a consent mode change means downstream for pixel data. You treat every testability gap as a signal worth investigating, not an obstacle to work around. 
 - Shift-left by default. You don't wait for a build to find problems. You read acceptance criteria like an auditor - spotting what's missing, what's ambiguous, and what will create a defect if it isn't clarified before dev starts. Refinement is where your value shows up first. 
 - A master of async defect communication. You file bugs the way a distributed team needs you to - self-contained, structured, and immediately actionable. A QA defect in your queue is never a mystery that needs a Zoom call to decode. Your documentation is your reputation. 
 - Globally minded, with experience working on geographically distributed teams. You understand the discipline, cadence, and over-communication required to make a US-India collaboration genuinely cohesive - and you've built those habits in practice. 
 - Methodical and detail-oriented - you understand that a missed pixel fire or a broken personalization token has real downstream consequences for marketing measurement and campaign performance. You bring that care to every test case you write and every defect you file. 
 - A collaborative teammate, comfortable working across engineering, product, analytics, and marketing functions within a globally distributed model. You don't stay in a QA swim lane - you go where quality needs attention. 

YOU HAVE

- Bachelor's Degree required Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. 
 - 4+ years' experience
 - Proficiency with Postman for API testing - structured request/response validation, test data generation, role-based access checks, and SLA timing verification. 
 - Experience with email QA - template render testing using Email on Acid, Litmus, or equivalent; familiarity with ESP platform testing (Zeta, Braze, Emarsys, or similar). 
 - Working knowledge of tag management QA - understanding what tag management systems do, how to use browser developer tools to validate tag fires, and how to read data layer objects against a specification. Experience with the Adobe Experience Platform Debugger or equivalent tag debugging tooling is strongly preferred. 
 - Solid understanding of agile/Scrum delivery - shift-left quality practices, sprint ceremony participation, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done as quality gates, QA sizing in sprint planning. 
 - Experience with Jira for defect tracking, defect lifecycle management, and sprint ticket status workflows. 
 - Experience testing across a multi-phase test lifecycle: QA → SIT → UAT → E2E → Production validation. 
 - Demonstrated experience working on a globally distributed or cross-timezone team - including a US-India GCC model, offshore delivery, or equivalent. Prior experience collaborating with remote stakeholders is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills - including the ability to write async-friendly defect reports, test status updates, and QA documentation that remote teammates can act on independently without a live call. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Adobe Analytics validation - understanding how events, eVars, props, and conversion metrics are captured and how to confirm accuracy against a measurement plan (SDR). 
 - Familiarity with OneTrust or consent management platforms and how they gate tag firing (GDPR/CCPA context). 
 - Experience testing on Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) - navigating Business Manager for test data setup, order creation, and profile configuration. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipeline integration for test automation - CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent; understanding of artifact reporting and suite segmentation (smoke, regression, integration). 
 - Exposure to Liquid templating in ESP platforms - ability to validate personalization logic and token rendering in email templates. 

#Hybrid

This job description is not meant to be an all-inclusive list of duties and responsibilities, but constitutes a general definition of the position's scope and function in the company.

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams.  - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security.

 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge
 - Amazon Kinesis, Route 53, S3 (events, triggers)
 - Terraform (0. 12+)
 - Apache Hudi (0. 11+) and CDC methodologies
 - AWS DMS
 - Apache Spark (2. 4+) and PySpark
 - Amazon EMR (5. x+)

data.description:
Who We Are Looking For

State Street Investment Management's Data, Analytics & AI Services (DAAIS) team is seeking an experienced hands-on architect, engineer for building the multi-cloud open architecture-based data platform that delivers trusted data products to the business functions. This role is an 80% IC role in doing hands-on engineering and developing POCs to support a resilient, scalable, performance optimized, secure multi-cloud data platform, and 20% of the capacity is responsible for managing and mentoring the employees, based out of Bangalore, responsible for the production maintenance & support of the legacy data platform. The successful candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise in large-scale data platform architecture, distributed computing, data pipeline engineering, and modern cloud architecture and operational experience. 

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Investment Management, one of the largest asset managers in the world. We partner with many of the world's largest, most sophisticated investors and financial intermediaries to help them reach their goals through a rigorous, research-driven investment process. With over four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer one of the broadest selections of services across asset classes, risk profiles, regions and styles. As pioneers in index, ETF, and ESG investing, we are always inventing new ways to invest. 

Join us if making your mark in the asset management industry from day one is a challenge you are up for. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a Data Platform Engineer, Vice President II, you will -

- Validate target data platform architectures and design principles through hands-on engineering, technical spikes, and POCs for a unified, cloud-native Lakehouse. 
 - Partner with architects to translate reference architectures and data strategies into working prototypes, measurable validation criteria, and production-ready implementation patterns. 
 - Optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Python/Scala, SQL, Spark, and modern orchestration frameworks. 
 - Engineer high-performance Iceberg-based data models and tables, including partitioning, compaction, schema evolution, metadata management, and multi-engine interoperability. 
 - Establish data engineering standards for data quality, lineage, observability, reliability, versioning, and backward-compatible data product contracts. 
 - Optimize platform, pipeline, and query performance through workload testing, partitioning and clustering, caching, concurrency management, and cost-aware lifecycle practices. 
 - Lead capabilities from POC to production by defining non-functional requirements, resolving engineering risks, integrating with platform services, and enabling operational support and SLA readiness. 
 - Engineer AI-ready data products with trusted, well-governed, semantically enriched data, incorporating context engineering, ontologies, embeddings, vector indexing, and RAG patterns. 
 - Build and productionize data services for Agentic and AI workloads, including MCP-enabled access, interoperable APIs, LLM gateways, multi-model routing, caching, observability, security, and cost optimization. 
 - Mentor and provide technical leadership to the L2/L3 support teams for legacy platform to ensure SLA adherence, escalation discipline, and timely closure of production issues impacting business, clients, or regulators. 

Required Qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, with 15+ years of technology experience, preferably in financial services. 
 - Expert-level hands-on programming in Python and SQL, with Java or Scala as a plus, and proven ability to design, debug, test, and optimize distributed data-processing solutions. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise with Apache Spark for batch and streaming workloads, including performance tuning, troubleshooting, reliability engineering, and cost optimization. 
 - Proven experience building and operating enterprise Lakehouse and data platforms using Snowflake and Databricks, supporting high-concurrency analytical, near-real-time, and AI-ready workloads. 
 - Strong cloud engineering experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including cloud-native data services, security, networking, infrastructure automation, portability, and cost management. 
 - Working expertise with open data architectures and metadata ecosystems, including Apache Iceberg, schema evolution, table optimization, catalog federation, zero-copy sharing, data virtualization, and multi-engine access. 
 - Extensive experience productionizing data capabilities through DevOps and CI/CD, automated testing, observability, data quality, incident management, and operational support for mission-critical platforms. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with both structured and unstructured data management tools and associated patterns 
 - Familiarity with modern governance frameworks (Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation). 
 - Expertise in AI-assisted coding using GitHub Copilot or Claude Code Assistant. 

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

Notifi is the AI-native platform that runs home service businesses. HVAC, plumbing and electrical shops use it to answer calls, book jobs, dispatch techs, send estimates, take payments and keep members on plan, all in one place. Iris, our AI voice agent, answers the phone and books the work. 

Shops are switching to Notifi from ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro and FieldEdge. Every release has to hold up for techs in the field and offices on the phone all day. That's where you come in. 

The role

We're hiring a QA Automation Engineer to own testing across our web app and our iOS and Android tech app. You'll build and run our Playwright regression suite, write end-to-end tests for the flows our customers depend on, and catch bugs before they reach a live shop. 

What you'll do

- Build and maintain a Playwright E2E suite in TypeScript for the web app
 - Write end-to-end tests for the core flows: call to job, dispatch, visit, estimate, invoice, payment
 - Run full regression before every release and turn failures into clear, reproducible bug reports
 - Wire the suite into CI so tests run on every pull request
 - Test the iOS and Android tech app on real devices and simulators
 - Test calling and texting: inbound, outbound, transfers, missed calls, voicemail
 - Write API tests for the backend endpoints behind each flow
 - Work daily with engineering and product to decide what is ready to ship

What you bring

- 4+ years in QA for web or mobile apps, with most of it in test automation
 - Hands-on Playwright experience (a must). Cypress or Selenium is a plus
 - Solid TypeScript or JavaScript
 - Experience running automated tests in a CI pipeline
 - API testing experience (Postman or similar)
 - Mobile testing experience. Appium, Detox or Maestro is a plus
 - Clear written English and sharp attention to detail
 - Bonus: SaaS, payments, VoIP or field service software experience

What we offer

- Fully remote
 - Real ownership of quality on a product that is growing fast
 - Direct work with the founders and engineering lead

Note: Looking for immediate joiners.

Mandatory Tech Stack Experience:

Role Overview

A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) works directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end to end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment. 

The role combines the technical rigor of a software engineer with the urgency and ownership needed to deliver measurable business outcomes. FDEs also create reusable architectures, patterns and engineering practices that help the wider FDE practice scale. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Embed with customer engineering teams: Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture and operational constraints. Turn ambiguous business problems into scalable, AI-enabled production systems. 
 - Build production AI applications: Design and develop production-grade software for AI and agentic workflows, including multi-agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, workflow automation and decision intelligence. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, APIs and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, observability, cost and security. 
 - Own production: Take systems from design through production rollout and ongoing operations. Troubleshoot incidents across AI models, distributed systems, data pipelines and application services. Put in place monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, testing, CI/CD, rollback and resiliency mechanisms that keep AI systems healthy at scale. 
 - Accelerate customer transformation: Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption across customer workflows. Build reusable patterns, accelerators and reference architectures for future engagements. 
 - Raise the bar: Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering best practices for AI and forward deployment. Feed reusable components and learnings back into products and services. 

Core technical skills (must have): 

Python: Strong, production-grade Python: clean code, testing, APIs and integration with enterprise systems. 

Agentic AI on AWS:   Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore, including prompt engineering, tool calling and agent orchestration with a framework (e. g. Strands Agents, LangGraph, LangChain). 

RAG & retrieval: Building retrieval pipelines: embeddings, chunking and vector search (e. g. Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch, pgvector). 

Core AWS services: Working knowledge of serverless and container services, storage, security and networking on AWS (e. g. Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, IAM). 

Production engineering: Taking AI systems to production: CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, evaluations and guardrails for AI output. 

Good to have: 

- Infrastructure as code (e. g. Terraform, AWS CDK) and containers (Docker). 
 - LLM evaluation and tracing tools (e. g. Bedrock Guardrails, RAGAS, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry). 
 - MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns, or other frameworks such as CrewAI or LlamaIndex. 
 - API frameworks such as FastAPI, SQL, and event-driven services (e. g. Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge). 
 - A second language such as TypeScript/Node. js or Java. 
 - Amazon SageMaker, and model fine-tuning or customization on Bedrock. 
 - Experience in regulated industries (banking, capital markets, insurance): security reviews, audit and data-residency controls. 
 - AWS certifications: AI Practitioner, Machine Learning Engineer - Associate, Solutions Architect - Associate/Professional, or Generative AI Developer - Professional. 

Basic qualifications: 

- 5+ years of professional software development experience (excluding internships). 
 - 5+ years of programming in at least one software programming language. 
 - 5+ years leading design or architecture of new and existing systems (design patterns, reliability and scaling). 
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Experience building production AI or ML applications, including agentic workflows. 
 - 5+ years across the full software development life cycle: coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing and operations. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable working in customer-facing environments.

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 

ROLE PURPOSE

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service. 

Key Responsibilities

 - Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers.

 - Process ownership and service delivery
 - Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W. 
 - Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders. 
 - Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight. 
 - Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions. 
 - Governance, risk and controls

 - Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO.

 - Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking.

 - Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. 
 - Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. 
 - Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. 
 - Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.

data.title: Solutions Architect
data.description:
About the role

You will be the architect who wins the technical deal. Before a contract is signed, you show enterprise customers that their AI agents will work, at their scale and under their rules. You build the demos and proofs of concept, answer the architecture questions, and hand delivery a plan they can execute. This is a hands-on engineering role in front of customers. You write code most weeks and spend the rest with CIOs, platform teams and risk officers. You report to the Co-Founder and CTO. 

What you will do

• Discover: run technical discovery with CIOs, platform-engineering and risk teams at banks, insurers and asset managers. Map their systems, data and controls to the agent use cases that matter. 

• Demo: build tailored demos of agent workflows, using the customer's own scenarios where you can. 

• Prove: scope and deliver 2 to 6 week proofs of concept. Write the code, wire up integrations and measure results against agreed success criteria. 

• Design: produce reference architectures for agent deployment on AWS, Azure or GCP, covering identity, data access, observability and guardrails. 

• De-risk: answer security, compliance and model-risk questionnaires (SOC 2, data residency, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls). 

• Hand off: turn every won proof of concept into a delivery plan our forward-deployed engineers can run from day one. 

• Feed back: bring field patterns to product and build reusable demo assets, templates and starter agents. 

What we are looking for

• 8+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture or forward-deployed engineering for enterprise customers. 

• Hands-on experience building LLM applications or agents: prompt and tool design, RAG, evaluation, and at least one agent framework. 

• Strong Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, containers and one major cloud. 

• Comfort in regulated environments, where governance, auditability and access control decide the deal. 

• Consulting experience: client-facing work, scoping engagements and running workshops with enterprise stakeholders. 

• Understanding of tool calling and MCP, guardrails and policy controls, access management, observability and audit trails. 

Nice to have

• Experience selling to, or working inside, financial services. 

• Kubernetes, observability or AIOps tooling. 

• AWS, Azure or GCP certifications. 

• A public demo, repo, talk or post about something you built with agents. 

Location: Chennai, India (Chennai office), hybrid 3 days on-site, with travel to customer sites as needed.

data.description:
Job Specification: 

We are seeking a Lead Java Engineer to head the XiP Compute Service (XCS) team - the engine room of Citi's enterprise-scale XiNG Platform (XiP), responsible for orchestrating and executing 1. 5 billion risk calculations every day. 

As the lead of the XCS team, you will own the design, development, and evolution of the most performance-critical component within XiP. XiP is Citi's unified risk calculation platform built on the XiNG quantitative libraries standard, and XCS sits at its core - providing the powerful compute paradigms and guardrails that enable calculations to run reliably at massive scale. 

Your team is the engine that daily coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute nodes, utilises hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations across Citi's private cloud and Public cloud infrastructures. The platform is both highly performant and rapidly evolving, and your leadership will be central to driving it to its next generation of scale, efficiency, and capability. 

You will work closely with other software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to define technical strategy and ensure the reliable, secure, and scalable operation of the platform. 

Responsibilities

Take a lead in defining the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform: 

Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in an undesirable manner, as small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines. 

Take on the day-to-day leadership of the development team: 

Lead the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, to ensure a smooth and effective development workflow. Manage the project backlog, prioritize tasks, and coordinate development efforts to align with the product roadmap and strategic goals. Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding the team in architectural decisions and enforcing coding standards. 

Serve as advisor or coach to team members, allocating and overseeing work: 

Mentor and guide developers, providing technical advice, code reviews, and career development support. Allocate tasks based on skill sets and project priorities, ensuring balanced workloads and timely delivery. Foster a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment, encouraging best practices and continuous learning. 

Lead the implementation of changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine: 

Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies, which regularly handle 250, 000 hours of compute in a single 90-minute execution, and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput. 

Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone: 

Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs.

 - 10+ years of professional software development experience with Java.

The Electronic Market Making Cash Trading team systematically provides liquidity in US Equities and ETFs, both on-exchange and to low-touch client flow. We're a small team that demands a high level of ownership and accountability from each contributor, while strongly emphasizing collaboration and transparency. Engineers on the team are deeply involved in both software and strategy development. You will work with other engineers and trading teams to improve all aspects of execution, price-making and risk management. You will have an opportunity to develop a deep understanding of how GS interacts with some of the most dynamic and liquid markets in the world.

Design, build and maintain high performance, low latency trading platform which can evolve and adapt to changes in our fast-paced, global business environment.

Improve the safety and reliability of trading systems. 

Manage work to balance the short-term needs of the business with strategic enhancements.

A deep passion for technology and software development

Sound understanding of multi-threaded application design and development and experience with lock-free data structures

Professional experience working with distributed systems

Knowledge of CPU microarchitecture, caches and memory subsystems and experience with micro-optimizations

Experience in low latency messaging, TCP/UDP tuning, Linux latency tunings is preferred

Experience with low latency trading platform is preferable but not necessary

Excellent communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with statistics and data-science methodologies

Experience with Python and data-science packages (e. g. numpy, scikit-learn)

Experience building and maintaining high-performance research infrastructure for large data inputs

Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture

At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don't just make things - we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. This position offers the opportunity to have real impact in a dynamic, technology-focused company impacting product lines ranging from consumer graphics to self-driving cars and the growing field of artificial intelligence. We have created a team of outstanding people stretching around the globe, whose mission is to push the frontiers of what is possible today and define the platform for the future of computing. Come, join us today!

What You'll Be Doing

- Set up scalable verification flows for large IP's that caters to multiple projects and variants. 
 - Improve continuous integration processes across multiple branches for various IP versions and projects. 
 - Continuous improvement of the speed of build and simulation flows. 
 - Set up automated metrics and dashboards to monitor health of the infrastructure flows and resources. 
 - Set up processes to identify suboptimal areas, and help in improving verification efficiency for the large team of HW engineers. 
 - Remove inefficiency wherever you can find it!
 - Architect and develop tools, user interfaces, and reports for chip development, data visualization, resource management, etc. 
 - Analyze performance bottlenecks, improve data analytics and visualizations of day to day workflows

 - Experience with LSF, compute farms, filers, and networks

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- A desire to constantly grow and learn new things. In this team you will constantly be exposed to new technologies and new problems. Your ability to assimilate new ideas and handle tough problems as they arise will be the key to your success.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you are creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you.

data.title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)
data.description:
Role Title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)

Company Overview

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony's risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony's Second Line of Defense. 

Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges. 

Role Summary/ Purpose

The eGRC Solution Architect is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk & Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that automate, standardize, and integrate governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end-to-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and deliver GRC solutions: Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end-to-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions. 
 - Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology-based solutions . 
 - Lead technical implementations : Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms. 
 - Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e. g. , RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation. 
 - Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
 - Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e. g. , RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives . 
 - GRC platform expertise : 5+ years of hands-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 . 
 - Solution architecture experience: 5+ years designing and delivering end-to-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target-state architecture, standards, and non-functional requirements. 
 - Problem-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Architectural and technical skills: Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines. 
 - Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership. 

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience

Work Timings: 2: 30 PM to 11: 30 PM IST

We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs-Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. 

Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events. 

For Internal Applicants

- Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying. 
 - Inform your Manager or HRM before applying for any role on Workday. 
 - Ensure that your Professional Profile is updated (fields such as Education, Prior experience, Other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format) 
 - Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal LPP)
 - L10+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible. 
 - L10+ Employees can apply

Grade/Level: 12

Job Family Group

Risk Management
