Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

Do you want to build custom business applications that directly support and improve how the company operates every day -from launching new capabilities to keeping critical systems stable and evolving?

As Senior Developer in our Custom Business Applications team, you'll work hands-on across an Azure full-stack to design, implement, and evolve applications that support core business processes. You'll own complex implementations at component and module level, ensure high quality and reliability, and help keep business-critical systems stable while they continue to evolve. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business requirements into robust, production-ready software, solving nontrivial technical problems, and contributing to a healthy codebase. 

If you want your work to have direct impact on real business operations, this role lets you see the results of your code every day. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Understand and implement solutions based on the defined LLD (low level design). 
 - Own complex implementations at component/module level. 
 - Ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability of delivered solutions. 
 - Make sound technical decisions within assigned scope, escalating broader design concerns as needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate approved requirements and designs into working software. 
 - Break down assigned features into actionable tasks. 
 - Provide reliable estimates for owned work. 
 - Deliver high-quality increments aligned with sprint goals. 
 - Proactively resolve technical issues within assigned scope. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write code that is reliable, readable, and maintainable, and follow the team's agreed standards and best practices
 - Participate in meaningful code reviews. 
 - Ensure adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) and DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Identify and address technical debt within owned components/module. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects and production issues. 
 - Contribute to root cause analysis and long-term fixes. 
 - Ensure adequate logging and observability in implemented components. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

- Collaborate closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, QA, and Platform teams. 
 - Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement within the team. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - 5+ years professional experience in software development. 
 - Experience with programming languages like C#, PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks. 
 - Experience working with web services / APIs (e. g. , REST). 
 - Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, particularly those offered on Azure. 
 - Proficiency in using various Azure services like Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, etc. 
 - Understanding and knowledge of cloud security best practices. 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevSecOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities. 

Assets

- Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Experience working with and contributing to UX designs. 
 - Hands‐on experience designing and operating event‐driven systems using Event Sourcing and CQRS. 
 - Experience with React, Next. js, GraphQL, and TypeScript. 
 - Working experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM templates. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. Azure Developer Associate, Azure Cosmos DB Developer Specialty). 

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. data.title: Principal Software Engineer Manager
data.description:
Overview

The Cloud Delivery team within Microsoft Defender helps services and product capabilities reach cloud environments quickly and reliably. We partner with service engineering and operations teams to improve deployment pipelines, automate readiness checks, and make releases easier to validate, diagnose, and operate. We aim to reduce routine manual intervention without losing the checks and recovery paths that keep releases safe. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

As a Principal Software Engineering Manager in Microsoft Defender, you will lead engineers and work across the organization to help build software and improve processes to make our cloud deployments safer, more reliable, and less dependent on manual intervention. 

You will own people development, technical direction, and delivery through your team while contributing hands-on to architecture, code, and production troubleshooting. Working with service teams across Defender, you will advance deployment automation and engineering efficiency by reducing repetitive work and developing reusable solutions to shared operational challenges. 

Responsibilities Include

- Hire, coach, and develop engineers through clear expectations, actionable feedback, performance management, and career growth opportunities. 
 - Set engineering priorities and deliver results through your team, balancing deployment improvements with reliability, security, and ongoing support. 
 - Lead architecture and design for Azure deployment automation and infrastructure tooling, addressing service dependencies, integration boundaries, and failure recovery. 
 - Contribute code, review designs and implementations, and troubleshoot production issues while developing engineers' technical judgment and ownership. 
 - Partner with Defender service teams to automate deployment preparation and validation, reduce manual handoffs, and clarify ownership of tooling and service operation. 
 - Drive engineering efficiency across Defender by identifying recurring deployment and operational work, improving existing workflows, and building reusable automation where it delivers measurable benefit. 
 - Use deployment telemetry and incident learning to measure improvements in reliability and manual effort and guide testing, observability, and safe rollout practices. 

Qualifications

Qualifications - Required: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field 
 - 10+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience. 
 - Experience managing software engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development. 
 - Experience delivering and supporting production software through an engineering team, including prioritization and dependency management. -
 - Ability to explain technical decisions, risks, and alternatives to engineering partners and leaders and resolve competing requirements. 

Other Requirements

Qualifications - Other Requirements: 

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: 

- This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

data.description:
CPU Random Tools Engineer - Grade 4

Introduction to Arm

You know us. With 125 Arm-powered products shipped every second, we'll be in over a trillion smart devices by 2035. Your smartphone, award-winning VR gaming, the world's fastest supercomputer - our engineers are crafting the sophisticated core processors leading the race towards a connected, autonomous, hyper-performance future. 

ARM designs the technology that is at the heart of sophisticated digital products, from wireless, networking and consumer entertainment solutions to imaging, automotive, security and storage devices. ARM improves people's lives by enabling the intelligence in affordable, easy-to-use electronic products that transform the way we live and work. We work in partnership with a global network of leading technology companies which are using our smart low-power technology. Together we are enabling the future of a better world. 

ARM is well recognized as the market leader in the CPU and System IP industry and this has been achieved by consistently delivering reliable and high quality IP products. The cost of design and manufacturing is high and that warrants "right first time" approach for all IP and System products. Time-to-market is essential for our partners to take care of steadfast competition in the marketplace, being first would enable them to get premium value from the end products. In this context, Design Verification of CPU IPs is an exciting challenge requiring an engineering abilities that is both broad and deep. 

So, we promise you endless exciting opportunities to experiment and go even further in CPU IP design!

Job Description: Role and Responsibilities

As an Engineer responsible for CPU Random Tools for stress verification, you will work on a sophisticated Random Instruction Sequences (RIS) tool. With a combination of techniques, the tool verifies the functionality of our CPU cores, being designed in Austin (US), Cambridge (UK) or Sophia Antipolis (FR). The existing team ensures addition of new architecture features, its customization to specific CPU cores, and provides support. 

You will be based in Arm's Bangalore design centre in India. 

As Senior Verification Engineer, your role will cover the development of the tool from development to deployment, and accountable for: 

- Understanding the intricacies of the CPU micro-architecture and defining how to push the test boundaries; 
 - Architect and develop solutions to improve the generation of stimuli to produce programs to stress our next generation CPUs; 
 - Implementing and supporting the tool, from the early stages of CPU development to product maturity. 

Job Requirements

- Problem Ownership and ability to work from abstract requirements 
 - Good communication and presentation skills 
 - Self-motivated and willing to take up additional responsibilities 
 - Quick learner with a strong desire to learn and develop new skills

Qualification And Experience

- B. Tech/B. S. or MTech/M. S. in Computer/Electronics Engineering or Computer Science from a reputed institute 
 - 5-10 years of stable proven experience with significant project contributions

Crucial Skills

- You hold experience in software design, and should be comfortable working with low-level hardware 
 - You have good solid understanding of programming languages, such as C and Python 
 - You are knowledgeable about CPU architecture and micro-architecture concepts 
 - You are able to understand assembly language (ASM) 
 - You have strong interpersonal skills and ability to work well as part of a team with the willingness to tackle varied technical challenges. 

Desirable Skills

- Fundamentals of Processor Architecture. 
 - Basics of ARM Architecture. 
 - Familiarity with EDA tools and Hardware Design Verification.

Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. data.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

About Five9

Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results. 

Role Overview

To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. 

In this role you will: 

- Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics
 - Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design
 - Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale
 - Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments
 - Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers
 - Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues

Key Responsibilities

- Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure
 - Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash
 - Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico
 - Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)
 - Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes
 - Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment
 - Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e. g. , NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization

Qualifications & Skills

- 8+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
 - Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM)
 - Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico
 - Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale
 - Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet)
 - Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e. g. , F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS)
 - Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing
 - CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays
 - Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
 - Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics
 - Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives
 - Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous
 - Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture

data.title: Member of Technical Staff
data.description:
About the Company

Grey Machines is a decision intelligence platform: it lets you simulate a strategic decision before you make it. You ask a "what if" question in plain language, and the system builds a working model of that world from scratch, with its actors, feedback loops and delays, grounded in real data and cited evidence. It then plays out thousands of possible futures and shows the range of outcomes, what drives them, and a brief in which every number traces back to its source, in hours rather than the weeks a strategy team would take. It is built for strategy teams, investors and policy makers. 

The Problem

Take a question like "What happens to nickel markets if Indonesia bans ore exports?" or "What does a US-Iran escalation do to oil and LNG?" Answering it well usually takes weeks: a strategy team, a financial model, expert calls and a deck. 

Grey Machines answers it in hours. From one plain-language question, the system builds a model of that world from scratch: the actors, the stocks and flows, the feedback loops and the delays. It grounds the starting values in real data and cited evidence, then runs thousands of Monte Carlo futures, with convergence checks deciding when to stop. What comes back is an interactive causal loop diagram, the range of outcomes, and a written brief in which every number traces back to where it came from. 

It works end to end and is in private beta. Now it has to be correct, fast and reliable at scale. That is the job. 

What You Will Build

You will be the first engineer and the most senior technical person in the room, so the scope is all of engineering. You will make the architecture calls every later engineer builds on, and own the consequences. 

- The simulation core: the ODE solver, the Monte Carlo engine, sensitivity analysis, and the convergence and health checks that decide when a result can be trusted

- The model-building pipeline: frontier LLMs build the model in stages, and deterministic validators and repair loops check every step. The real work is deciding what the LLM can be trusted with, what code has to verify, and how to fail safely. 

- The data and evidence layer: values from sources such as FRED, the academic literature, the web and the documents users bring, with units, ranges and provenance that survive end to end

- The execution layer: long Monte Carlo jobs are checkpointed and resume after a restart, today on one machine. Next they need to be scheduled and run in parallel across many. 

- Production: AWS, deploys, monitoring, tracing and incident response

- The frontend when it needs you: a React 19 app with Canvas 2D and D3 visualisations that make dense quantitative output readable for a strategist, not just a quant

- The engineering bar: testing, review and release discipline, and hiring the team that comes after you

Who You Are

- You have built systems from zero, not just shipped features into existing ones, and lived with your own architecture decisions, including the wrong ones. 

- You are fluent in Bayesian probability and statistics, stochastic processes and numerical methods: ODEs, Monte Carlo and convergence diagnostics. A PhD is not required. Being able to reason about what the numbers mean is. 

- You write production code fast, debug carefully and care when it is wrong. Production experience with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL and React is required: the codebase is built on them. 

- You have run LLMs in production: structured output, prompt caching, multi-stage pipelines and the failure modes that only show up there. 

- You write clearly. We work remotely and asynchronously, so your design docs and code reviews are how you work. 

Strong Signals

None of these is required. They are backgrounds that tend to fit. 

- A year or two at a quantitative trading firm (Jane Street, Hudson River Trading, Tower Research, Graviton or similar)

- Your own startup, including one that did not work out. We care about what you learned. 

- A maths, CS, physics or statistics degree from a school these firms hire from

- Multi-tenant SaaS or high-throughput compute pipelines

- CTO, Staff or Principal Engineer experience at an early-stage company

What It Is Honestly Like

We are an early-stage startup, and we would rather say so up front. 

- Priorities move. Something you build this month may be thrown away next month because we learned something. 

- There is no team behind you yet. You will check your own blind spots and make calls with incomplete information. 

- Some weeks will feel like a drawdown. We want someone who stays steady through the good weeks and the bad ones, and treats uncertainty as part of the job. 

In return you get real ownership, founder-level say in the product and the company, and a genuinely hard applied-maths problem. Fully remote, flexible hours.

You own what we propose to our customers and what we deliver to them. That means owning the technical solution end to end - understanding the requirement, designing the approach, preparing the proposal, defending it in front of the customer, and then standing behind it when it goes into delivery. 

It also means owning the commercial outcome of the technology business and deciding how the technology organisation should be structured as it grows. You will have the mandate to shape the team, the practices, and the technical standards we hold ourselves to.

data.title: Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement
data.description:
Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement

Intelligent Command Centre (ICC) & Transformation Lead - all towers

Tower: Cross-tower: Performance, Governance & Continuous Improvement

Location: Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

Reports to: HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

Role type: People manager

Scope: Intelligent Command Centre, SLA and KPI governance, continuous improvement portfolio, transition PMO support and hub quality management

ABOUT THE HUB

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 

ROLE PURPOSE

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Transition and shared services set-up

- Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers. 
 - Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point. 
 - Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave. 
 - Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting. 2. Process ownership and service delivery

- Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W. 
 - Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders. 
 - Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight. 
 - Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions. 3. Governance, risk and controls

- Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers. 
 - Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions. 
 - Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth. 4. Continuous improvement and digital

- Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO. 
 - Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings. 
 - Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking. 
 - Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas. 5. People leadership, performance and culture

- Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. 
 - Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. 
 - Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. 
 - Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. 
 - Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. 
 - Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off. 
 - By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running. 
 - Within 12-18 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders. 

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Hub-wide SLA adherence: ≥ 95% across towers

Validated CI benefits: Annual savings and hours released against target

Automation hours released: Increased year on year

Reporting timeliness and accuracy: 100% on schedule

Hub CSAT / NPS: At or above target

Audit and quality findings: Closed within agreed timelines

CI participation: % of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement

Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 

TECHNICAL SKILLS

- Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services. 
 - Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis. 
 - Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage. 
 - Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI). 
 - ITIL service level management and quality management systems. 
 - Benefits realisation and business case development. 

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

• Customer-centric leadership

• Builds teams from zero

• Drives change and adoption

• Sound judgement under pressure

• Influences without authority across countries

• Data-led decision making

• Coaches and develops talent

• Holds a high bar on control

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

Essential

- 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles. 
 - Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function. 
 - Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. 
 - Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field. Preferred

- Transition PMO experience
 - Process mining certification
 - Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent)

KEY STAKEHOLDERS

Hub Director, all tower GPOs, Global HR leadership, HR technology and data teams, Finance, Internal Audit, transformation partners.

PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe's products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share. Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture: 

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you're excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

Job Description

Are you passionate about maintaining the reliability and performance of one of worlds largest fintech

infrastructure? We are seeking a skilled SRE - System Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal

candidate will have a solid foundation in Linux/Unix administration and networking, along with a keen

understanding of open source technologies, tools, and cloud services. Join us to ensure our services

remain always-up and always-available. 

Qualifications

Key Requirements: 

- Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration, coupled with extensive experience in the field. 
 - Computer networking proficiency and working knowledge. 
 - Utilize a wide variety of open source technologies and tools, with a strong emphasis on cloud services. 
 - Implement best practices and IT operations to maintain an always-up, always-available service. 
 - Participate actively in the on-call rotation schedule. 
 - Communicate effectively in English. 
 - Display a strong background in Linux networking, including the use of IP, iptables, and IPsec. 
 - Work with MySQL databases effectively. Working experience in Mariadb, Percona will be a plus. 
 - Understand and apply coding and scripting skills, with a preference for Perl, python or Golang. 
 - Experience with automation and configuration management, using tools like SaltStack. 
 - Hands-on experience with private cloud environments. 

Desirable Skills: 

- Experience with implementing cloud services on Linux using KVM/QEMU. 
 - Familiarity with container orchestration technology. 
 - Knowledge of NoSQL databases, especially Aerospike. 
 - Proficiency in Perl and Golang. 
 - Understanding of Galera cluster operations. 
 - Experience with data center related activities. 

If you are an enthusiastic team player with a robust technical background, eager to tackle challenges and

contribute to the success of our operations, we would love to hear from you!

data.description:
Position: Senior Production Engineer - Injection Molding

Department: Production - Injection Molding

Reporting To: Head - Production

Team: Leads the Injection Molding Line Engineers across shifts

Location: Hosur, Tamil Nadu

Role Purpose

Own the safe, on-time and high-quality output of the injection molding shop floor at our office chair manufacturing plant by leading the Line Engineers, driving OEE and cycle-time improvement, reducing defects and downtime, and building a strong, skilled molding team. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Team Leadership & People Development: 

- Lead, guide and review the performance of Line Engineers across all shifts; allocate lines, machines and responsibilities. 
 - Set clear shift-wise goals and KPIs for Line Engineers and hold them accountable for results. 
 - Train and mentor Line Engineers on machine settings, defect diagnosis, safety and quality checks; build multi-skilled backups. 
 - Ensure disciplined shift handovers and effective supervision of operators, helpers and technicians through the Line Engineers. 

2. Production Planning & Delivery: 

- Convert daily and weekly production schedules into shift-wise targets and ensure plan adherence. 
 - Plan machine-mold allocation and capacity utilization; flag material, mold or manpower constraints early. 
 - Review daily production reports, track plan vs actual and drive corrective actions for gaps. 

3. Process Optimization & OEE: 

- Own OEE, cycle time, rejection and scrap for the molding shop and drive continuous improvement. 
 - Standardize process parameters and machine setting sheets; approve and control any parameter changes. 
 - Reduce mold changeover time and downtime through structured planning and SMED practices. 

4. Mold, Machine & Maintenance Coordination: 

- Oversee mold changeovers and ensure they are executed with minimal downtime. 
 - Coordinate with the tool room for preventive maintenance, minor repairs and resolution of mold issues such as alignment, temperature variation and venting. 
 - Coordinate with the maintenance team for preventive and breakdown maintenance of machines, chillers and ancillary equipment. 

5. Quality, Material & Defect Management

- Lead root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for defects such as flash, short shots, sink marks, warping and burn marks. 
 - Work with the QC team on first-part approvals, batch audits and corrective actions. 
 - Ensure correct material loading (PP, PPGF, Nylon, ABS, etc. ) with proper drying and temperature control. 
 - Ensure traceability of material lots and batches for every production order. 

6. Trials, NPD & Continuous Improvement

- Lead trials for new molds, designs and materials in collaboration with design/NPD and the tool room. 
 - Drive Kaizen activities, process audits and waste elimination initiatives across the molding shop. 

7. Safety & Compliance

- Ensure safe working practices, 5S and adherence to SOPs and work instructions on the molding floor. 
 - Maintain production, downtime and quality records and present regular performance reviews to management. 

Requirements

- Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Production or Plastics Engineering; CIPET qualified candidates preferred. 
 - 3+ years of experience in injection molding, including team-handling experience. 
 - Proven experience in plastic part manufacturing (furniture, automotive or consumer goods); experience with office chair or furniture components is an advantage. 
 - Strong understanding of plastic flow behavior and defect diagnosis (warpage, sink, flash, etc. ). 
 - Hands-on knowledge of materials such as PP, PPGF, Nylon and ABS, and of basic mold/tooling. 
 - Ability to interpret technical drawings. 
 - Working knowledge of OEE, Lean/Kaizen and root cause analysis. 
 - Strong leadership, shift-management and communication skills. 

Key KPIs

- OEE
 - Production plan adherence
 - Cycle-time adherence
 - Rejection and scrap %
 - Mold changeover time
 - Machine and mold downtime
 - First-pass yield
 - Safety and 5S compliance

data.title: Avionics Hardware Lead
data.description:
Company Overview

At Cosmoserve Space, we are pioneering a cleaner, more sustainable future for space exploration through innovative technology focused on active debris removal. Our mission is to safeguard the orbital environment by developing high-tech, cost-effective solutions that lead the market in addressing the growing challenge of space debris. With a passionate team of engineers and a commitment to cutting-edge engineering, Cosmoserve is driving the next generation of responsible space activities, ensuring that the space remains accessible for future missions. 

Position: Avionics Hardware Lead

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports To: CEO

Location: Financial District, Hyderabad, Telangana

Job Summary

We are looking for an Avionics Hardware Lead to own the onboard electronics of our spacecraft, from system specification to tested flight hardware. The role covers defining avionics requirements from mission goals and designing microcontroller-based circuits, power electronics and subsystem interfaces. The Lead will drive circuit simulation, PCB layout, component selection and testing, and ensure every board meets space-grade quality and reliability standards. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Lead will head a team of engineers, set design and documentation standards, and work closely with the GNC, AIT and QA teams to deliver reliable hardware on schedule. 

Key Responsibilities

•  Translate mission and system goals into clear avionics system specifications. 

•  Lead design and development of electronic circuits built around microcontrollers. 

•  Run circuit simulations and review PCB layouts before fabrication. 

•  Select, design and test low-power DC-DC converters and power distribution circuits. 

•  Define and implement interfaces between avionics units over serial and parallel buses, with signal conditioning using op-amps and current-to-voltage converters. 

•  Select components suitable for space applications, including qualified use of industrial-grade parts. 

•  Apply QA practices in line with MIL-STD-883, ISO and AS9100 requirements. 

•  Prepare and maintain design documents, test procedures and reports. 

•  Lead, mentor and review the work of a team of avionics engineers. 

Qualifications

Education: BE / B. Tech or M. Tech in ECE or EEE with specialisation in Electronics / Instrumentation. 

Work Experience: 8 to 10 years

Required Skill Set (Major)

•        Experience in design and development of electronic circuits with microcontrollers. 

•        Experience in preparing system specifications for system goals and functions. 

•        Good knowledge of circuit simulation in KiCad, PSpice or similar tools. 

•        Knowledge of PCB layout. 

•        Knowledge of power electronics such as low-power DC-DC converters, including selection and testing. 

•        Good knowledge of interfacing various avionics systems using serial or parallel buses, op-amps, current-to-voltage converters, etc. 

•        Knowledge of QA aspects related to MIL 1553 STD, ISO and AS standards. 

•        Good knowledge of component selection for space applications. 

•        Knowledge of building systems for space using industrial-grade components. 

•        Experience in leading a team of engineers. 

•        Good documentation aptitude. 

•          Added Advantage

1.       General knowledge of space systems for satellite building. 

2.       Firmware knowledge

Required Soft Skills

•          Ability to lead, guide and motivate a team of engineers. 

•          Strong sense of ownership from design through to testing. 

•          Clear communication with engineers, management and vendors. 

•          Works well with GNC, mechanical, AIT and QA teams. 

•          Methodical approach to debugging and root cause analysis. 

•          High attention to detail and discipline in following quality processes. 

•          Good planning and prioritisation in a fast-paced startup. 

•          Adaptable to changing requirements and limited resources. 

•          Willing to mentor juniors and give constructive design reviews.

data.title: Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems - Roofsol Energy
data.description:
Job Description - Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems

Company: Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. 

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra

Department: Technology / Digital Solutions

Experience: Approximately 10 years

Employment Type: Full-time

About Roofsol Energy

Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. operates in the solar energy sector, developing and managing solar projects across India. The company has invested in multiple solar projects under the OPEX (CAPEX-free / RESCO) business model, where continuous monitoring of generation, plant performance, equipment health, and operational efficiency is essential. 

As part of its technology development strategy, Roofsol Energy intends to establish its own end-to-end solar monitoring ecosystem, including proprietary data loggers, IoT-based data acquisition systems, cloud infrastructure, and a centralized solar generation monitoring platform. The objective is to develop and own the underlying technology and Intellectual Property (IP), while ensuring reliable monitoring and management of a large portfolio of distributed solar projects across India. 

  

Role Overview

Roofsol Energy is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead the conceptualization, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of an in-house solar data logging and generation monitoring system. 

  

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy and Technology Development

·            Define the technology roadmap for Roofsol Energy's proprietary solar monitoring and data acquisition ecosystem. 

·            Lead the end-to-end development of the monitoring platform, from product architecture and prototype development to commercial deployment. 

·            Evaluate appropriate hardware, communication protocols, software frameworks, cloud technologies, and system architectures. 

·            Develop solutions suitable for both small rooftop solar installations and large distributed solar portfolios. 

2. Data Logger and IoT Hardware Development

·            Lead the design, development, prototyping, testing, and deployment of in-house solar data logging equipment. 

·            Develop expertise in integrating inverters, energy meters, weather sensors, and other plant equipment using protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485, Ethernet, and MQTT, as applicable. 

·            Ensure reliable data acquisition, local buffering, time synchronization, remote configuration, and recovery during network or power outages. 

·            Establish hardware validation, field testing, quality assurance, and lifecycle management processes. 

3. Cloud Platform and Software Development

·            Lead the architecture and development of a centralized cloud-based solar monitoring platform. 

·            Establish scalable infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing data from hundreds of geographically distributed solar installations. 

·            Oversee the development of dashboards, plant-level monitoring screens, portfolio-level reporting, alerts, notifications, and automated performance reports. 

·            Ensure integration with existing business systems, maintenance workflows, and third-party equipment where required. 

·            Establish high availability, disaster recovery, backup, cybersecurity, and system performance standards. 

  

4. Solar Generation Monitoring and Analytics

·            Develop real-time and historical solar generation monitoring capabilities. 

·            Establish monitoring of energy generation, plant availability, equipment health, communication failures, and performance deviations. 

·            Enable automated alerts for generation losses, inverter faults, abnormal operating conditions, and data gaps. 

·            Support performance analysis through relevant metrics such as specific yield, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, and actual-versus-expected generation, where applicable. 

  

5. Intellectual Property and Technology Ownership

·            Build and maintain Roofsol Energy's proprietary technology stack, including hardware designs, firmware, software source code, system architecture, technical documentation, and associated IP. 

·            Establish appropriate IP ownership, confidentiality, source-code control, licensing, and third-party technology compliance practices. 

  

6. Team Leadership and Vendor Management

·            Build and lead a multidisciplinary team covering embedded systems, electronics, firmware, IoT, cloud engineering, software development, and data analytics. 

·            Evaluate and manage technology vendors, hardware manufacturers, system integrators, and development partners. 

  

Candidate Profile

·            Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, IoT, or a related technical discipline. 

·            Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, industrial data acquisition, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, or related technology domains. 

·            Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying connected hardware and software products, preferably from concept through production and field deployment. 

·            Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, cybersecurity, remote device management, and scalable system architecture. 

·            Knowledge of solar PV systems, inverter communications, energy meters, generation monitoring, and renewable energy analytics will be highly advantageous. 

  

  

Why Join Roofsol Energy?

  This is an opportunity to establish a proprietary technology platform from the ground up and take ownership of a strategic digital initiative within the renewable energy sector. The selected professional will have the opportunity to shape the company's technology roadmap, develop in-house IP, and build a scalable monitoring ecosystem supporting a growing portfolio of solar assets across India. 

Interested candidates may share their updated CV highlighting relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, and technology ownership.

data.title: Design Verification - Technical Leader
data.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Digital Verification Engineer to take on a Technical Leader role within our Imaging verification team. The candidate will drive verification strategy and closure for complex digital IPs in imaging and automotive subsystems, mentor junior engineers, and act as the technical point of contact for verification across cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end verification strategy, planning, and closure for one or more complex IPs/subsystems. 
 - Architect and review UVM-based verification environments, ensuring reusability and scalability across projects. 
 - Drive functional and code coverage closure; define coverage models and identify verification gaps early in the cycle. 
 - Lead protocol-level verification efforts (e. g. , I3C, MIPI, AMBA), including VIP evaluation, integration, and debug. 
 - Apply the use of formal verification techniques (e. g. , JasperGold) to complement simulation-based verification, particularly for FSM and control-logic-heavy blocks. 
 - Review test plans, testbenches, and verification collateral authored by team members; provide technical guidance on methodology and debug approaches. 
 - Interface with design, architecture, DFT, and software teams to clarify specification ambiguities and drive design-for-verification practices. 
 - Identify and resolve spec ambiguities/errata; work with IP/protocol working groups where applicable. 
 - Mentor and technically guide junior verification engineers; support their ramp-up on tools, methodology, and protocols. 
 - Drive process improvements: regression infrastructure, debug efficiency, coverage methodology, and verification reuse. 
 - Communicate verification status, risks, and closure plans to management and stakeholders. 
 - Support root-cause analysis of silicon/post-silicon issues traced back to verification gaps, where relevant. 

Required Skills

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (VLSI specialization preferred). 
 - 5-7 years of experience in digital design/IP verification, with demonstrated ownership of verification closure for at least one complex IP or subsystem. 
 - Strong expertise in System Verilog and UVM methodology - testbench architecture, sequences, scoreboards, and reference models. 
 - Proven experience with functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion-based verification (SVA); ability to define coverage models from specification. 
 - Hands-on experience with industry-standard simulation tools (VCS, Xcelium, or Questa) and debug tools. 
 - Experience with formal verification tools and methodology (e. g. , JasperGold) for FSM, connectivity, or control-logic verification. 
 - Solid understanding of one or more protocols such as I3C, I2C, SPI, AMBA, MIPI-CSI, or similar interconnect/interface standards, including VIP-based verification. 
 - Strong scripting skills (Python, Perl, or TCL) for automation, flow development, and regression management. 
 - Ability to read and interpret design specifications, RTL, and identify verification risk areas independently. 

Preferred / Good To Have

- Experience mentoring or technically leading a small team of verification engineers. 
 - Exposure to mutation testing or other coverage-quality assessment techniques. 
 - Familiarity with low-power verification (UPF/CPF) and Gate Level simulations. 
 - Experience working with EDA vendors (e. g. , Cadence, Synopsys) for tool/methodology support and issue resolution. 
 - Prior contribution to internal verification methodology documents, guidelines, or reusable verification IP (VIP) development. 
 - Experience working in a globally distributed team environment. 

Soft Skills

- Strong technical leadership and mentoring ability. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous or under-specified requirements. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills - able to present technical status and risk clearly to management. 
 - Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive closure under deadlines. 
 - Collaborative approach to working with design, architecture, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML assisted verification techniques to improve verification productivity and efficiency. 

What We Offer

- A technical leadership track with visibility into IP-level and subsystem-level verification strategy. 
 - Opportunity to shape verification methodology, including formal and protocol verification practices. 
 - Mentorship and people-development opportunities within a growing team. 
 - Exposure to advanced verification domains including formal verification and next-generation Security IP and systems. 
 - Collaborative, cross-functional work environment with global teams. 

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. 

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 

To discover more, visit st. com/careers.

data.title: Senior Manager, Applied Science
data.description:
About Tekion

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3, 000 people across North America, Asia and Europe. 

Summary

Responsible for leading advanced applied science initiatives that drive innovation, optimize business outcomes, and expand the capabilities of data-driven products and services. This role requires strategic oversight, technical excellence, and the ability to translate scientific advancements into real-world applications. It involves cross-functional collaboration, mentoring, and execution of complex machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions. 

Duties & Responsibilities

- Lead a team of applied scientists and machine learning engineers in developing and deploying advanced models and algorithms. 
 - Drive the technical vision, research agenda, and roadmap for applied science initiatives aligned with business priorities. 
 - Oversee experimentation, evaluation, and deployment of machine learning models into production environments. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to integrate models into scalable systems. 
 - Champion best practices in scientific rigor, experimentation, reproducibility, and responsible AI. 
 - Mentor team members and foster a high-performance culture grounded in innovation and continuous learning. 
 - Monitor project progress, remove blockers, and ensure delivery of high-impact outcomes on time and within scope. 
 - Represent the applied science function in executive and strategic planning discussions. 

Qualifications

- PhD or Master's degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field. 
 - 12+ years of experience in applied science or machine learning roles, including at least 3 years in a management role. 
 - Proven experience building and deploying ML models in production systems. 
 - Deep understanding of supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning techniques. 
 - Strong coding skills in Python and proficiency with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills. 
 - Experience managing complex technical projects and delivering measurable business impact. 

Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

data.title: Platform Engineering Lead
data.description:
We are seeking an experienced Platform Engineering Lead to join the Enterprise Data Platform team in Pune. The role focuses on leading the design and delivery of scalable, cloud-native data and platform capabilities, driving strategic technology decisions, and enabling teams to build secure, high-performing platforms that accelerate innovation across the organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and delivery of distributed, event-driven, and data-intensive systems into production environments. 
 - Drive platform engineering initiatives across cloud-native services, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and secure-by-design architecture. 
 - Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and best practices. 
 - Influence architecture, security, product, and delivery stakeholders to drive pragmatic technology outcomes. 
 - Navigate governance frameworks and regulatory requirements in a complex enterprise environment. 
 - Champion automation-first mindset and production-grade engineering practices across platform delivery. 
 - Build and promote reusable self-service platform capabilities, onboarding models, and integration frameworks. 
 - Oversee observability, alerting, incident handling, resilience, and continuous improvement for business-critical platforms. 
 - Ensure solutions meet Barclays standards for Security, Data Privacy, Resilience, and Operational Risk. 

Required Skills

Platform & Data Engineering

- Proven software engineering experience designing and delivering distributed, event-driven, or data-intensive systems into production. 
 - Strong engineering judgement and automation-first mindset enabling robust, scalable, and efficient technology solutions. 
 - Strong expertise in cloud-native services, infrastructure as code, and scalable platform patterns. 
 - Deep understanding of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and secure-by-design architecture principles. 
 - Experience with production-grade engineering practices driving reliable and secure platform delivery at scale. 
 - Knowledge of platform resilience, recovery strategies, and operational excellence. 

Technical Leadership

- Demonstrated technical leadership experience in regulated or complex enterprise environments. 
 - Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to influence architecture, security, product, and delivery stakeholders. 
 - Experience guiding and mentoring engineering teams through complex technical challenges. 
 - Ability to navigate governance frameworks and drive alignment between business objectives and technology execution. 
 - Strong engineering judgement with focus on pragmatic, scalable solutions. 

Engineering Practices

- Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile/Scrum methodologies. 
 - Commitment to secure coding, code quality, and engineering best practices. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to resolve complex production issues. 
 - Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident management. 

Preferred Skills

- Proficiency in containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker and container runtime management. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including deployment strategies, scaling, troubleshooting, and Helm chart management. 
 - Expertise in Infrastructure as Code tools such as CloudFormation and Terraform for provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure. 
 - Hands-on exposure to streaming and data platform technologies such as Kafka, Kafka Streams, Flink, Schema Registry, event schemas, connectors, or real-time data pipelines. 
 - Production operations experience covering observability, alerting, incident handling, resilience, recovery, and continuous improvement for business-critical platforms. 
 - Experience creating reusable self-service platform capabilities, onboarding models, or integration frameworks that enable teams to adopt platform services safely and efficiently. 
 - Experience with AWS Cloud Services and cloud-native application development. 

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The role is based out of Pune. 

Purpose of the role

To build and maintain the systems that collect, store, process, and analyse data, such as data pipelines, data warehouses and data lakes to ensure that all data is accurate, accessible, and secure. 

Accountabilities

- Build and maintenance of data architectures pipelines that enable the transfer and processing of durable, complete and consistent data. 
 - Design and implementation of data warehoused and data lakes that manage the appropriate data volumes and velocity and adhere to the required security measures. 
 - Development of processing and analysis algorithms fit for the intended data complexity and volumes. 
 - Collaboration with data scientist to build and deploy machine learning models. 

Vice President Expectations

- To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures. . 
 - If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department's future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements. . 
 - If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. . 
 - OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions. . 
 - Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment. 
 - Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda. 
 - Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does. 
 - Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business. 
 - Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies. 
 - Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions. 
 - Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes. 
 - Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes. 

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship - our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset - to Empower, Challenge and Drive - the operating manual for how we behave.
