We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we are saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is establishing a Foundational APIs capability to make core business data and functionality easier to access securely, consistently, and reliably across our products and solutions. 

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a central role in shaping this capability. You will help define and build stable, reusable API contracts that enable product experiences, integrations, workflows, clients, and approved AI solutions to interact with SimCorp's business capabilities without needing to understand the complexity of the underlying systems. 

This is not a role focused only on defining standards or producing architecture. You will work hands-on with engineers, architects, product leaders, domain experts, and existing platform teams to turn technical direction into production-quality software. You will help the team reuse existing API infrastructure and domain capabilities where appropriate, progressively abstract legacy implementations, and avoid creating unnecessary layers or duplication. 

You will join a newly established team in India and help deliver its first production capabilities. The role provides an opportunity to influence architecture, engineering practices, technical direction, and the way API capabilities are developed and adopted across SimCorp. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

- Lead the technical design and implementation of SimCorp's Foundational APIs. 
 - Work hands-on with engineering teams to build secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable services using C#/. NET and Microsoft Azure. 
 - Translate real consumer and business needs into focused API capabilities with clear outcomes and measurable release criteria. 
 - Design stable and reusable API contracts that represent meaningful business capabilities rather than exposing the complexity of underlying systems. 
 - Collaborate with domain experts to establish clear and consistent meaning for shared concepts such as portfolios, positions, transactions, cash, instruments, and settlement information. 
 - Evaluate and make pragmatic decisions across REST, GraphQL, messaging, and other integration approaches based on the needs of each capability. 
 - Make API behavior explicit across business dates, data freshness, pagination, filtering, precision, missing information, partial results, and error handling. 
 - Design for distributed-system concerns including latency, partial failures, retries, idempotency, concurrency, resilience, and source-system availability. 
 - Help separate stable consumer contracts from underlying implementations so that systems can evolve or be progressively replaced without unnecessary consumer impact. 
 - Assess and reuse existing API frameworks, gateways, services, integration solutions, and domain capabilities before introducing new abstractions or infrastructure. 
 - Work with legacy systems and supported interfaces, using adapters and incremental modernization patterns where appropriate. 
 - Contribute directly to critical implementation areas, technical spikes, reference implementations, automated tests, deployment pipelines, and complex problem resolution. 
 - Establish and promote engineering practices covering clean code, automated testing, contract testing, compatibility validation, security, observability, CI/CD, and production readiness. 
 - Review architecture, technical designs, and code, providing constructive feedback that raises the engineering quality of the team. 
 - Lead by example, helping engineers decompose complex problems into incremental, testable, and releasable capabilities. 
 - Create reusable implementation patterns, templates, documentation, and examples that make it easier for other teams to contribute consistently. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Management, Architecture, Platform, Security, Data, and domain engineering teams across SimCorp. 
 - Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, dependencies, limitations, and risks clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. 
 - Mentor engineers and strengthen technical leadership within the team through design discussions, pairing, code reviews, and practical engineering guidance. 
 - Continuously learn and develop yourself, the team, and the Foundational APIs capability. 

What We Value

- Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed is less important. We expect you to be strong in several of the following areas and interested in learning the rest: 
 - Extensive experience designing and building production software using C# and . NET. 
 - Strong experience with Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architecture, and Azure DevOps. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and developing REST APIs and distributed services. 
 - Experience with GraphQL, messaging, or event-driven architecture is valuable, but not mandatory. 
 - Strong understanding of API design principles, including contract design, versioning, backward compatibility, pagination, filtering, error handling, and documentation. 
 - Experience building observable and supportable services using logs, metrics, tracing, health monitoring, and operational diagnostics. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed-system challenges such as latency, resilience, partial failure, concurrency, idempotency, consistency, and safe retry behavior. 
 - Experience creating and managing CI/CD pipelines and automated quality controls. 
 - Strong automated-testing skills, including unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience with relational databases and SQL. 
 - Experience applying Domain-Driven Design or similar techniques to define clear business capabilities and service boundaries. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy systems through adapters, incremental refactoring, progressive migration, or cloud adoption. 
 - Ability to simplify complex architectures and create maintainable solutions without introducing unnecessary abstraction. 
 - Ability to evaluate existing systems and frameworks critically before deciding to build something new. 
 - Strong architectural judgment combined with the willingness and ability to contribute hands-on to implementation. 
 - Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term maintainability, reliability, and contract stability. 
 - Ability to mentor and guide engineers toward technical excellence and effective delivery without becoming a bottleneck for decisions. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across product, business, architecture, and engineering domains. 
 - Experience working in a multinational product-development organization. 
 - Interest in learning the investment-management domain and understanding the business meaning behind the APIs being developed. 
 - Readiness to learn relevant SimCorp technologies, frameworks, and legacy environments where required. 
 - An M. Sc. or Ph. D. in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field is valuable but not essential. 
 - Good English communication skills, both written and spoken. 

AI-ENABLED DEVELOPMENT

- Use approved AI tools fluently as part of everyday engineering, discovery, development, testing, and documentation workflows. 
 - Critically evaluate AI-generated code, designs, tests, and documentation for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit. 
 - Help the team use AI responsibly, including understanding when AI-generated output can accelerate delivery and when deeper engineering review is required. 
 - Identify opportunities where AI can reduce low-value work, improve developer productivity, and accelerate prototyping and technical discovery. 
 - Help ensure that APIs intended for approved AI consumers apply the same identity, authorization, business rules, auditability, and operational controls as other consumers. 

FURTHERMORE, WE VALUE THAT YOU

- Are curious about complex business and technical problems and willing to examine assumptions before proposing a solution. 
 - Are comfortable working in an evolving area where business meaning, source-system ownership, implementation, and priorities may be distributed across multiple teams. 
 - Can influence technical direction across organizational boundaries without relying solely on formal authority. 
 - Take ownership of outcomes and remain engaged from discovery through implementation and production operation. 
 - Challenge unnecessary complexity and help teams focus on the smallest useful capability that can be validated with a real consumer. 
 - Learn through experimentation and use insights from both successes and failures to improve future decisions. 
 - Can identify technical debt, architectural risk, and operational weaknesses and help the team address them deliberately. 
 - Value collaboration and knowledge sharing and actively help other engineers grow. 
 - Combine strong technical opinions with openness to evidence, alternative perspectives, and changing circumstances. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy: We ask you to work two days a week from the office. You may work remotely on the other days or work from the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture: An inclusive and diverse company culture where different perspectives and expertise are valued. 
 - Work-life balance: We believe that a sustainable balance between professional and personal responsibilities helps everyone perform at their best. 
 - Empowerment: We believe all voices are valuable and should be heard. You will be involved in shaping our technical direction and ways of working. 
 - Career and growth: SimCorp provides opportunities for professional development and supports individual career paths based on your strengths and aspirations. 
 - Innovation: You will have opportunities to contribute to engineering improvements, technical modernization, and strategic capabilities with impact across SimCorp. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English through our career site as soon as possible. We assess applications continuously, and only applications submitted through our system can be processed. 

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur during recruitment. To support fairness and equal opportunity for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal information such as photographs, age, or other non-professional details from your application. 

If you are interested in joining SimCorp but are unsure whether this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you identify suitable opportunities. 

We continuously seek to improve our talent-acquisition process and make every candidate's experience positive and valuable. During the process, we may ask you to provide feedback, which will be highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a leading provider of integrated investment-management solutions. Our colleagues represent a broad range of nationalities, educational backgrounds, professional experiences, and perspectives. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. Following the merger with Axioma, we combine the strengths of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other status protected under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. 

We believe in the continuous growth and development of our employees so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer – File System
data.description:
Role Overview

Nasuni is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to help define and build the next generation of our distributed file data platform. This role sits within the File System team, responsible for the core storage architecture powering Nasuni's cloud-native file platform. 

You will provide technical leadership across distributed file system architecture, storage protocols, metadata services, data protection, and Kubernetes-based infrastructure. You will influence long-term platform direction while remaining close enough to the technology to solve some of the most complex systems challenges in enterprise storage. 

This role is ideal for engineers who thrive at the intersection of distributed systems, performance engineering, cloud-native infrastructure, and large-scale storage platforms. 

This role is not intended for engineers focused primarily on application development, front-end technologies, or isolated feature delivery. 

This role is located at Nasuni's Hyderabad Office - Hybrid 3 Days Onsite per week. 

Level & Scope Definition

You Will

- Own architectural decisions spanning multiple subsystems
 - Lead technical strategy for distributed storage and file services
 - Drive platform scalability, resilience, and operational excellence
 - Influence engineering standards across multiple teams
 - Mentor senior engineers and technical leaders
 - Balance long-term architecture investments with near-term delivery goals

Responsibilities

- Define architecture and technical direction for Nasuni's distributed file system platform
 - Lead design and implementation of core storage services including metadata, snapshots, caching, replication, and recovery
 - Drive evolution of NFS, SMB, and S3 access services
 - Establish scalability, performance, and reliability standards across the platform
 - Partner with Platform, Control Plane, Security, and Infrastructure teams on system-wide initiatives
 - Guide architectural reviews and technical decision-making
 - Lead resolution of complex production and performance challenges
 - Improve engineering productivity through automation, observability, and modern development practices
 - Utilize AI-assisted engineering workflows where appropriate to accelerate development, troubleshooting, analysis, documentation, and testing while maintaining accountability for quality and security
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to technical talent development

Expected Outcomes & Impact

- Improve platform scalability and resilience for enterprise workloads
 - Influence multi-year architecture decisions across the storage platform
 - Reduce operational complexity through automation and platform improvements
 - Accelerate engineering velocity while maintaining reliability standards
 - Raise technical excellence across the File System organization

Qualifications

Must Have

- 12+ years of software engineering experience focused on systems programming
 - Deep expertise in C and C++
 - Significant experience designing distributed systems at scale
 - Strong understanding of file system internals, POSIX semantics, VFS, metadata services, and storage architectures
 - Experience with Kubernetes-based distributed platforms
 - Experience leading architecture decisions across multiple engineering teams
 - Experience with NFS, SMB, S3, or related storage protocols
 - Proven ownership of large-scale technical initiatives from design through production

Preferred

- Experience with cloud-native storage platforms
 - Linux kernel, FUSE, or eBPF experience
 - Consensus systems and distributed coordination
 - High availability architectures
 - Performance engineering and storage benchmarking
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and technical leads

Ideal

- Experience building enterprise-scale file systems
 - Contributions to storage, distributed systems, or infrastructure platforms used by large customer environments
 - Experience establishing engineering standards across organizations
 - AI workflow optimization experience for software development and platform engineering

Experience Guidelines

- 10-15+ years total software engineering experience
 - 7+ years in distributed systems, storage, or infrastructure engineering
 - 3+ years leading architecture or technical direction across multiple teams

AI at Nasuni

AI at Nasuni is used to improve efficiency, decision-making, and engineering outcomes. In this role, you will be expected to leverage AI tools for code generation, debugging, architecture analysis, documentation, testing, and workflow automation while applying strong engineering judgment, validation, security awareness, and ownership. AI is a productivity multiplier, not a substitute for technical expertise. 

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams-and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform-turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, and AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration. 

Why Work at Nasuni - Hyderabad / India

With Vista Equity Partners' backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders-cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities-combining the pace of a fast-growing company with the scale and resources of a global technology investor. You'll innovate at the intersection of cloud, AI, and enterprise data infrastructure, collaborate with talented teams, and build modern platforms trusted by enterprises worldwide. Join us in Hyderabad and help shape the future of intelligent, AI-ready data management. 

Benefits

As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers competitive benefits designed to support every stage of your life and career: 

- Competitive compensation programs
 - Flexible time off and leave policies
 - Comprehensive health and wellness coverage
 - Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
 - Employee referral and recognition programs
 - Professional development and learning support
 - Inclusive, collaborative team culture
 - Modern office spaces with team events and perks
 - Retirement and statutory benefits as per Indian regulations

To all recruitment agencies: Nasuni does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job boards, Nasuni employees or any other company location. Nasuni is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 

Nasuni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every team member can thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, or any other status protected by applicable laws in India or the country of employment. 

This privacy notice relates to information collected (whether online or offline) by Nasuni Corporation and our corporate affiliates (collectively, "Nasuni") from or about you in your capacity as a Nasuni employee, independent contractor/service provider or as an applicant for an employment or contractor relationship with Nasuni.

data.title: Senior Quant Developer - Algorithmic Trading
data.description:
About BestEx Research

BestEx Research is a financial technology and research firm specializing in building sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools servicing multiple asset classes. The firm provides high-performance algorithmic execution services to hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through a traditional electronic broker and in a broker-neutral Software as a Service (SaaS) model. 

Its cloud-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is the first end-to-end algorithmic trading solution for equities and futures that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), an algorithm customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre-trade analytics in a single platform. The platform is currently live for U. S. , Europe, and Canadian equities and global futures trading. 

BestEx Research is disrupting a $100 billion industry by challenging the status quo of stale, black-box solutions from banks and offering next-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement with transparency and customization. BestEx Research uses leading-edge technology to support its low-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems, with its backend in C++, research libraries in C++/Python and R, and web-based technologies for delivering its front-end platforms. 

BestEx Research's mission is to become the leader in automation and measurement of execution across asset classes globally and significantly reduce transaction costs for our clients. 

Visit for more information about our mission, products, research, and services. 

Why Join Us?

BestEx Research's Bangalore office is not an "offshore center. " It's a core engineering and research hub-working on the exact same problems and projects as our U. S. team. You'll be part of the global brain trust, solving some of the hardest problems in trading, systems, and data science. 

What You'll Love: 

- Zero bureaucracy, zero silos-engineers directly collaborate with traders, researchers, and the CEO
 - Direct ownership and end-to-end visibility on production systems
 - Daily opportunity to learn from pioneers in HFT, low-latency systems, and algo trading
 - A high-trust environment where performance speaks louder than hierarchy
 - Competitive compensation in India, including equity and cash bonuses
 - 5-week structured training program: 

Your Role: Build What Most Engineers Never Get to Touch

- Market microstructure and trading mechanics
 - Algorithmic execution and strategy design
 - Exchange simulators and performance testing
 - Market data systems and real-time analytics
 - Hands-on exercises using production research data
 - Continuous professional development, with refresher courses, advanced sessions, and on-demand training tailored to your growth
 - Global exposure: Opportunities to collaborate with, visit, or relocate to our U. S. , Singapore, or London offices, based on performance and business needs

You'll be part of a lean, focused team building ultra-low-latency trading systems, real-time exchange simulators, execution algorithms, and alpha forecasting models. Our engineers own the stack-from C++ nanosecond-sensitive infrastructure to Python-based research platforms. 

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of research and engineering-comfortable building systems, testing hypotheses, and working directly with data that moves markets. 

What You'll Work On

- Architect and implement: 
 - Execution algorithms across global markets
 - Exchange simulators and tick-level backtesting frameworks
 - Smart Order Routing systems across lit and dark venues
 - Models for market impact, price prediction, and volume forecasting
 - High-performance trading systems optimized for throughput and latency
 - Core infrastructure to support new asset classes and global markets
 - Collaborate closely with global quants, traders, and senior engineers
 - Analyze system performance across app, OS, and hardware layers

Requirements

You Should Have

- Bachelor's or Master's from a top-tier CS, Math, or Engineering program (IIT/NIT/BITS preferred but not required)
 - 6+ years hands-on C++ experience (C++14/17/20) in performance-sensitive applications
 - Strong fundamentals in data structures, OS, networks, and concurrency
 - Python fluency for data analysis and prototyping (preferred but not required)
 - Experience with large-scale, real-time systems (trading experience is a plus but not mandatory)
 - Passion for learning-markets, systems, and modeling

Bonus Points For

- Deep experience with TCP/IP, multi-threading, and latency optimization
 - Prior work on trading platforms, FIX engines, or exchange protocols
 - SQL optimization and experience with research or market data pipelines
 - Contributions to open-source C++/Python performance tools

Benefits

Why This Role Is Rare

- Exposure to real-time trading systems live in global markets
 - Direct mentorship from senior algorithmic trading and software engineering veterans
 - Blend of research, systems design, and algorithm development
 - Equity and cash compensation
 - Zero red tape, no outsourcing mentality

data.title: Agentic AI Automation Engineer
data.location: Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab, India
data.description:
Mid-Level AI Engineer - Agentic AI

AI-Workflow Programme | Mohali, On-Site

POSITION

We are seeking a Mid-Level AI Agentic Engineer to join the AI-Workflow programme and

build the autonomous crew systems that augment HRS operations across Finance, 

Controlling, Operations, Customer Service, Customer Experience, and HR. This is not a

research role or a prototype environment - you will be building production AI crews that

handle live operational workflows for real departments, with real outcomes measured

from day one. 

You will work within a "crews building crews" model: a platform of seven build agents (PM, 

Architect, Automation, QA, SRE, Documentation, Observability) scaffolds, tests, and

documents the operational crews you build. Your job is to close the gap between agent

scaffolded output and production-ready code - working directly with the Tech Lead, the

PM, and the build agent platform to deliver tested, instrumented, and documented crews

within a 10-day delivery lifecycle. 

The mission is workforce augmentation. AI handles the volume. Humans handle the

judgement. Every crew you build encodes that principle in every escalation boundary, 

every guardrail, and every human-in-the-loop gate. 

CHALLENGE

Crew Development & Implementation

- Build operational AI crews from structured To-Be process descriptions using DSPy

typed signatures with assertion guards and agent workflow orchestration patterns

such as state machines, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and resumable execution

- Implement N8N workflow automation and JSON integration connectors linking

crews to operational systems including Zammad, Genesys, and enterprise back

office platforms

- Work directly with the Automation Agent to scaffold DSPy modules and agent

workflows - extending and improving generated output, not accepting it verbatim

- Design and encode specific, testable escalation boundaries for every crew before

shadow deployment - grounded in real process context, not generic confidence

thresholds

- Deliver every crew with 100% unit test coverage, a complete runbook, and New

Relic instrumentation live before go-live - these are deployment gates, not

aspirational standards

- Contribute reusable patterns to the shared crew library and peer-review modules

built by other engineers on the team

Technical Execution & Quality

- Implement agent memory management using explicit typed state, structured

context handling, and clear handoff boundaries to prevent context degradation

across multi-step operational workflows

- Apply three-layer output validation - DSPy assertions, output validators, and policy

enforcer - on every crew module before merge

- Build and validate test suites covering non-deterministic edge cases and failure

modes - not just happy paths - using the QA Agent's generated baseline as a

starting point

- Integrate crews with AWS Bedrock model routing (Claude Haiku/Sonnet) and work

within the EKS and Terraform IaC stack managed by DevOps

- Maintain guardrails configuration for every crew - escalation triggers, human

approval gates, and policy enforcement - encoded in config before any crew

enters shadow deployment

- Participate in weekly DSPy evaluation cycles against gold-standard baselines to

validate crew output quality and flag drift

Observability & Production Operations

- Instrument every crew with New Relic metrics from day one: throughput, error rate, 

latency, escalation rate, and cost per task - observability is a deployment

prerequisite, not an afterthought

- Actively diagnose and resolve production failure modes: memory drift across multi

step workflows, hallucination under low-confidence RAG retrieval, context

degradation in long-running state machines, and prompt injection via untrusted

integration inputs

- Use post-deployment observability data to identify improvement candidates and

raise them in RAID - closing the feedback loop the Observability Agent depends on

- Contribute to the continuous improvement cycle: every crew in production is a

measurement and improvement loop, not a delivery milestone

Collaboration & Build Platform

- Work within the 10-day delivery lifecycle - Request → Discovery → Design →

Development → QA → CI/CD → Monitoring → Continuous Improvement - delivering

to standard at each stage

- Collaborate with the PM during Discovery to assess process automation feasibility

using FUDV scoring - frequency, uniformity, digitisation, volume - and push back

credibly where AI reliability or data quality is not there yet

data.title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Enterprise Automation
data.description:
As a Senior Engineering Manager in the Revenue Platform Automation division, you'll lead the engineering efforts driving our Sales, Customer Success (CS), and Finance technology stack. You'll ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across these platforms, with a strong focus on backend and data-driven solutions. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you'll play a critical role in ensuring our systems are robust, integrated, and aligned with the company's strategic objectives. This role offers a unique opportunity to blend technical expertise with leadership skills, driving impactful change in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. 

You will build and lead a team of talented engineers responsible for developing and maintaining automation solutions for our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technologies. You'll train and mentor team members, identify and resolve impediments, oversee the integrity of software estimations, and ensure that code and tests meet high standards while keeping scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind. 

This is a backend-focused role, leveraging your strong background in Java, Python, workflow automation solutions (Workato), web services (REST/OpenAPI), messaging frameworks (Kafka), data platforms (Snowflake), cloud technologies (AWS/GCP), and containerization (Kubernetes/Docker) to build innovative solutions. You'll use your strong knowledge of Sales, Customer Success, and Finance business domains and tools to build complete solutions in sales automation (Salesforce, Service Cloud), finance automation (ERP/billing/CPQ/payment), and customer insights (Catalyst/Gainsight). You'll ensure your team masters their discrete business domains, maintaining ownership, and accountability for their deliverables. You will oversee the development of strong test automation suites, aligning with automated build & CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native delivery. 

Your ability to collaborate with product management, provide leadership across multiple locations, set high standards for the team, and hire, train, and retain exceptional talent is foundational to your success. You'll solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, inspire creative thinking, and help foster a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose. 

Your responsibilities span across the Sales & Customer Success Platform and Finance Platform teams, each of which are cross-functional teams consisting of product management, product ownership, and engineers who are responsible for our core Revenue Technology stack. The Senior Engineering Manager oversees the engineers/testers on the teams, identifying and overseeing the solutions that meet internal customers' needs. 

Primary Job Responsibilities

- Lead and inspire a team of skilled engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability. Provide guidance and support to ensure team growth and success, empowering them with autonomy and ownership

Your back-end expertise allows you to dive into the codebase when needed, ensuring alignment with best practices

 - Lead efforts to enhance system performance, drive innovation, and implement scalable solutions that align with the company's strategic objectives
 - Leverage your strong background in Java, Python, data platforms, workflow automation, software architecture, messaging frameworks, and cloud technologies to drive the technical direction of our revenue platforms. Ensure the adoption of best practices in automation, web services, test automation, and cloud-native delivery

 - Oversee the integrity of software estimations and ensure high standards of performance, reliability, and security in the systems developed by your team. Vigilantly identify and resolve impediments, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope
 - Drive innovation within the revenue technology stack. Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, tools, and systems, ensuring our technology remains at the cutting edge
 - Play a key role in hiring, training, and retaining top engineering talent. Set a high bar for performance, create opportunities for professional growth, and cultivate an environment where team members feel valued and motivated
 - Establish and drive a culture rooted in belonging, psychological safety, candor, connection, cooperation, and fun. Solicit feedback, engage with empathy, and build strong relationships across the organization to foster an environment where innovative ideas can thrive

 - Model and encourage desired behaviors to support the company's vision and values. Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested

Skills And Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

 - 7+ years in an Engineering leadership role with direct management responsibilities of at least 3 people

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events. 

Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer

Title: Design for Test (DFT) Lead (Edge Computing)

Location Greater Bengaluru/Hybrid/Remote

About Company: 

We are hiring for organization which is leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. Its robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today's best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. It was launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems. 

Job Description: 

Lead DFT Engineer (Edge Computing)

Developing silicon for Edge Computing isn't just about speed; it's about balancing high-performance data processing with extreme power efficiency and reliability in remote environments. 

As the Design for Test (DFT) Lead, you will be the architect of our testing strategy, ensuring our data center chips are flawlessly manufacturable and resilient enough for edge deployment. 

Key Responsibilities

Architectural Leadership: Define and implement the end-to-end DFT architecture for complex SoCs, including Hierarchical DFT, Scan compression, Boundary Scan and MBIST. 

Edge-Specific Reliability: Develop strategies for In-System Test (IST) and power-on self-test (POST) to ensure chip health in remote edge data centers. 

Implementation & Flow: Oversee scan insertion, ATPG (Stuck-at, Transition, Path Delay), and Memory/Logic BIST. 

Cross-Functional Synergy: Collaborate with Design, Physical Design, and Yield teams to ensure high test coverage while minimizing area overhead and power impact as well as timing analysis. 

Post-Silicon Validation: Lead the bring-up and debug phase on ATE (Automated Test Equipment) to root-cause silicon failures and optimize test time. 

Technical Requirements

Experience: 12+ years in DFT, with at least 2 years in a leadership or principal role. 

Tools: Mastery of industry-standard tools (e. g. , Synopsys TestMAX, Siemens/Mentor Tessent, or Cadence Modus). 

Memory & Logic Test: Deep expertise in MBIST (Memory Built-In Self-Test) with repair capabilities, SCAN, IJTAG (IEEE 1687) and boundary scan (IEEE 1149. 1/6). 

Advanced Nodes: Proven track record with FinFET nodes (7nm, 5nm, or below). 

Low Power: Experience managing DFT in multi-voltage/power-gated designs-crucial for edge efficiency.

Your expertise will directly influence how our plants perform, how our teams operate, and how we meet the energy challenges of tomorrow. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the design, deployment, and validation of SCADA systems across renewable energy projects from engineering through post-commissioning handover.

 - Exposure to BESS integration, hybrid plant control logic, and storage SCADA systems. 
 - Working knowledge of Python, Power BI, and digital or AI-based integrations. 
 - Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to deliver under pressure. 

Location

This position is based in Pune, India. 

What We Offer

At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century.

data.description:
Transformation Delivery Lead - Senior Manager

Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale technology transformation programs for our most strategic clients. You will lead the end-to-end transformation execution, ensuring programs deliver committed business outcomes, financial targets, operational improvements, and stakeholder expectations across Technology Modernization, AI Enterprise Transformation, M&A and Enterprise Agility pillars

Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network

Areas of Work: Transformation Delivery

Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Years of Exp: 12 - 17 years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernization, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programs? Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping portfolio level leads, directors and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organizations, and ensuring transformation investments generates lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organizations. 

The Practice - A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernizing delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value. 

Role

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organizations through complex transformation journeys - from for translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support: 

- Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership: Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to portfolio priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. 
 - End-to-End Delivery Accountability: Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization - including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernization, and cloud-native migration programs, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity. 
 - AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership: Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. 
 - Revenue Management and Financial Governance: Manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions. 
 - undefined
 - Integration and Dependency Management: Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes. 
 - Value Realization and Benefits Framework: Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio - cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at portfolio level
 - Global Delivery Leadership: Act as a trusted partner to senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. 
 - Executive Stakeholder Leadership: Shape Portfolio level narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings

Role Summary

As Delivery Lead Senior Manager, you will own end-to-end delivery of one or more large, complex transformation programmes with budgets typically ranging from $5M to $30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at Portfolio level, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end programme delivery, ensuring outcomes are on time, on budget, and aligned to contractual SLAs and KPIs. 
 - Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CI/CD practices and modern ways of working within client organizations. 
 - Lead portfolio-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client. 
 - Manage relationships at Portfolio and director level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation. 
 - Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio. 
 - Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio. 
 - Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption. 
 - Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs
 - Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings. 
 - Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits. 
 - Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure. 

What We're Looking For

- 12-17 years' total experience; 4-6 years in senior programme delivery within a large professional services or consulting firm, including hands-on management of budgets in the $5M-$30M range. 
 - Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes. 
 - Demonstrated track record of Portfolio-level stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management. 
 - undefined
 - Experience leading organisational change and embedding operational performance improvements at scale. 
 - Track record of account growth, deal-shaping, and business development alongside delivery execution. 
 - Strong executive presence: communicates with clarity and gravitas; builds trust with senior audiences rapidly. 
 - Must have experience of working across at least one of the following areas; Technology Modernisation, Complex Delivery, Drive Transformation, Revenue Management. 

Set Yourself Apart

- 
 - Mastery of managing complex deliveries coordinating with more than one supplier with multiple dependencies and work plans
 - Experience delivering cloud-native transformation programs leveraging Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), microservices architectures, API-led integration, or SaaS platforms
 - Experience of delivering transformation at scale within a highly regulated or complex industry sector
 - Cloud/Industry and Programme Management certifications and credentials
 - Demonstrate a strong Technical and Emotional Quotient
What's in it for you?

- An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
 - Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies. 
 - Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional. 
 - Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities. 
 - Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization

About Accenture

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Lead Software Engineer, Foundational APIs

Location: Noida, India

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, and collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn, and pursue meaningful outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values: Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we are saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is establishing a Foundational APIs capability to make core business data and functionality easier to access securely, consistently, and reliably across our products and solutions. 

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will help turn this ambition into working software. You will design and build API capabilities that support product experiences, integrations, workflows, clients, and approved AI solutions without requiring consumers to understand the complexity of SimCorp's underlying systems. 

You will be a senior, hands-on member of a newly established engineering team in India. You will help the team deliver its first production capabilities, establish effective engineering practices, and make sound implementation decisions across API design, distributed systems, security, reliability, testing, and cloud engineering. 

The role requires strong technical depth and practical delivery experience. You will contribute directly to the codebase while guiding other engineers through design discussions, reviews, problem solving, and continuous improvement. 

You will collaborate with architects, Product Management, domain experts, Platform teams, and engineers across SimCorp to build capabilities that are valuable today and sustainable as the wider platform evolves. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate secure and reliable Foundational API services using C#/. NET and Microsoft Azure. 
 - Translate business and consumer requirements into clear API contracts, technical designs, and incremental implementation plans. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership through coding, design discussions, code reviews, pairing, testing, and production problem resolution. 
 - Build API capabilities around clear business use cases rather than exposing the complexity of underlying systems and legacy implementations. 
 - Work with domain experts to understand the business meaning of concepts such as portfolios, positions, transactions, cash, instruments, and settlement information. 
 - Address distributed-system concerns including latency, partial failure, retries, idempotency, concurrency, resilience, and source-system availability. 
 - Build scalable and maintainable backend services with appropriate performance, security, and reliability characteristics. 
 - Assess and reuse existing API frameworks, gateways, integration solutions, domain services, and supported interfaces before introducing new abstractions. 
 - Create adapters and service components that separate stable consumer contracts from legacy or changing underlying implementations. 
 - Support the incremental modernization of existing systems without disrupting current consumers and business processes. 
 - Establish and promote effective engineering practices covering clean code, automated testing, contract testing, secure development, observability, CI/CD, and operational readiness. 
 - Build comprehensive automated tests across unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end levels where appropriate. 
 - Help define quality controls for API changes, including compatibility, versioning, documentation, security, and production readiness. 
 - Diagnose performance bottlenecks, production issues, integration failures, and complex defects, and implement sustainable solutions. 
 - Break complex engineering problems into focused, testable, and releasable increments. 
 - Collaborate with the Principal Software Engineer and architects on significant technical decisions and convert agreed direction into practical implementation. 
 - Mentor engineers through technical planning, code reviews, pairing, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback. 
 - Promote shared technical ownership and help the team avoid dependency on individual specialists. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management, Platform, Architecture, Security, Data, and domain engineering teams to deliver integrated capabilities. 
 - Communicate technical decisions, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and limitations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Continuously improve yourself, the team, our engineering practices, and the Foundational APIs capability. 

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing to and thriving in this role. We expect you to have strong expertise in several of the areas below, together with the willingness and curiosity to develop in the others. 

- More than five years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong programming experience in C# and . NET, with a good understanding of clean, maintainable, and testable code. 
 - Practical experience designing and developing REST APIs, backend services, and system integrations. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and production deployment. 
 - Experience creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated quality controls. 
 - Strong understanding of API design principles, including contracts, resource modelling, versioning, backward compatibility, pagination, filtering, and error handling. 
 - Experience designing secure backend systems using authentication, authorization, identity, access control, and secrets management. 
 - Understanding of distributed-system concerns such as latency, resilience, concurrency, partial failure, consistency, idempotency, and safe retries. 
 - Strong automated-testing skills, including unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience with observability practices including structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, health monitoring, and operational diagnostics. 
 - Experience with relational databases and SQL. 
 - Familiarity with messaging, event-driven architecture, service bus patterns, or streaming technologies is valuable. 
 - Experience with Domain-Driven Design or similar approaches to defining business capabilities and service boundaries is valuable. 
 - Experience working with legacy systems, modernization initiatives, adapters, or incremental migration is valuable. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to simplify complex technical problems and create maintainable solutions without introducing unnecessary abstraction. 
 - Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with security, reliability, maintainability, and long-term contract stability. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence through practical guidance and collaboration. 
 - A continuous-improvement mindset and experience working in an agile engineering environment. 
 - Experience collaborating in an international product-development organization. 
 - Strong communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken. 
 - A degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related field is valuable, but practical engineering experience and demonstrated capability are equally important. 
 - Interest in learning the investment-management domain and understanding the business meaning behind the capabilities being developed. 
 - Readiness to learn relevant SimCorp technologies, frameworks, and legacy environments where required. 

AI-ENABLED DEVELOPMENT

- Use approved AI tools as part of everyday engineering, development, testing, documentation, and technical-discovery workflows. 
 - Critically evaluate AI-generated code, tests, designs, and documentation for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit. 
 - Help engineers understand when AI can accelerate delivery and when deeper engineering judgment and review are required. 
 - Identify opportunities where AI-assisted development can accelerate prototyping, reduce repetitive work, strengthen testing, and improve developer productivity. 
 - Ensure that AI-generated artifacts meet the same engineering, security, testing, and review standards as other contributions. 

FURTHERMORE, WE VALUE THAT YOU

- Take ownership from technical discovery through implementation, deployment, and production operation. 
 - Are curious about complex business and technical problems and seek to understand the context before proposing solutions. 
 - Can work effectively when business knowledge, implementation ownership, and technical dependencies are distributed across different teams. 
 - Are comfortable challenging assumptions constructively and changing direction when evidence supports a better approach. 
 - Lead through practical engineering contribution rather than relying on title or authority. 
 - Create a collaborative environment where engineers can raise concerns, explore alternatives, and learn from successes and failures. 
 - Identify technical debt and architectural risks and help the team address them deliberately. 
 - Focus on delivering the smallest useful capability that can be validated with a real consumer. 
 - Combine strong technical judgment with humility, openness, and respect for the expertise of others. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy: We ask you to work two days a week from the office. You may work remotely on the other days, or work from the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture: An inclusive and diverse company culture where different perspectives and expertise are valued. 
 - Work-life balance: We believe that a sustainable balance between professional and personal responsibilities helps everyone perform at their best. 
 - Empowerment: We believe all voices are valuable and should be heard. You will be involved in shaping our technical direction and ways of working. 
 - Career and growth: SimCorp offers opportunities for professional development and supports individual career paths based on your strengths and aspirations. 
 - Innovation: You will have opportunities to contribute to engineering improvements, modernization, and strategic capabilities with impact across SimCorp. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English through our career site as soon as possible. We assess incoming applications continuously, and only applications submitted through our system can be processed. 

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur during recruitment. To support fairness and equal opportunity for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal information such as photographs, age, or other non-professional details from your application. 

If you are interested in joining SimCorp but are unsure whether this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you identify suitable opportunities. 

We continuously seek to improve our talent-acquisition process and make every candidate's experience positive and valuable. During the process, we may ask you to provide feedback, which will be highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a leading provider of integrated investment-management solutions. Our colleagues represent a broad range of nationalities, educational backgrounds, professional experiences, and perspectives. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. Following the merger with Axioma, we combine the strengths of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other status protected under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. 

We believe in the continuous growth and development of our employees so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

data.title: Senior Devops Engineer-AWS & AI tool
data.description:
Role Description

Architecture & Builder Mode

- AWS solution architecture. Translate workloads and non-functional requirements into AWS architectures covering accounts, networking, compute, storage, data services, identity, security, observability, resilience, and cost. Maintain clear conceptual, logical, and physical deployment designs. 
 - Infrastructure as code. Design and implement reusable, version-controlled infrastructure using Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or approved equivalents. Establish environment consistency, state management, code review, policy checks, and controlled promotion. 
 - Cloud-native platforms. Lead deployment of containerized and serverless workloads using services such as ECS, EKS, EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, and appropriate managed services. Select technologies based on workload needs, operational complexity, and cost. 
 - CI/CD and release engineering. Build secure, repeatable pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery. Own build, test, artifact, scanning, deployment, approval, rollback, and release automation patterns across environments. 
 - AI-DLC enablement. Use Claude Code, Codex, or comparable tools to accelerate IaC, pipeline development, scripting, documentation, and troubleshooting. Define safe agent permissions, review gates, and policies for AI-generated infrastructure changes. 
 - End-to-end platform delivery. Own platform workstreams from discovery and design through provisioning, integration, testing, production rollout, and operational handover. Coordinate with application, architecture, security, networking, QA, and customer teams. 

Firefighter Mode

- A deployment fails before a customer milestone. You trace the pipeline, artifact, configuration, and infrastructure dependencies, restore a safe deployment path, and communicate the recovery plan. 
 - An application is unreachable or unstable in AWS. You investigate DNS, routing, security groups, IAM, load balancing, compute, and service telemetry to identify the cause and coordinate a verified fix. 
 - A production environment shows rising latency, error rates, or infrastructure cost. You use operational evidence to isolate the issue, implement appropriate scaling or optimization, and measure the result. 
 - An AI-generated Terraform or pipeline change introduces security or deployment risk. You block unsafe promotion, review the proposed changes, remediate the issue, and improve the automated guardrails. 

Systems Thinker Mode

- Secure cloud foundations. Establish account and environment isolation, VPC/network design, least-privilege IAM, encryption, secrets management, logging, and approved connectivity. Partner with security and governance teams on policies and risk remediation. 
 - Reliability and operations. Design for availability, fault isolation, scaling, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery requirements. Establish SLOs where appropriate, monitoring, ing, runbooks, incident response, and tested recovery procedures. 
 - Platform standardization. Create reusable IaC modules, pipeline templates, container standards, environment baselines, and self-service patterns that reduce manual effort while preserving governance and traceability. 
 - Team enablement. Mentor DevOps and application engineers, review infrastructure designs and code, define ownership and operating procedures, and help teams adopt cloud and AI-DLC practices safely and independently. 
 - Delivery and cost accountability. Own technical dependencies, capacity, release readiness, and platform risks. Track deployment frequency, failure/recovery trends, infrastructure drift, service reliability, and cost; make optimization decisions using measurable evidence. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Experience. Typically 7+ years in software engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering, including at least 2 years leading technical delivery or cloud/platform architecture. Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered. 
 - Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's degree is an advantage. 
 - AWS and DevOps expertise. Strong hands-on experience designing and operating production AWS environments, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, Linux, networking, security, containers, scripting, and operational troubleshooting. 
 - Leadership and delivery. Proven ability to guide engineers, own infrastructure and deployment decisions, coordinate with application and security teams, and deliver production platforms with clear operational accountability. 

Technical Toolkit

We value demonstrated technical depth and the ability to learn adjacent technologies-not superficial familiarity with every tool listed below. 

- AWS architecture and networking. AWS Organizations/Control Tower familiarity, IAM, VPC, subnets, routing, security groups, VPC endpoints, Transit Gateway or VPN/Direct Connect where applicable, Route 53, load balancers, and AWS networking/security fundamentals. 
 - Compute, containers and serverless. EC2, ECS/Fargate, EKS/Kubernetes, ECR, Lambda, API Gateway, autoscaling, and appropriate managed storage/data services such as S3, RDS, or DynamoDB. Strong Docker and container troubleshooting experience. 
 - Infrastructure and automation. Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or comparable IaC; Bash and Python scripting; Git, reusable modules, environment/state management, infrastructure testing, and drift detection. 
 - CI/CD and DevSecOps. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline/CodeBuild, or comparable platforms; artifact management, automated testing, security scanning, policy-as-code, secrets handling, approvals, and deployment strategies. 
 - Security and operations. IAM least privilege, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, or approved equivalents; observability, ing, incident response, backup/recovery, and cost optimization. 
 - Cloud-native architecture. High availability, disaster recovery, infrastructure resilience, service networking, event-driven integration, deployment patterns, and AWS Well-Architected principles. Familiarity with Bedrock, SageMaker, or AI workload infrastructure is an advantage. 
 - AI-first engineering. Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or comparable tools; specification-driven infrastructure development, agent instructions/skills, approved tool access, context engineering, and human-verified automation.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in software engineering, systems integration, cloud-native and real-time distributed systems with strong delivery leadership, guiding multidisciplinary teams and cross-functional partners to build reliable, scalable, secure, high-performance solutions. 

The role also drives technical strategy, architecture governance, resource and talent planning, risk management, and successful program execution.

Software Development & Architecture

- Lead the architecture, design, development, and maintenance of Ground System software applications and services. 
 - Define technology roadmaps and software engineering best practices for Ground Systems. 
 - Drive architecture reviews, design governance, and technical decision-making across programs. 
 - Ensure software solutions meet performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security requirements. 
 - Champion modern software engineering practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD, containerization, and microservices-based architectures.

Required Qualifications

 - Proven experience leading large-scale software development and integration projects. 
 - Strong programming expertise in: 
 - Python, C/C++, Java (Preferred), Scripting Languages, Linux/Unix environments. 
 - Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 
 - Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps/DevSecOps practices, and CI/CD frameworks.

data.title: QA/QC Manager - Hospital Interior Fit-Out
data.description:
Job Title

QA/QC Manager - Hospital Interior Fit-Out

Job Description Summary

This role is responsible for leading all Quality Assurance and Quality Control activities for hospital interior fit-out projects. The QA/QC Manager ensures that all construction works meet project specifications, regulatory standards, healthcare facility requirements, and client expectations while maintaining the highest quality standards throughout the project lifecycle. 

Job Description

About the Role: 

- Lead and manage all Quality Assurance and Quality Control activities for hospital interior fit-out projects from planning through project completion. 
 - Develop, implement, and maintain project-specific QA/QC plans, quality procedures, inspection test plans (ITP), and quality documentation. 
 - Ensure all interior fit-out works comply with healthcare industry standards, project specifications, applicable codes, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Conduct regular site inspections, audits, and quality assessments to ensure workmanship and materials meet approved standards. 
 - Coordinate with project managers, consultants, contractors, vendors, and client representatives to address quality-related issues and ensure timely resolution. 
 - Review material submittals, method statements, shop drawings, mock-ups, and quality records prior to execution. 
 - Monitor installation quality for architectural finishes, MEP interfaces, healthcare-specific installations, and specialized hospital areas. 
 - Identify non-conformances, issue corrective actions, and follow up to ensure closure of quality observations. 
 - Maintain quality documentation, test reports, inspection records, punch lists, and project close-out quality requirements. 
 - Conduct quality training and awareness programs for project teams and contractors to promote a quality-driven culture. 
 - Ensure coordination of quality processes with project schedules, safety requirements, and client expectations. 
 - Ensure the contract between the client and Cushman & Wakefield is implemented in accordance with agreed quality standards and deliverables. 

About You

- Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. 
 - Minimum 10 years of experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control for construction projects, with significant exposure to hospital or healthcare interior fit-out projects. 
 - Strong knowledge of QA/QC procedures, inspection methodologies, quality management systems, and construction best practices. 
 - Proven experience in managing quality processes for interior finishes, architectural works, MEP coordination, and healthcare facility requirements. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Knowledge of ISO 9001 standards, quality auditing techniques, and documentation control processes. 
 - Proficiency with quality management tools, MS Office, project documentation systems, and construction management software. 

Why join Cushman & Wakefield?

As One Of The Leading Global Real Estate Services Firms Transforming The Way People Work, Shop And Live, Working At Cushman & Wakefield Means You Will Benefit From

- Being part of a growing global company; 
 - Career development and a promote-from-within culture; 
 - An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion. 

We're committed to providing work-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment. 

We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion-from-within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional, and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program. 

We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong. 

That's why we support and celebrate inclusive causes, not just on days of recognition throughout the year, but every day. We embrace diversity across race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, persons with disabilities, and protected veteran status.
