data.description:
Job Summary

This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins' products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins' products in a variety of customer applications. 

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less-experienced developers/testers' work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team. 

Competencies

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins' products. 

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements. 

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams. 

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products. 

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions. 

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts. 

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects. 

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization. 

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. 

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward. 

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. 

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. 

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently. 

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization. 

Education, Licenses, Certifications

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required. 

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles. 

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations. 

Experience

Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred

Role Overview

The Functional Safety (FuSa) Software Developer is responsible for developing, verifying, and maintaining safety-critical software in compliance with ISO 26262 for automotive electronic systems. The role ensures that software components meet defined ASIL requirements and supports the full safety lifecycle from concept to production. 

Key Responsibilities - Functional Safety Engineering

- Implement software safety requirements derived from system and hardware safety requirements. 
 - Ensure compliance with ISO 26262 Part 6. 
 - Develop safety-related embedded software in C/C++. 
 - Implement safety mechanisms such as watchdogs, redundancy, diagnostics, and safe-state handling. 
 - Work with MCU-based platforms and RTOS environments. 
 - Develop unit and integration tests. 
 - Execute requirement-based testing. 
 - Support ASIL-compliant verification and coverage analysis. 
 - Participate in audits and safety reviews. 
 - Prepare ISO 26262 compliant work products. 
 - Maintain traceability between requirements, design, code, and tests. 
 - Support OEM and supplier safety documentation. 
 - Participate in requirements discussions. 
 - Connect with external stake holders to clarify requirements assist in system level testing. 

Technical Skills

- Embedded C/C++ ISO 26262 (Part 6)
 - AUTOSAR knowledge (preferred)
 - RTOS concepts
 - MISRA-C compliance

Tools & Standards

- Git, windchill, Eclipse, doxygen
 - Unit test tools like vector cast
 - Static analysis tools (Polyspace, QAC)
 - Debugging tools (JTAG, Lauterbach)
 - Analytical and problem-solving mindset
 - Strong documentation skills
 - Effective communication
 - Cross-functional collaboration

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics or Embedded Systems
 - 6-8 years of automotive embedded software experience
 - Prior functional safety project exposure preferred

Nice to Have

- Functional Safety certification
 - OEM project experience
 - Exposure to cybersecurity-safety interaction

data.title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

The Lead Forward Deployed Engineer operates at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this hands-on, customer-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys' Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering. 

Key Responsibilities

Customer Onboarding & Data Integration

- Strategic Execution: Lead end-to-end enterprise onboarding from strategy to production rollout, serving as the system of record for customer assets, findings, and business context. 
 - Pipeline & API Design: Build REST API, webhook, and scalable ingestion (e. g. , S3-based ETL/ELT) pipelines to integrate diverse data sources (VM, EDR/XDR, Cloud, IAM, CMDBs, GRC). 
 - Data Modeling & Correlation: Design custom mapping, transformation, tagging, and asset criticality scoring; implement de-duplication and correlation logic across heterogeneous security feeds. 
 - Pipeline Reliability: Ensure continuous full and incremental data ingestion with automated scheduling, monitoring, and error handling. 

Data Quality & Validation

- Data Integrity: Establish scalable validation frameworks to audit and maintain asset/findings accuracy for confident risk decision-making. 
 - Issue Resolution: Execute controlled reprocessing and configuration adjustments to fix data quality issues without disrupting operational metrics. 

Dashboards, Remediation & Workflows

- Analytics & Modeling: Build customized dashboards, trend visualizations, and risk scoring models, including complex "toxic risk combination" scenarios. 
 - Workflow Automation: Integrate ETM with ticketing/remediation tools (Jira, ServiceNow) and configure automated alerts, escalations, and ownership mapping. 
 - Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board-level, operational, and regulatory audiences. 

Product & Engineering Feedback Loop

- Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams. 
 - Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation-driven action. 

Required Qualifications: 

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Experience: 8-10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles. 
 - Technical Stack: 
 - Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages. 
 - Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT). 
 - Hands-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases. 
 - Domain & Data Expertise: 
 - Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation. 
 - Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks). 
 - Hands-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows. 
 - Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services. 
 - Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures. 
 - Proven ability to thrive in high-impact, fast-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. 

We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer for our Frontier Security AI team. Snowflake's Frontier Security AI teams develop production-grade LLM applications, intelligent agents, AI infrastructure, and evaluation systems for enterprise customers - products that must meet a high bar for quality, security, reliability, and efficiency while operating over sensitive data at large scale. In this role, you will lead the design and development of our Agentic Harness and agent evaluation platform, working across product, infrastructure, applied AI, security, and modeling teams to take new capabilities from prototype to dependable customer value. 

AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL: 

- Architect and build the Agentic Harness that executes complex, multi-step AI workflows across models, tools, data, and services. 
 - Design stable interfaces for tool execution, context construction, state management, memory, permissions, retries, fallbacks, and human review. 
 - Own agent quality end to end by building evaluation harnesses, representative datasets, automated graders, experiment pipelines, and release gates. 
 - Convert ambiguous reports such as "the agent feels worse" into measurable failure modes, reproducible tests, and durable fixes. 
 - Analyze production agent trajectories to identify failures in reasoning, retrieval, tool use, context, orchestration, and application code. 
 - Close the loop between production incidents, root-cause analysis, evaluation coverage, and regression prevention. 
 - Develop offline and online measurements for task completion, correctness, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost. 
 - Build simulation and replay infrastructure for golden-set tests, adversarial scenarios, model comparisons, and large-scale experiments. 
 - Improve agent efficiency through model routing, prompt and semantic caching, context compaction, tool-result management, and token optimization. 
 - Productionize new model capabilities as secure, observable, multi-tenant services with clear operational controls. 
 - Establish standards for evaluation design, including sampling, ground-truth quality, grader calibration, leakage prevention, and statistical significance. 
 - Define technical direction across multiple teams and lead projects whose scope extends beyond a single service. 
 - Mentor engineers, raise the quality of architecture reviews, and remain directly involved in implementation and debugging. 

OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE: 

- 9+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex production systems. 
 - Direct experience shipping and operating LLM applications, AI agents, or model-backed workflows in production. 
 - Strong background in distributed systems, service architecture, high-throughput APIs, concurrency, and failure handling. 
 - Experience building an agent runtime, workflow engine, developer platform, evaluation system, or similar infrastructure. 
 - Demonstrated ability to evaluate nondeterministic systems without relying on a single aggregate score. 
 - Fluency in Python and strong proficiency in at least one systems or application language such as Java, Go, Rust, or TypeScript. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of tool calling, structured generation, retrieval, context engineering, prompt management, and model APIs. 
 - Experience with production observability, including structured traces, replay, metrics, logs, and incident diagnosis. 
 - Ability to balance agent quality with latency, reliability, security, and inference cost.

data.description:
Description

Salesforce is currently seeking a Manager, Technical Consulting to play a meaningful part in managing, training, and building the careers of our technical consulting team. We are key players in this objective, as they can use Industry Cloud functionality to deliver customer requirements quickly with minimal customization. 

In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team. 

This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a technical architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce's Lifesciences and Health industry solutions

Responsibilities

- You'll have up to 15 direct reports under your scope of responsibility. 
 - You will be required to deliver technical work (as a technical architect) on Salesforce's Life Sciences Cloud projects at 50% utilization and balance that with leading your team of Technical Consultants and Senior Technical Consultants. 
 - You'll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest-quality solutions that meets the customers' needs, ensuring continuous team enablement across modern AI coding environments. 
 - Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value. 
 - Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community's overall knowledge base and expertise, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering model across your delivery team. 
 - Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs. 
 - Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap. 
 - Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying. 
 - Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Lifesciences and Health clouds, guiding teams on the effective use of AI development tools (e. g. , Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to maintain delivery speed and code health. 
 - Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by defining metric frameworks to measure the business value of client AI workloads. 
 - Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders. 
 - Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion. 

Minimum Requirements

- 10-15 years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors. 
 - 5+ years of people management experience. 
 - Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills. 
 - Proven experience architecting enterprise-level Salesforce solutions in the life sciences or Veeva product or healthcare industry. 
 - Strong understanding of compliance and regulatory requirements including HIPAA, GxP, PHI, HL7, and FHIR. 
 - Expertise in one or multiple domains of Healthcare Providers, Healthcare Payers, Life Science and Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Public health & Government Healthcare programs, Insurance. 
 - Experience in healthcare domain (Preferred)
 - Integration Architecture (Must have)
 - Platform Security (Must have)
 - Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
 - Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
 - Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
 - Architectural Design Patterns
 - Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
 - Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others) or Veeva CRm experience
 - Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect, System Architect)
 - OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
 - Health Cloud Certification (Good to have).

data.title: Architect - Traffic and Security
data.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader - we're changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We're committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. 

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

Job Type: Full-time

About The Team

Traffic Engineering powers secure, scalable, highly available traffic systems that support eBay's global commerce platform. We build and operate traffic management and security capabilities across edge and service layers, including PoP strategy, caching, Kubernetes networking, and reliability improvements based on monitoring insights. 

Role Summary

As a Traffic Engineering Architect, you will own architecture and technical direction across eBay's traffic engineering platform, spanning traffic management, load balancing, service connectivity, PoP/caching optimization, and traffic security (rate limiting, bot mitigation, etc. ). You will lead cross-team design, guide execution on critical initiatives, and drive measurable improvements in latency, availability, resilience, and security. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define architecture and technical strategy for global traffic systems: traffic management, load balancing, service connectivity, PoP optimization, caching, and traffic security controls. 
 - Architect and deliver rate limiting and bot mitigation solutions across edge/service layers in partnership with Security. 
 - Design and build high-performance, low-latency distributed systems using C/C++ and Go (Java in relevant components as needed). 
 - Drive Kubernetes networking and platform patterns at scale, including CNI integrations, service mesh, IPAM, and production-grade deployment models. 
 - Own technical tradeoffs across performance, scalability, reliability, security, operability, maintainability, and delivery timelines. 
 - Establish/advance observability and engineering metrics; use production signals to improve SLOs, reduce incidents, and increase efficiency. 
 - Lead operational excellence: incident prevention, resiliency design, capacity/performance tuning, and automated remediation where appropriate. 
 - Align roadmaps and execution across Product, Infrastructure, SRE/Operations, and Security; resolve cross-team dependencies and drive technical consensus. 
 - Mentor senior engineers/tech leads through architecture reviews, design reviews, and code reviews; raise engineering standards and consistency. 
 - Contribute to innovation via open-source engagement, patents, and forward-looking exploration relevant to traffic systems. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience with significant depth in networking/traffic engineering, distributed systems, and/or cyber security. 
 - Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Go (Java acceptable/valuable for specific subsystems); experience building production-grade, high-performance systems. 
 - Deep knowledge of Linux networking, traffic management fundamentals, and systems performance optimization. 
 - Strong experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure at scale. 
 - Proven experience designing secure, scalable, observable distributed platforms and operating them in production. 
 - Demonstrated cross-team technical leadership: driving architecture across multiple systems, influencing partners, and delivering large initiatives. 
 - Strong communication, mentoring, and technical decision-making skills in ambiguous environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Envoy, service mesh, control plane/data plane architectures, NGINX/HAProxy, SDN, eBPF, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with rate limiting, bot management, abuse prevention, and traffic security patterns (edge and service). 
 - Background in PoP design, caching strategies, and internet-scale traffic optimization. 
 - Vendor tool integration experience and operation in globally distributed environments. 
 - Open-source contributions, patents, or externally visible technical leadership. 

What Success Looks Like

- Improved global traffic platform outcomes (latency, throughput, availability, resilience, security). 
 - Reduced incident frequency/impact through architecture, observability, and operational rigor. 
 - Strong architectural alignment across teams with higher engineering quality and execution velocity. 

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay. com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

data.title: Senior Test Engineer - FinOps & Cloud Infrastructure | 3 Years Experience s Only
data.description:
About Company: NEXUS AIDC is advancing the next generation of intelligent data center operations through its AI-native Data Center Operating System. Our unified platform connects physical infrastructure, compute resources, AI workloads, and operational intelligence, enabling real-time visibility, predictive insights, and intelligent automation. As we expand our enterprise footprint, we continue to advance our platform capabilities to support increasingly complex AI infrastructure environments. 

Opportunity: We are seeking a technically strong, hands-on Senior Test Engineer (FinOps & Cloud Infrastructure) to drive quality assurance, automation, and validation of our infrastructure financial intelligence capabilities. The ideal candidate will combine strong software testing expertise with a solid understanding of data center infrastructure, cloud technologies, resource utilization, and cost economics. This role requires technical ownership, analytical depth, and the ability to validate complex infrastructure data, financial calculations, and optimization models within an enterprise-grade software platform. 

Responsibilities

- Own functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing of FinOps and infrastructure cost management capabilities. 
 - Validate cost collection, allocation, chargeback/showback, budgeting, forecasting, and optimization recommendations. 
 - Test infrastructure usage and cost data across cloud, Kubernetes, CPU/GPU compute, storage, networking, power, and cooling systems. 
 - Verify pricing models, cost calculations, resource utilization metrics, financial projections, savings estimates, and reporting accuracy. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain automated API, UI, database, and data-validation tests integrated into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Validate data ingestion, aggregation, reconciliation, and accuracy across multiple infrastructure and cloud data sources. 
 - Identify calculation discrepancies, data inconsistencies, integration defects, and performance issues. 
 - Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and Engineering teams to improve test coverage, reliability, and overall product quality. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 3+ years of hands-on experience in software testing, quality assurance, and test automation. 
 - Strong expertise in API, UI, integration, database, and data-validation testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Playwright, pytest, Postman/Newman, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of data center and cloud infrastructure attributes, including compute, CPU/GPU utilization, memory, storage, networking, power consumption, cooling, capacity, resource allocation, and workload performance. 
 - Good understanding of FinOps principles, cloud financial management, pricing, billing, cost allocation, budgeting, forecasting, and optimization. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP, including cloud resource metering, utilization metrics, and cost drivers. 
 - Ability to interpret and validate infrastructure telemetry, operational metrics, usage data, and their impact on cost calculations and optimization recommendations. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience validating complex datasets, numerical calculations, and analytical reports. 
 - Experience developing automated tests within CI/CD workflows. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities, with exceptional attention to numerical and financial accuracy. 
 - Ability to independently own testing deliverables and work effectively in a fast-paced product engineering environment. 

Preferred Skills

- FinOps Certified Practitioner certification or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Experience testing cloud cost management, billing, infrastructure management, or FinOps platforms. 
 - Familiarity with multi-cloud billing datasets, usage metering, cost allocation models, and infrastructure financial analytics. 
 - Exposure to AI/GPU infrastructure economics, power and cooling cost models, workload-based costing, and cost-per-unit calculations. 

Why Join NEXUS: Join a growing AI infrastructure technology company advancing intelligent and autonomous data center operations. Work alongside an experienced engineering team on sophisticated, real-world infrastructure challenges, contributing directly to product quality, financial accuracy, and enterprise platform reliability. 

How to Apply: Interested candidates must apply through the LinkedIn job posting and submit an updated resume highlighting relevant experience in test automation, data center or cloud infrastructure, and financial or data-intensive application testing. Candidates with demonstrable expertise in infrastructure data validation, automation, and cloud financial management will be prioritized.

data.title: QMS Development - Lead
data.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a technically competent, hands-on QMS Development Lead with proven aerospace quality management system experience. In this role, you will build a practical, traceable Quality Management System that connects engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, inspection, risk management, and continual improvement. This role is about building quality into every process, not merely preparing documents for audits. You will maintain independence and objectivity when reporting quality risks, verify corrective-action effectiveness, and never compromise applicable requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

QMS Development & Implementation

- Develop, maintain, and improve a practical QMS aligned with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and AS9100 requirements and the company's actual scope of activities. 
 - Establish and maintain procedures, process maps, work instructions, forms, records, and document-control practices. Risk Management & Internal Audits

- Identify process and product risks, evaluate potential failures, establish suitable controls, and monitor their effectiveness. 
 - Plan and conduct risk-based internal audits, document findings, and verify that corrective actions are effective. Root Cause, Corrective Action & Nonconformity Management

- Lead or facilitate RCA, CAPA, 8D, and other problem-solving methods to prevent recurrence rather than merely correct symptoms. 
 - Establish practical methods to identify, contain, investigate, disposition, and resolve nonconforming products or processes. Supplier Quality

- Support supplier qualification, quality evaluation, and supplier audits. 
 - Manage supplier nonconformities and drive supplier improvement activities. Metrics, Management Review & Digital QMS

- Develop meaningful quality indicators, analyse trends, report risks and performance, and support management reviews. 
 - Digitise document control, audit management, CAPA tracking, training records, and quality reporting while maintaining data integrity and traceability. Training, Culture & Readiness

- Help teams understand why quality controls matter and make quality part of daily work rather than an activity performed only before audits. 
 - Maintain evidence-based compliance, identify gaps early, and coordinate improvement actions with the relevant process owners. 

Qualification & Experience Requirements

Education: Degree in Engineering, Quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated professional expertise. 

Experience: Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on aerospace QMS experience. 

Mandatory Exposure: Practical experience with AS9100 implementation, maintenance, auditing, or improvement, along with DGQA requirements, in an aerospace-related organisation. 

Technical & Professional Skills Required

- Standards Knowledge: Working knowledge of ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and applicable AS9100 and DGQA requirements. 
 - Quality Tools: Practical experience with internal audits, nonconformities, root cause analysis, corrective action, document control, and process improvement. 
 - Process Building: Ability to interpret standards and convert requirements into workable operating processes. 
 - Professional Skills: Strong analytical thinking, professional communication, integrity, and cross-functional coordination. 

Desirable / Preferred Add-On Knowledge

- Supplier Quality: Supplier quality management and supplier audit experience. 
 - Aerospace Manufacturing: Exposure to special-process controls, product traceability, and configuration management. 
 - Digital QMS: Familiarity with digital QMS platforms, workflow automation, dashboards, and quality-data analysis. 
 - Growth-Stage Experience: Experience establishing or strengthening a QMS in a growing or early-stage organisation. 
 - Certifications: Relevant quality or auditor certifications (e. g. , AS9100 Lead Auditor).

Job Summary

Lead and oversee Quality Control and testing operations for Medium Voltage (MV) Air Insulated Switchgear (AIS) panels, ensuring compliance with applicable quality standards, electrical safety regulations, and customer specifications. The role involves technical leadership, team management, quality assurance, testing operations, continuous improvement, and customer coordination. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Leadership

- Lead and coordinate testing activities for MV AIS panels, typically in the 3. 3 kV to 36 kV range. 
 - Review and approve test procedures, protocols, and test reports. 
 - Analyze test results and troubleshoot complex technical issues during testing. 
 - Ensure adherence to technical specifications and applicable testing standards. 2. Team Management

- Supervise, mentor, and develop a team of test engineers and technicians.

 - Conduct performance evaluations and identify training requirements. 
 - Ensure adherence to safety procedures while maintaining team productivity and morale, particularly during high-pressure situations. 3. Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement

- Ensure compliance with relevant IEC, IEEE, and other applicable standards. 
 - Maintain testing equipment calibration, accuracy, and reliability. 
 - Implement quality control measures and validate testing documentation. 
 - Monitor monthly Factory Routine Test (FRT) and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) data and publish key performance indicators (KPIs). 
 - Collect and analyze error data and provide feedback to relevant departments to improve engineering inputs, drawings, and vendor workmanship. 
 - Monitor and control post-dispatch non-conformities (NCC) and site complaints within defined limits. 
 - Lead and participate in cross-functional improvement projects. 4. Project and Customer Management

- Coordinate with project managers to align testing schedules with project requirements. 
 - Monitor testing progress, resource utilization, budgets, and timelines. 
 - Coordinate with customers during witness testing and Factory Acceptance Tests. 
 - Ensure timely completion of testing activities and resolution of technical issues. 5. Audits and Compliance

- Participate in internal and external ISO audits, EHS audits, Energy Management System (EnMS) audits, and factory approval audits. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable quality management systems and audit requirements. 
 - Maintain accurate testing and quality documentation. 6. Environment, Health and Safety (EHS)

- Ensure EHS compliance across shop-floor testing activities. 
 - Maintain records of safety training for testing engineers and technicians. 
 - Maintain safety and compliance documentation for service providers. 
 - Ensure adherence to Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA), Permit to Work (PTW), Toolbox Talks (TBT), and Last-Minute Risk Assessment (LMRA) processes. 
 - Promote electrical safety, arc-flash awareness, and safe working practices.

 - 3-5 years of experience in a team leadership or supervisory role. 
 - Strong background in electrical power distribution systems. Technical Skills

- Expertise in MV switchgear testing procedures and protocols. 
 - Hands-on experience with electrical testing equipment and tools. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 62271, IEEE C37 series, and other relevant standards. 
 - Understanding of protection relay systems and switchgear control schemes. 
 - Experience in test documentation, reporting, and data analysis. Leadership and Behavioral Competencies

- Strong team leadership and people management skills. 
 - Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Effective communication and stakeholder management. 
 - Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines under pressure. Safety Requirements

- Knowledge of electrical safety procedures and arc-flash safety protocols. 
 - Advanced electrical safety certification preferred. 
 - First aid and emergency response training preferred. 
 - Familiarity with electrical safety work permits and safe working procedures. Additional Requirements

data.title: Backend and Algorithms Engineer
data.description:
Ingersoll Rand is committed to achieving workforce diversity reflective of our communities. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. 

Role : Backend and Algorithm Engineer. 

Level: Mid-level, Individual Contributor

-

Experience: 4+ years

-

About The Role

We build a data-driven platform that optimizes compressed air systems - compressors - under real-world operating constraints, including stability, safety, and performance. The algorithms this team develops translate live sensor data into operating decisions that reduce energy consumption, lower emissions, and generate cost savings for customers. 

This role carries end-to-end ownership of algorithms: from the mathematical and control logic that determines how a compressor should behave, through to the production service that executes that decision continuously and safely in the field. For this hire, we are prioritizing engineering strength. We are seeking a candidate whose existing practices already reflect a rigorous, test-first, strongly typed approach to software, so that onboarding time is spent on domain context rather than on foundational engineering habits. 

Responsibilities

- Build and maintain production-grade Python services and automated pipelines to a consistently high standard of testing, type safety, and reliability. 
 - Design and implement optimization and control logic that translates physical and operational constraints into decisions executed by real compressors. 
 - Fit and calibrate models against noisy, real-world sensor data, exercising sound judgment about when a given fit or result cannot be trusted, such as in the presence of outliers, edge cases, or boundary behavior. 
 - Write tests prior to implementation as standard practice, using shared, reusable test fixtures rather than ad hoc, hardcoded test data. 
 - Carry projects from design through automated verification to production deployment, in close collaboration with a distributed core engineering team. 

Required Qualifications

- 4+ years of experience building and shipping production Python systems, with demonstrated proficiency in type-hinted code and schema-first data models, as opposed to unstructured data passed between functions. 
 - Strong testing discipline, including test-first development, well-structured and reusable test fixtures, and a consistently high standard of test coverage as an established practice rather than an aspirational goal. 
 - Demonstrated ability to own a service across its full lifecycle: containerized, deployed through an automated pipeline, and operated within an orchestrated, multi-service infrastructure. 
 - Working knowledge of relational databases and at least one caching or eventing layer in a production environment. 
 - Familiarity with modern, reproducible dependency management practices for Python, in contrast to less structured approaches to package installation. 
 - Strong applied problem-solving ability in optimization or control logic, with demonstrated capacity to translate physical or operational constraints, such as stability, safety, or performance limits, into functioning algorithms rather than relying solely on off-the-shelf models. 
 - Experience fitting or calibrating models against real-world, noisy data, with sound judgment regarding the reliability of results. 
 - A disciplined approach to data and experimentation, including reproducible results, appropriate training and validation practices for time-ordered data, and awareness of data leakage risks. 
 - Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with a distributed team across time zones. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with more than one cloud provider, or genuine interest in cloud migration work. 
 - Experience with workflow or pipeline orchestration systems, beyond request-response APIs. 
 - Academic or professional background in a physical or engineering discipline relevant to rotating or reciprocating machinery - thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, or mechanical/industrial systems - compressors being one example. 
 - Hands-on machine learning experience, which is valuable but secondary to the optimization and control skill set described above. 
 - An advanced degree in a quantitative or engineering field. 

What We Offer

- We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success. 
 - Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication. 
 - Leave Encashments 
 - Maternity/Paternity Leaves 
 - Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance 
 - Employee Assistance Program 
 - Employee development with LinkedIn Learning 
 - Employee recognition via Awardco 
 - Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork. 

Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE: IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www. IRCO. com.

data.title: Staff Engineer , ESSD Validation
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

As a Staff SSD Validation Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc. , you will be responsible for defining and driving comprehensive validation strategies for Micron NAND-based SSD systems and solutions. You will lead development of test plans, test cases, and automation frameworks to validate SSD firmware across functional, system-level, performance, reliability, interoperability, and customer qualification domains. You will serve as a technical leader, driving validation excellence, automation, and innovation while collaborating closely with firmware, hardware, systems, product engineering, and hyperscale customers throughout the product lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in NVMe/PCIe technologies, SSD architecture, customer qualification requirements, and automated validation methodologies. This role also requires a strong focus on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advanced automation technologies to improve validation productivity, product quality, and time-to-market. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define validation strategies, test plans, test cases, and automation frameworks for SSD firmware validation. 
 - Develop and maintain automated test solutions covering functional, system, performance, reliability, interoperability, and customer qualification requirements. 
 - Lead validation efforts across all phases of the product lifecycle, including development, qualification, customer enablement, and sustaining activities. 
 - Demonstrate strong understanding of NVMe, PCIe, OCP Cloud SSD specifications, storage protocols, and customer-specific requirements. 
 - Partner with Micron's hyperscale and datacenter customers to improve product quality, customer satisfaction, and qualification cycle times. 
 - Drive issue identification, debug, root cause analysis, and closure through effective collaboration with firmware, hardware, system architecture, and product engineering teams. 
 - Analyze validation results, identify quality risks, and provide clear recommendations to stakeholders and leadership. 
 - Communicate validation status, technical risks, mitigation plans, and project progress effectively across organizations. 
 - Influence and lead cross-functional teams to execute validation strategies and achieve program milestones. 
 - Operate effectively in ambiguous environments and independently drive high-impact initiatives to completion. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote technical excellence, automation, and best practices across the validation organization. 
 - Leverage AI-powered engineering tools and approved enterprise AI solutions to improve test development, debug efficiency, data analysis, and reporting workflows. 
 - Identify opportunities to apply AI and machine learning techniques for automating validation workflows, failure analysis, anomaly detection, and predictive quality analytics. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort, enhance test coverage, accelerate issue triage, and improve validation throughput. 
 - Utilize Generative AI tools for code generation, test case development, log analysis, technical documentation, and productivity enhancement while adhering to company policies. 
 - Champion responsible and ethical AI practices, ensuring compliance with Micron AI governance, security, privacy, and data protection requirements. 
 - Mentor teams on effective AI adoption, prompt engineering techniques, and AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve organizational productivity and innovation. 
 -

Required Experience

- 6-12 years of experience in Embedded Firmware, Storage Systems, or SSD Validation Engineering. 
 - 4+ years of SSD Firmware Validation experience is highly preferred. 
 - Strong understanding of SSD architecture, NAND Flash technologies, and storage subsystems. 
 - Deep knowledge of NVMe, PCIe, OCP Cloud SSD, and enterprise storage specifications. 
 - Experience with Datacenter Compute and Storage environments such as Microsoft Hyper-V, VMware vSphere, VSAN, and cloud infrastructure is a strong plus. 
 - Strong hands-on experience debugging NVMe/SAS protocol issues using protocol analyzers such as LeCroy and JDSU. 
 - Experience developing comprehensive validation plans involving I/O workloads, NVMe protocols, media management, endurance, and reliability testing. 
 - Experience using storage validation platforms and tools such as Medusa, SanBlaze, OakGate, UNH, PCIe-CV, and related qualification suites. 
 - Experience integrating tests into automated validation frameworks and continuous integration environments. 
 - Proven ability to drive complex technical issues to closure across multiple organizations. 
 - Experience reviewing, analyzing, tracking, and documenting validation results and product quality issues. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in driving validation strategies for large-scale programs and customer engagements. 

Successful Candidates Will Have

Technical Skills

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field. 
 - Strong programming expertise in Python and test automation framework development. 
 - Strong Linux and Windows debugging experience. 
 - Excellent knowledge of storage systems and platform architecture, including CPU, Memory, PCIe, Drivers, Operating Systems, Firmware, and Hardware interactions. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 
 - Experience with large-scale automation environments and continuous validation systems. 
 - Ability to analyze complex technical data and make informed engineering decisions. 

AI & Data-Driven Engineering Skills

- Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools to improve engineering productivity and technical decision-making. 
 - Understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and practical AI use cases within engineering workflows. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools for scripting, debugging, test generation, report creation, and knowledge discovery. 
 - Knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, data analytics, and AI-enabled automation techniques is highly desirable. 
 - Ability to critically review and validate AI-generated outputs and apply engineering judgment to ensure technical accuracy. 
 - Commitment to responsible AI usage, data governance, security, privacy, and ethical AI practices. 

Leadership & Professional Skills

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Strong project planning, execution, and organizational skills. 
 - Ability to lead multiple priorities and programs simultaneously. 
 - Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority. 
 - Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Proven mentoring and technical leadership capabilities. 
 - Results-oriented mindset with the ability to drive execution in fast-paced and ambiguous environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working directly with hyperscale, enterprise, or cloud storage customers. 
 - Experience applying AI/ML techniques to validation, quality engineering, or system analytics. 
 - Experience building data-driven dashboards, predictive quality models, or intelligent test orchestration systems. 
 - Active contributor to automation, innovation, and continuous improvement initiatives within engineering organizations. 

About Micron Technology, Inc. 

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities - from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience. 

To learn more, please visit micron. com/careers

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 

To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport_india@micron. com

Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards. 

Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.

However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.

data.title: Mgr, Software Engineer (Java / Python / Cloud / Distributed)
data.description:
Own Every Moment at NetApp

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure-delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud. 

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function. 

Job Summary

Are you passionate about open-source technologies or solving distributed computing problems at scale? Do you love learning and working with a diverse range of technologies and people? We're looking for a collaborative and curious Lead Software Engineer to join our development team at NetApp Instaclustr (www. instaclustr. com). 

Our mission at NetApp Instaclustr (www. instaclustr. com) is to make it easy for customers around the globe to run powerful open-source applications at scale - like Cassandra, Kafka, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Cadence, and ClickHouse, across both on-premises data-centres and in the cloud. 

The NetApp Instaclustr development team is responsible for building, maintaining and operating the platform that allows us to provision and reliably keep thousands of distributed application servers running worldwide. 

Job Requirements

8 or more years of commercial experience regularly delivering quality software and overcoming technical challenges. 

Demonstrated experience with leading people. 

Proficiency in Java, SQL and at least one other modern programming language - and openness to learning more. 

Strong communication skills and a humble and collaborative nature - essential for working harmoniously with multiple teams. 

A curious mindset with a keen interest in how your work will positively impact customers. 

Eagerness to tackle new challenges and continuously grow you and your team's software engineering skills. 

Working with a wide range of technologies and tools, such as: Java, SQL, Python, Typescript, Rust, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Debian, and more. 

Working with major cloud providers. Our systems run on AWS, Azure and GCP. 

Responsibilities

Lead one of the teams of 5-10 engineers that makes up our product development team. You can expect that some of your time will be spent helping your team head in the right direction, and some will be spent being hands-on with our technology and systems and doing your own development tasks. 

Take end to end ownership of one or more aspects of our managed platform, which takes care of the whole lifecycle: provisioning infrastructure, installing applications and, most importantly, keeping the applications running reliably in production. 

Work with a Product Manager to set team priorities, and work with a senior software engineering manager to plan and manage the work of your team. 

Develop the skills and careers of the engineers in your team. 

Work with other Lead Software Engineers to support each other in developing complex solutions or agreeing on the best approach to solve problems which affect everyone. 

Apply DevOps best practices as part of a global team that operates 24x7. This may include participating in on-call support roles to assist in keeping our management platform running smoothly.

About The Team And Role

The eBay Cloud team powers the foundational cloud infrastructure that supports thousands of eBay applications. As one of the largest private cloud platforms in the industry, we operate and manage hundreds of Kubernetes clusters across diverse environments, comprising millions of compute instances. 

The Traffic team is critical to the availability and performance of eBay's private cloud. Our responsibilities encompass the end-to-end management of all cloud traffic infrastructure, including load balancing, global traffic management (GTM), Point of Presence (PoP), service mesh, API gateways, and advanced network policies. We design, deploy, and operate high-performance, fault-tolerant traffic routing solutions that handle billions of daily requests, ensuring seamless, low-latency connectivity for both internal microservices and external customer traffic. This involves continuous optimization of data plane performance, rigorous security enforcement at the edge and within the cluster, and developing self-service tools that empower application teams to configure their connectivity reliably and securely across our massive global footprint. 

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Cloud Traffic Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for the development, operations, and governance of one of the largest private clouds in the world based on Kubernetes. 

You will guide and mentor a team of hardworking engineers in building and maintaining robust, secure, and scalable cloud offerings that empower eBay's core product engineering organizations and initiatives. 

We require a unique blend of cloud expertise, traffic management, software development management experience, and strong leadership skills. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of cloud-native technologies, experience managing and developing software engineering teams, passion for building scalable and reliable systems, and excellent people skills to cultivate a high-performing team.

building, etc.

scalability. 

Ensure full software lifecycle instrumentation from requirement ideation to software development to deployment. 

Drive the adoption of cloud-native technologies and standard processes, such as service mesh, microservices, etc. 

Collaboration With Internal Partners And Team Members

Cloud engineering and operations teams, product, and PMO on engineering resource allocation and project schedules in accordance with our strategic organizational priorities. 

Cloud SRE team to champion automation to enhance efficiency and reliability. 

Operations teams on maintaining a highly available cloud infrastructure to ensure eBay's products and services are available to our customers. 

Fleet management team passionate about managing resources, coordinating workloads, and controlling costs for the private cloud. 

Information security teams to ensure integrity and compliance of the cloud infrastructure by implementing appropriate security controls and monitoring. 

Global security teams to ensure the products are protected against external and internal threats

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of people management or technical leadership. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge technical and design perspectives. 
 - Strong technical background with a deep understanding of cloud-native architectures and technologies (e. g. , Kubernetes, containerization, service mesh, microservices). 
 - Experience with software development, networking, and security technologies in a large-scale cloud environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

 - Proven ability to work closely with Information Security teams on compliance, security controls, and monitoring for cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong product attitude - balancing security rigor with customer empathy and usability.

data.description:
Overview

Are you passionate about data platforms and tools? Are you an open-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization. 

You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities. 

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. 

Responsibilities

We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data. 

As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will

- Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption
 - Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption
 - Architect robust multi-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads
 - Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers
 - Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. 

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. 

Qualifications

Required

- 12+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure
 - You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework
 - You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost. 
 - Deep understanding of big data and distributed systems challenges including partitioning, shuffle behaviour, skew, idempotency and backfills
 - Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
 - Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
 - Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake
 - A track record of owning ambiguous cross team problems end to end and of influencing without authority
 - Degree in Computer Science, EE or a related STEM discipline or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

- Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot
 - Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume
 - Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
 - Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale
 - Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP
 - Experience running platform components on Kubernetes
 - Experience with multi region data architectures, including replication, failover and consistency tradeoffs

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go. atlassian. com/perksandbenefits .

data.description:
AI Engineering & Data Science Lead

Company: Tapza Technologies

Location: Hyderabad, India

Employment: Full-time | On-site

Experience: 5+ years, with demonstrated ownership of production AI systems

About Tapza

At Tapza, we're building an AI-native operating system for healthcare providers, including pharmacies, clinics, and hospitals. 

Our philosophy is simple: 

The best healthcare software might be the software healthcare professionals barely have to operate. 

The Opportunity

We're looking for an AI Engineering & Data Science Lead to own the technical direction, architecture, and execution of AI across Tapza's healthcare products. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. 

You'll work directly with the founding team, make consequential engineering decisions, build production-grade AI systems, and gradually develop the AI engineering team around you. 

We're looking for someone who has already taken AI systems beyond prototypes and successfully deployed them in real-world environments. 

What You'll Own

1. Agentic AI & LLM Engineering

- Architect, build, and deploy production-grade AI agents, RAG systems, and intelligent automation workflows. 
 - Develop reliable agent orchestration, tool integrations, structured data extraction, and enterprise system integrations. 
 - Implement robust guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, data security, observability, and failure recovery. 
 - Own model selection, evaluation, and optimization for accuracy, latency, reliability, scalability, and inference cost. 

2. Production AI Engineering

- Design scalable AI services, inference pipelines, and integrations with backend systems. 
 - Implement observability, automated testing, model monitoring, versioning, and rollback mechanisms. 
 - Optimize inference performance, reliability, and infrastructure costs. 
 - Establish secure data handling, access controls, and privacy-aware AI architecture. 

What We're Looking For

Required

- 5+ years of relevant software engineering, machine learning, or applied AI experience. 
 - Proven experience in architecting, building, and deploying AI/ML systems used in production. 
 - Strong Python programming and software engineering fundamentals. 
 - Experience with machine learning fundamentals, statistical evaluation, and model performance measurement. 
 - Experience building APIs, data pipelines, and cloud-deployed services. 
 - Practical understanding of model evaluation, latency optimization, inference economics, security, and production reliability. 
 - Ability to independently own complex technical problems from architecture through deployment. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing technical designs, or leading technical delivery. 

Good to Have

- Experience with speech AI, multilingual NLP, OCR, or document intelligence. 
 - Experience with time-series forecasting and predictive analytics. 
 - Familiarity with AWS and production MLOps infrastructure. 
 - Experience with healthcare, healthtech, or other regulated industries. 
 - Experience building systems that process sensitive information. 
 - Familiarity with clinical workflows, interoperability standards, or ABDM. Healthcare domain experience is an advantage, not a requirement. Strong production engineering experience matters more. 

Why Join Tapza?

- Technical ownership: Shape the architecture and engineering direction of AI across multiple healthcare products. 
 - Real-world complexity: Solve problems involving reliability, multilingual environments, latency, inference costs, security, and imperfect data. 
 - Leadership opportunity: Help establish and grow Tapza's AI engineering function. 
 - Long-term upside: Equity participation and the potential to progress into a broader AI leadership role as the company grows. 

Compensation

Competitive compensation within our current startup-stage budget, along with meaningful equity participation. 

Detailed compensation and equity terms will be discussed during the hiring process. 

How to Apply

We're especially interested in understanding what you've actually built and shipped. 

Along with your resume or LinkedIn profile, please share: 

- One AI/ML system you personally architected or substantially built and deployed in production. 
 - Your specific technical contribution, the hardest engineering challenge, and how you solved it. 
 - The scale of the system and how you measured its reliability, accuracy, latency, or cost. GitHub repositories, technical write-ups, architecture diagrams, or project demonstrations are welcome where publicly shareable. 

We're looking for demonstrated engineering ownership-not just familiarity with AI tools and frameworks.

data.title: QA and compliance Specialist – QMS
data.company: Neo Power Electronics & Projects Private Limited
data.description:
Company Description: 

Established in 1975, Neo Power Electronics & Projects Private Limited is an ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 14001: 2015 and ISO 45001: 2018 certified leader in electrical manufacturing and EPC solutions, serving industrial, commercial, infrastructure and defence sectors across India, Southeast Asia and Africa. The company designs, manufactures, installs, tests and commissions high-performance electrical, electronics, instrumentation and automation systems and turnkey projects, and exports defence equipment including submarine and torpedo batteries. Neo Power delivers scalable, cost-effective solutions backed by precision execution and long-standing client relationships. 

Job Location: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

Role Description: 

We manufacture electrical and electronic equipment, including products designed for hazardous-area (Ex) applications. We are looking for a  QA & Compliance Specialist  to support and maintain our  ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS), ISO 14001 Environmental Management System (EMS), and ISO 45001 Occupational Health & Safety (OH&S) Management System. The QA & Compliance Specialist will be responsible for supporting day-to-day quality activities on the shop floor, ensuring compliance with applicable quality, environmental, occupational health and safety, and hazardous-area (Ex) requirements. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

- Maintain and update  QMS documentation, including procedures, work instructions, formats, controlled forms and quality records, ensuring revision control, traceability and withdrawal of obsolete documents; guide and train shop-floor personnel on the correct completion and maintenance of quality and production records. 
 - Conduct and coordinate  incoming, in-process and final inspections  of materials, components, assemblies and finished products against approved drawings, specifications and inspection plans, including review of inspection and test reports prior to product release/dispatch. 
 - Identify, segregate and control  non-conforming products; raise and track NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) and coordinate root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) with relevant departments through implementation, verification and closure. 
 - Monitor  process and product quality  on the shop floor, identify recurring defects and ensure identification and traceability of raw materials, components, work-in-progress and finished products, promoting a right-first-time culture with Production and Engineering. 
 - Maintain the  calibration schedule and records  for measuring, monitoring and test equipment, ensuring that only calibrated and valid instruments are used for inspection and testing. 
 - Support  supplier quality and customer complaint  investigations, including supplier-related NCRs and follow-up on corrective actions through timely closure. 
 - Support  internal, customer and certification audits  by preparing records and following up findings to closure; compile quality data and KPIs (rejection, rework, NCRs, complaints, CAPA status) for monthly quality reviews and management review inputs. 
 - Ensure that no unauthorised changes are made to  certified product designs, components, materials, software, processes or critical parameters without technical review, documented approval and change control, and maintain compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, customer and hazardous-area (Ex) certification requirements. 

Qualifications

- B. E. /B. Tech. in Electrical or Electronics Engineering from a recognised institution. 
 - 2-4 years in a QA/QC role in electrical or electronics manufacturing. 
 - Working knowledge of ISO 9001: 2015 QMS requirements, documentation and records; ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 knowledge is an advantage. 
 - Hands-on incoming, in-process and final inspection using measuring instruments and electrical test equipment. 
 - Proficient in MS Excel and Word, with good written and spoken English. 
 - Detail-oriented and disciplined in documentation, record control and closing quality actions. 

Preferred: 

- Experience in or an  IECEx, ATEX, or PESO-certified manufacturing organization, with awareness of applicable  IEC 60079 series  and  ISO/IEC 80079-34  requirements. 

- ISO 9001: 2015 Internal Auditor certification  or practical experience in conducting/supporting internal QMS audits. 

- Experience in  electrical/electronic manufacturing, preferably involving  electrical panels, lighting equipment, battery associated electronic control, or hazardous-area (Ex) equipment. 

- Familiarity with  Ex-product documentation, inspection requirements, traceability, change control, non-conformity management, and certification-related quality controls  will be an added advantage.
